lines.japanese: 不作法の穴を埋めるように朗々と、忍は叫んだ。
lines.english: To fill the holes in his etiquette, Shinobu declared in a ringing voice:

lines.japanese: 「結構なお点前で！」
lines.english: “The tea is exquisite!”

lines.japanese: まだ飲んでない。
lines.english: He had not drunk it yet.

lines.japanese: 咄嗟に沙也加が顔を伏せた。
lines.english: Sayaka abruptly bowed her head.

lines.japanese:
肩が震えた気もしたが、再び持ち上げた顔には、
さきほどより堅牢な鉄の面が張りついていた。
lines.english: Her shoulders might have trembled, but when she raised her face again, an iron mask more impregnable than before was fastened over it.
(Now—!)

lines.japanese:
飲む。
　最後の一口まで、音を立てないように飲みきった。
lines.english: He drank. He drained it to the last drop without making a sound.

lines.japanese: （これはかなり高得点だったはずだ！）
lines.english: (That must have earned me serious points!)

lines.japanese:
沙也加は目で忍を射る。
　忍もこれに応え、まっこうから受け止めた。
lines.english: Sayaka transfixed Shinobu with her gaze. He answered it, meeting her head-on.

lines.japanese:
自信満々、意気軒昂。ついに礼節が牙を剥くとき
がやってきたことを、二人はひしひしと感じ取る。
lines.english: Confidence swelled; spirits soared. Both could feel that the hour had come for courtesy to bare its fangs.

lines.japanese:
和の空間が緊迫感を帯びていく。
　沙也加が小さく唇を噛む。
　視線が力を宿した。
lines.english: The harmonious room grew taut with menace. Sayaka bit her lip. Her gaze gathered force.

lines.japanese:
怒気を充溢させたような少女の奉仕の心に、忍も
また決死の覚悟で挑む。
lines.english: Against the girl's spirit of hospitality, seemingly brimming with wrath, Shinobu staked his life.

lines.japanese:
両名の間にかかっていた緊張の橋は、今や峻厳な
山嶺となっていた。
lines.english: The bridge of tension between them had risen into a stern mountain ridge.

lines.japanese:
その山頂で二つの念は激突し、闘争し、烈風とな
って渦巻く。
lines.english: At its summit their wills collided, struggled, and spiraled into a gale.

lines.japanese: 精一杯のもてなす心、対する無二の感謝。
lines.english: Hospitality given to the utmost; answering it, gratitude without equal.

lines.japanese:
二つは鋼の音を鳴らして幾度となく名勝負を繰り
広げた。
lines.english: Again and again, the two fought match after splendid match amid the clash of steel.

lines.japanese:
頃合いを見て茶器を下げに来た女性が、ぎょっと
した顔をして扉を閉める。戦場だった。
lines.english: A woman who came to clear the tea things took one startled look and closed the door. It was a battlefield.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の気持ちが刃の鋭さで打ち込まれれば、忍
もより以上の感謝を盾として受け止め、全身全霊で
押し返す。
lines.english: Whenever Sayaka's feelings struck with the edge of a blade, Shinobu received them on a shield of still greater gratitude and drove her back with all his heart and strength.

lines.japanese:
チリチリと、焼けつく思念がさらなる高みに研ぎ
澄まされていく。
lines.english: Their searing thoughts crackled and sharpened toward still greater heights.

lines.japanese:
感謝が、静寂が、礼儀が、
優しさが、友愛が、慎みが、不可視の弾丸となって
撃ち放たれ斬撃と化して室内を無尽に振る舞う、
lines.english: Gratitude, silence, courtesy— kindness, friendship, modesty—became invisible bullets, fired and transformed into slashing blows that raged without limit through the room.

lines.japanese: さながらそれは和敬清寂の暴風雨。
lines.english: A veritable tempest of harmony, respect, purity, and tranquility.

lines.japanese:
活けてあった花が力無く落ちた。
　ギシギシと軋む柱の悲鳴を忍はどこかに聞いた。
lines.english: The arranged flower drooped helplessly. Somewhere, Shinobu heard the pillars groan and creak.

lines.japanese:
沙也加が持てる好意を振り絞って、眼光に殺傷力
を乗せる。
lines.english: Sayaka wrung out every drop of goodwill she possessed and loaded her glare with lethal force.

lines.japanese:
忍は歯を食いしばってそれに耐えた。
　この道では、残念ながら彼女に一日の長がある。
lines.english: Shinobu gritted his teeth and endured. Regrettably, she had the advantage of experience in this discipline.

lines.japanese:
ぐいぐい押し込まれれば、狭い部屋のこと、逃げ
場はない。
lines.english: Pressed steadily backward in that cramped room, he had nowhere to flee.

lines.japanese:
そして逃げるつもりもない忍は、内心念仏を唱え
ながら、なんとなればこれしかないと決めていた逆
転の発想を繰り出すのである。
lines.english: Nor did Shinobu intend to flee. Chanting a prayer inwardly, he unleashed the reversal he had decided was his only remaining option.
(You—)

lines.japanese:
目を閉じ、寸時相手を油断させつつ、開眼と同時
に思いの丈を双眼へとこめた。
lines.english: He closed his eyes, lulling his opponent for the briefest instant, then opened them and poured the full measure of his feelings into his gaze.

lines.japanese: （好きだ！！）
lines.english: (I love you!)

lines.japanese:
ゼロ距離からそれぞれのどてっ腹に機関銃の弾丸
を埋め込みあうようなもので、どこか恍惚とした境
地で二人は断末魔の愉悦に身を委ねるのであった。
lines.english: It was as though each emptied a machine gun into the other's belly at point-blank range. In a state approaching rapture, they surrendered to the ecstatic pleasure of their own death throes.

lines.japanese:
やがてどちらからともなく、ため息が漏れた。
　急速に世界は弛緩していった。
lines.english: At last a sigh escaped. The world relaxed in a rush.

lines.japanese: 「今日は、」
lines.english: “Today…”

lines.japanese: 色濃い疲労を感じさせる声音で、沙也加が口を開く。
lines.english: Sayaka spoke in a voice heavy with exhaustion.

lines.japanese: 「ありが……とう……」
lines.english: “Thank… you…”

lines.japanese: 「こちら……こそ……」
lines.english: “No… thank you…”

lines.japanese: そしてまた、二人は同時に肩と息を落とした。
lines.english: Again, their shoulders sank and their breath left them in unison.

lines.japanese: 「では」
lines.english: “Well, then.”

lines.japanese:
忍は立ち上がろうとした。
　すっかり忘れていた。
lines.english: Shinobu tried to stand. He had completely forgotten.
“Ah… Whoa…!?”

lines.japanese:
足が痺れていることさえ、気が付かなかったので
ある。
lines.english: He had not even noticed that his legs were asleep.

lines.japanese:
そんな忍を見つめる沙也加の顔が、憐憫を宿して
いる。
lines.english: Sayaka watched him with pity in her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、あっ、あひぃ」
lines.english: “Ah—ah—aaah!”

lines.japanese: それはもう無様に、忍はひっくり返る。
lines.english: Shinobu toppled over in the most undignified fashion imaginable.

lines.japanese:
本堂家の妙に美形な家政婦につきそわれ、玄関に
向かう。
lines.english: Escorted by the Hondou household's strangely beautiful maid, he made his way to the front door.

lines.japanese: 「……どうだった？」
lines.english: “…How was it?”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese:
「お嬢さんがお友達を連れてくるのは珍しいの……
　だから」
lines.english: “It's rare for the young lady to bring a friend home… so I wondered.”

lines.japanese:
味のあるクールビューティーだった。
　『月火水木金土日』の七曜の文字を模様とした、
変なエプロンをつけている。
lines.english: She was a cool beauty with an intriguing air. Her odd apron was patterned with the seven kanji for the days of the week.

lines.japanese:
なぜ家政婦をやっているんだろうと疑問に思った
が、残念ながら思考力は尽きている。
lines.english: He wondered why she worked as a maid, but unfortunately his powers of thought were spent.

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Well…”

lines.japanese: あの素晴らしい特濃時間を思い出し、
lines.english: Remembering that wonderfully intense stretch of time,

lines.japanese: 「……茶道、すごい」
lines.english: “…Tea ceremony is incredible.”

lines.japanese: 快楽に呻くように呟いた。
lines.english: He murmured it like a moan of pleasure.
“Heh…”

lines.japanese: 妖しく家政婦は笑った。
lines.english: The maid laughed mysteriously.

lines.japanese: 「若いのね」
lines.english: “So young.”
“…What?”

lines.japanese: 「きっとお嬢さんも本望でしょうね」
lines.english: “I'm sure the young lady is perfectly satisfied.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてですか？」
lines.english: “Why is that?”

lines.japanese: 「はじめての招待で、あんなにも情熱的に」
lines.english: “On your very first invitation, and with such passion…”

lines.japanese: 「は、はじめてだったんですか！？」
lines.english: “Th-That was her first time!?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「それはもう、入念に準備を」
lines.english: “She prepared for it most meticulously.”

lines.japanese: 「昨夜は緊張にピリピリとしていたようね」
lines.english: “She seemed positively raw with nerves last night.”

lines.japanese:
（……怒っていたんじゃなくて緊張していたのか……
　アレ……）
lines.english: (…So she wasn't angry. That was nervousness… That…?)

lines.japanese: 「あなた、はじめての男ね」
lines.english: “You're her first man.”
“…Her what?”

lines.japanese: 「お嬢さんは、メロメロ」
lines.english: “The young lady is completely smitten.”

lines.japanese: 「いっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese:
「フフ、フフ……お嬢さんのはじめて、はじめての
　お嬢さん」
lines.english: “Heh, heh… The young lady's first time; our first-time young lady.”

lines.japanese: 「な、何を言ってるんです！」
lines.english: “Wh-What are you saying!?”

lines.japanese:
ドキドキしながら、忍は目線を落とした。
　家政婦は拳の内側から、親指を突き出すように握
り込んでいるのが見えた。
lines.english: Heart pounding, Shinobu lowered his gaze. He saw that the maid had made a fist around her thumb, leaving it protruding between her fingers.

lines.japanese: 血液の温度が一気に冷えた。
lines.english: The heat drained from his blood in an instant.

lines.japanese: 「……その手、やめてくれます？」
lines.english: “…Would you stop doing that with your hand?”

lines.japanese: 「あら？」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 「見えてないと思って、そんな卑猥な」
lines.english: “You thought I couldn't see you making that obscene—”

lines.japanese: 「失敬」
lines.english: “My apologies.”

lines.japanese: 「アヤしい人ですね、あなた」
lines.english: “You're a suspicious character, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「ただの１８歳家政婦よ」
lines.english: “I'm merely an eighteen-year-old maid.”

lines.japanese: 「なんかアヤしいなあ」
lines.english: “There's definitely something suspicious about you.”

lines.japanese: 「若いのね」
lines.english: “So young.”

lines.japanese: 「…………いや、若いとか関係ない……」
lines.english: “……No, age has nothing to do with it…”

lines.japanese: 「フフ」
lines.english: “Heh.”

lines.japanese: 「フフとか言ってるけど、顔笑ってないですよね？」
lines.english: “You keep saying ‘heh,’ but you're not actually smiling, are you?”

lines.japanese: 後ろ姿からはわからないが、確信していた。
lines.english: He could not tell from behind her, but he was certain.

lines.japanese: 「失敬」
lines.english: “My apologies.”

lines.japanese: 「だからその手やめてくださいって言ったでしょ！」
lines.english: “I told you to stop doing that with your hand!”

lines.japanese: エロい家政婦さんだった。
lines.english: She was one lewd maid.

lines.japanese:
「あなた……沙也加のことイジメてたりしないでしょ
　うね？」
lines.english: “You haven't been tormenting Sayaka or anything, have you?”

lines.japanese: 「呼び捨て？」
lines.english: “Calling her Sayaka, are we?”

lines.japanese: 「あの子をイジメるなんてできないわ」
lines.english: “I could never torment that girl.”

lines.japanese: 「……自宅の中では、僕の目も届かないので」
lines.english: “…I can't keep an eye on her inside her own home.”

lines.japanese: 「ナイト気取りね」
lines.english: “Playing the knight?”

lines.japanese: 「それとも、そういうことが昔実際にあった？」
lines.english: “Or has something like that actually happened before?”
“Not really…”

lines.japanese:
だが言われて思い出すのは、孤軍奮闘の記憶ばか
りだ。
lines.english: Yet her words called up memory after memory of fighting alone.

lines.japanese:
沙也加はいつも一人だったし、彼女につきまとう
形になった忍もまた、クラスメイトに親しい友人を
持たなかった。
lines.english: Sayaka had always been alone. And Shinobu, who came to trail along after her, had no close friends among their classmates either.

lines.japanese:
いや、持てなかったのだ。
　やがて二人が互いを認めるような関係になると、
クラスの全てが完全に他者になった。
lines.english: No—he had been unable to have them. Once the two came to acknowledge one another, everyone else in their class became an absolute stranger.

lines.japanese:
決して寂しいばかりではなかったのである。
　そして代用のきかない関係性であったからこそ、
二人の絆は深まった。
lines.english: It had never been merely lonely. And because theirs was a bond for which no substitute existed, it deepened.

lines.japanese: 「あなた達のなれそめ、気になるわね」
lines.english: “I'm curious how the two of you came together.”

lines.japanese:
「……言いませんよ。沙也加にも訊かないでくださ
　いね」
lines.english: “…I'm not telling. And please don't ask Sayaka about it, either.”

lines.japanese: 「平気よ。あの子をイジメるなんてできないわ」
lines.english: “Don't worry. I could never torment that girl.”

lines.japanese: 「物理的にも、観念的にも」
lines.english: “Not physically, nor conceptually.”

lines.japanese: 家政婦の言葉の意味を見失う。
lines.english: The meaning of the maid's words eluded him.

lines.japanese: 「観念？」
lines.english: “Conceptually?”

lines.japanese: 「上位の自我を迫害することなどできないわ、王様」
lines.english: “One cannot persecute a higher ego, my king.”

lines.japanese: 忍は愕然と目の前の人物を見つめた。
lines.english: Shinobu stared at the woman before him in shock.
“Um—”

lines.japanese: 「こちらでお待ちくださいとのことです」
lines.english: “You’ve been asked to wait here.”

lines.japanese:
玄関だった。
　家政婦は一礼し、引き下がった。
lines.english: They had reached the entryway. The maid bowed and withdrew.

lines.japanese: 「あの！」
lines.english: “Excuse me!”

lines.japanese:
行ってしまった。
　狐につままれたような顔で、忍は立ち尽くした。
lines.english: She was gone. Shinobu stood rooted to the spot, looking utterly baffled.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 私服に着替えた沙也加がやってきた。
lines.english: Sayaka returned, changed into ordinary clothes.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、着替えたんだ？」
lines.english: “Oh, you changed?”

lines.japanese: 「……ええ、恥ずかしいから」
lines.english: “…Yes. I was embarrassed.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな、良かったのに」
lines.english: “You didn't have to be. It looked good on you.”

lines.japanese: 「……悦子さんが何か？」
lines.english: “…Did Etsuko say something?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、特には」
lines.english: “No, nothing in particular.”

lines.japanese: 「変わったお手伝いさんだね」
lines.english: “She's an unusual maid.”

lines.japanese:
「そう？　真面目だけど、とても大人しい方よ。自己
　主張のない」
lines.english: “Really? She's very serious, but terribly reserved. She never asserts herself.”

lines.japanese:
「……きっと好奇心に殺されないタイプだ。注意し
　た方がいいね」
lines.english: “…I doubt curiosity will ever kill that cat. You should watch out for her.”

lines.japanese: 見送られて、帰路に就いた。
lines.english: Sayaka saw him off, and he started for home.

lines.japanese: 夕刻だった。
lines.english: It was evening.

lines.japanese:
伊勢崎宗多の噂は、世情にうとい忍も耳にするこ
とが多かった。
lines.english: Even Shinobu, out of touch with current affairs, had often heard rumors about Souta Isezaki.

lines.japanese:
大人の視点では、彼は平凡な少年以外の何者でも
なかっただろう。
lines.english: To an adult's eye, he would have been nothing more than an ordinary boy.

lines.japanese:
だが子供にしかわからない倫理、大人には見えな
い世界では、伊勢崎宗多は牙を持った獣そのものだ
った。
lines.english: But under a code of ethics only children understood, in a world adults could not see, Souta Isezaki was nothing less than a fanged beast.

lines.japanese:
単独、一匹狼ではない。
　数名の、同種の仲間もいた。
lines.english: Nor was he solitary, a lone wolf. Several others of his kind ran with him.

lines.japanese:
宗多はその中でもっとも小柄だったが、もっとも
俊敏でもっとも攻撃的だった。
lines.english: Souta was the smallest among them, but also the quickest and the most aggressive.

lines.japanese:
結果として彼は集団の上に立ち、弱者を傷つける
日々を謳歌していた。
lines.english: Consequently, he reigned over the group and spent his days reveling in hurting the weak.

lines.japanese: 子供のすること、と大人は思うだろう。
lines.english: Just children being children, an adult might say.

lines.japanese:
だがときにそうした攻撃は、未成熟な心を破壊す
ることさえあった。
lines.english: Yet such attacks sometimes went so far as to destroy an immature heart.

lines.japanese:
多くが水面下で。
　子供たちの前では、はばかることなく。
lines.english: Most of it happened beneath the surface. But before other children, they showed no restraint.

lines.japanese:
いずれにしても、大人の介入しえない次元での出
来事である。
lines.english: Either way, it happened in a dimension beyond the reach of adult intervention.

lines.japanese:
別世界の物語に等しいのである。
　集団を脱落した者が“略奪”されているのを、忍
は幾度か目にした。
lines.english: It might as well have been a story from another world. Several times, Shinobu saw those who had fallen out of the group being ‘plundered.’

lines.japanese: 彼らが奪うものは、死肉ではなく不可視の何かだ。
lines.english: What they stole was not carrion, but something invisible.

lines.japanese:
虚勢、矜持、恐怖、苦痛……そういったものを貪
り食う時、伊勢崎宗多たちは獲物の心から漏れた何
かを食らっている。
lines.english: Bravado, pride, fear, pain… When Souta Isezaki and his pack gorged on such things, they were consuming something that leaked from their prey's hearts.

lines.japanese:
よく、いじめられる側には問題があると言われる。
　確かにその指摘は否定できない。
lines.english: People often say there is something wrong with the victim of bullying. It would be wrong to deny the point entirely.

lines.japanese:
だが問題の中には、生来の気性に属する部分も数
多く見られた。
lines.english: But many of those faults belonged to a person’s inborn temperament.

lines.japanese: 鈍重なことはそれだけで失笑の対象となる。
lines.english: Slowness alone was enough to invite derision.

lines.japanese:
身体的欠陥を突くことを子供は躊躇わない。
　声の甲高い男子はブザーのついた標的と変わりない。
lines.english: Children did not hesitate to attack physical defects. A boy with a high voice was little more than a target fitted with its own buzzer.

lines.japanese:
虚偽を吐き通す者は原始的な正義のもとに糾弾さ
れる。
lines.english: Those who persisted in lying were condemned in the name of primitive justice.

lines.japanese: 子供らは喜怒哀楽に感情移入しやすい。
lines.english: Children readily identified with feelings of joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure.

lines.japanese: 抑制のきかない精神は踏みとどまることができない。
lines.english: An unrestrained mind did not know how to stop.

lines.japanese:
閉鎖的な集団内では、大枠を外れたローカルルー
ルが発達するものだ。
lines.english: Within a closed group, local rules that stray beyond the larger framework tend to develop.

lines.japanese:
その中では一つの巨大な善悪が定められ、固着する。
　認知的な不協和を避けるため、正当化は著しい。
lines.english: Within it, a single monolithic standard of right and wrong takes root. To avoid cognitive dissonance, the group goes to extraordinary lengths to justify itself.

lines.japanese:
イジメられる側に問題がある。
　この論理は、彼らの良心の呵責を麻痺させる機能
を持つ。
lines.english: There is something wrong with the victim. That logic serves a purpose: it numbs the pangs of their conscience.

lines.japanese:
匿名のネットとは異なり、それは暗黙の了解事と
して醸成されていく。
lines.english: Unlike anonymous interactions online, it gradually hardened into a tacit understanding.

lines.japanese:
加えて、上に立つ人間は無意識にしろ意識的にし
ろ、人を扇動する術に長けている。
lines.english: Moreover, whether consciously or not, those who rise to the top are highly skilled at inciting others.

lines.japanese:
伊勢崎宗多は、知恵の働くタイプだった。
　集団の排他的な機能を制し、自らの快楽―――腹
を満たす。

lines.japanese:
確か隣のクラスである。

lines.japanese:
取り囲まれ、前後左右から飛んでくる蹴りを受け、

lines.japanese: 「きかない」と言っている。

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 「きかない」「きかない」「きかない」

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: （食ってる―――）

見ず知らずの人間のため、忍が払えるものはなか

同様の捕食光景を見ることが、何度かあった。

lines.japanese: いくつかの季節が過ぎていく。

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 衝撃だった。

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese: 魂は神聖不可侵。

lines.japanese:
この事実は、科学全盛の現代にあってなお色褪せ

lines.japanese:

lines.japanese:
忍もわざわざ苦労して、調べようとはしなかった。

幻滅するためにつまびらかにする必要はないと思

lines.japanese: 大切か、否か―――

lines.japanese: 太い息を落とす。

（ひとりぼっちの彼女のために、僕もひとりぼっち

lines.japanese: （それができるのか……？）

lines.japanese:
親友などいない。

そう、生理的嫌悪感だ。

（本堂沙也加が、僕を拒絶することだって、あるん

lines.japanese: そうなった時、清純無垢な心の行く果てを。

lines.japanese: 「沙也加だから、白くて柔らかいとは思うけど」
lines.english: “It's Sayaka, so pale and soft sounds about right.”
“…Hmph.”

lines.japanese:
葉子がたじろぐ。
　七人の力関係というのは、実は対等ではない。
lines.english: Youko faltered. The balance of power among the seven of them was not, in fact, equal.

lines.japanese:
年月によって築きあげられた相関関係図は、なか
なかに複雑なものがある。
lines.english: The relationship map built over the years was remarkably complicated.

lines.japanese: 「あれは白くて柔らかいですね」
lines.english: “That one is certainly pale and soft.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「……楽しみですか？」
lines.english: “…Are you looking forward to it?”

lines.japanese: 「……いや……どうだろう」
lines.english: “…No… I don't know.”

lines.japanese: 言えるか。
lines.english: As if he could say.

lines.japanese: 「仕方ないので、兄でも拾って兄ります」
lines.english: “I suppose I'll go pick up Bro and broceed.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「いつか沙也さん、半分ください」
lines.english: “Give me half of Saya someday.”

lines.japanese: 「ダ、ダメ」
lines.english: “N-No.”

lines.japanese:
教室の入口から、内側をうかがう。
　沙也加は自席に座って待機していた。
lines.english: He peered inside from the classroom door. Sayaka was sitting at her desk, waiting.

lines.japanese: （いたいた）
lines.english: (There she is.)

lines.japanese:
声をかけようとすると、彼女の方から顔を上げた。
　微笑。
lines.english: As he prepared to call out, she looked up first. A smile.

lines.japanese: 「お昼は？」
lines.english: “Have you eaten?”

lines.japanese: 「まだ」
lines.english: “Not yet.”

lines.japanese: 「ご一緒してもいい？」
lines.english: “May I join you?”

lines.japanese: 「誘いに来たんだよ」
lines.english: “I came to invite you.”

lines.japanese: 沙也加は花のようにほころぶ。
lines.english: Sayaka’s smile bloomed like a flower.

lines.japanese: 「さて、どうしようか。パンにする？」
lines.english: “Now, what should we do? Get some bread?”

lines.japanese: 「忍はごはんが良いんでしょう？」
lines.english: “You'd rather have rice, wouldn't you?”

lines.japanese: 「少なくなければ何でもいいよ」
lines.english: “Anything's fine as long as there's enough of it.”

lines.japanese: 「学食でいいわよ」
lines.english: “The cafeteria will do.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、じゃあ」
lines.english: “All right, then.”

lines.japanese:
学食では、忍はカレーを、沙也加はランチプレー
トを頼んだ。
lines.english: In the cafeteria, Shinobu ordered curry and Sayaka the lunch plate.

lines.japanese:
まだ時間が早いためか、混雑の度合いはそれほど
でもなかった。
lines.english: Perhaps because it was still early, the place was not particularly crowded.

lines.japanese: 沙也加が席を取り、忍が食事を運ぶ。
lines.english: Sayaka found a table while Shinobu carried over their food.

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese: 「いただきます」
lines.english: “Let's eat.”

lines.japanese:
律儀に告げて、二人は食器を手にした。
　燃費の悪い忍は、いつものことだが飢えていた。
lines.english: Having duly observed the formality, they took up their utensils. Shinobu, whose engine burned fuel at a dreadful rate, was hungry as ever.

lines.japanese:
学食のカレーは男子御用達の一品でもあるのか、
並でも量が多めになっている。
lines.english: The cafeteria curry must have been a staple among the boys, for even the regular serving was on the large side.

lines.japanese:
富士山の如く盛られた白米に、乱暴にぶちまけら
れたとろみのあるルーは、いかにも食欲をそそるの
だが……同じ理由で女子からは敬遠される。
lines.english: Thick roux had been slopped liberally over a Mount Fuji of white rice. It looked undeniably appetizing, yet… for the very same reason, the girls avoided it.

lines.japanese:
卓上に置かれた容器から、ほとんどカレー用と言
われる福神漬をひとつかみ、これを添える。
lines.english: From a container on the table he took a handful of sweet pickles— the condiment that seemed to exist almost solely for curry—and added them.

lines.japanese: それを忍はもりもりと食べはじめた。
lines.english: Then Shinobu began to shovel it down.

lines.japanese:
具などはほとんどなく、切れ端のような野菜が時
折浮かんでいる程度だ。
lines.english: There were almost no solid ingredients, merely the occasional scrap of vegetable floating to the surface.

lines.japanese:
味はレトルトと大差ない。辛味もほとんど感じる
ものではない。
lines.english: It tasted little different from packaged curry and had barely any heat.

lines.japanese: それを親の敵のように食う。
lines.english: He ate as if the curry had murdered his parents.

lines.japanese:
頬に詰めるだけ詰めて飲み込む、いわゆる子供食
いであるのだが、これは周囲でいくら諫めても直ら
なかった忍の悪癖である。
lines.english: He stuffed his cheeks to bursting, then swallowed—the way a child ate. It was a bad habit no amount of admonition from those around him had ever corrected.

lines.japanese: 夢中になりすぎるのだ。
lines.english: He always got too absorbed.

lines.japanese: 一方、沙也加の方は慎ましい。
lines.english: Sayaka, by contrast, was modesty itself.

lines.japanese:
顎の位置を変えもせず、箸にライスを小振りにか
ためて口に運ぶ。
lines.english: Without so much as shifting her chin, she gathered a dainty portion of rice between her chopsticks and carried it to her mouth.

lines.japanese:
千里の道も一歩からと言うが、膳をあける頃には
さぞかし血糖値も上がっていることだろう。
lines.english: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. By the time she cleared her plate, her blood sugar would surely have risen.

lines.japanese: 忍が席を立つ。
lines.english: Shinobu stood.

lines.japanese: 沙也加は気にも止めない。いつものことだ。
lines.english: Sayaka paid no attention. This was nothing unusual.

lines.japanese:
戻ってくる。
　二杯目のカレーに忍は挑みかかっていく。
lines.english: He returned. Shinobu attacked his second plate of curry.

lines.japanese:
性質こそ違うものの、二人は黙々と食事を続けた。
　沙也加が食べ終わる頃、ちょうど忍も三杯目をた
いらげて昼食を終えた。
lines.english: Different though their ways of eating were, the two continued in silence. Just as Sayaka finished, Shinobu polished off his third helping and concluded his lunch.

lines.japanese: 息のあった二人である。
lines.english: They made a perfectly synchronized pair.

lines.japanese: 「風にでも当たる？」
lines.english: “Want to get some air?”

lines.japanese:
話しかけるために沙也加に目をやると、小さな
リンゴが差し出されていた。
lines.english: When he looked toward Sayaka to speak, she was holding out a small apple.

lines.japanese: 「これは？」
lines.english: “What's this?”

lines.japanese:
「親戚が送ってきたものなのだけど、可愛かったか
　らそのまま」
lines.english: “A relative sent them. This one was so cute that I left it whole.”

lines.japanese: 手の器にすっぽりと収まった、小振りなリンゴだ。
lines.english: A little apple, nestled neatly in the bowl of her palm.

lines.japanese: 「嫌い？」
lines.english: “Don't you like them?”

lines.japanese: 「愛してる」
lines.english: “I love them.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「ありがたくいただきます」
lines.english: “Then I'll gratefully accept it.”

lines.japanese: 受け取ったリンゴを、そのまま囓った。
lines.english: He took the apple and bit straight into it.

lines.japanese: 「うまい、なんじゃこりゃ……」
lines.english: “Delicious. What is this…?”

lines.japanese: 忍の知るリンゴではなかった。
lines.english: It was no apple Shinobu had ever known.

lines.japanese:
「詳しくはないけれど、結構なものらしいわね。一個
　１０００円とかなんとか」
lines.english: “I don't know much about them, but apparently they're quite special. A thousand yen apiece, or something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「うまい、うますぎる」
lines.english: “It's good. Too good.”

lines.japanese: 「おおげさね。普通のリンゴよ」
lines.english: “You're exaggerating. It's an ordinary apple.”

lines.japanese: 「食べたことないの？」
lines.english: “You've never had a different kind?”

lines.japanese: 「それ以外のリンゴは食べたことがないわね」
lines.english: “I don't think I've ever eaten any apples but those.”

lines.japanese: 「そういえば」
lines.english: “Now that you mention it.”
(Milady—)

lines.japanese:
眩暈。
　気が付けば、ガリガリにやせ細ったリンゴの芯を、
カレーの皿に落としていた。
lines.english: Vertigo. The next thing he knew, he was dropping the apple's gaunt, emaciated core onto his curry plate.

lines.japanese: 「……ごちそうさま」
lines.english: “…Thank you for the meal.”

lines.japanese: 「屋上？」
lines.english: “The roof?”

lines.japanese: 先ほどの忍の意向を持ち出して、沙也加。
lines.english: Sayaka picked up Shinobu's earlier suggestion.

lines.japanese: 「うん、行こうか」
lines.english: “Yeah. Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「……寝そう」
lines.english: “…I might fall asleep.”

lines.japanese: 「ダメよ」
lines.english: “Don't.”

lines.japanese: 「昼寝すると、効率がいいんだよ？」
lines.english: “A nap makes you more efficient, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「風邪をひくでしょ」
lines.english: “You'll catch cold.”

lines.japanese: 「へーい」
lines.english: “Yes, ma'am.”

lines.japanese: しばらく無言で風に当たる。
lines.english: For a while, they stood in silence and let the wind play over them.

lines.japanese: 「……墓参り、本当に行ってもいいの？」
lines.english: “…Are you sure it's all right for me to visit the grave?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「でもあの場所は……沙也加の場所だ」
lines.english: “But that place… belongs to you.”

lines.japanese: 「最初に見付けただけで、私の場所ではないわ」
lines.english: “I merely found it first. It doesn't belong to me.”

lines.japanese: 「権利とか、そういうことじゃなくてさ」
lines.english: “I don't mean ownership or anything like that.”

lines.japanese:
「あそこは沙也加の、心の一部みたいなところなの
　かなと思ってたから」
lines.english: “I thought that place might be something like a part of your heart.”

lines.japanese: 彼方の空を眺めながら言う。
lines.english: He spoke while gazing into the distant sky.

lines.japanese: 「あの場所のこと、気付いていたのね」
lines.english: “So you had noticed.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、まあ」
lines.english: “Well, yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「……未練たらしいと思う？」
lines.english: “…Do you think I'm clinging to the past?”

lines.japanese: 「思わないけど、未練はあっても良いと思う」
lines.english: “No. But even if you are, I don't think that's wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「僕が勝手に、君に踏み込んだわけなんだから」
lines.english: “I'm the one who barged into your life.”

lines.japanese: 「納得の行くまで、考えるといいよ」
lines.english: “Think about it until you're satisfied.”

lines.japanese: 「一生、考え込むかもしれない」
lines.english: “I may spend my whole life thinking.”

lines.japanese: 「一生、か」
lines.english: “Your whole life…”

lines.japanese: 「ま、それが良い時間であるならいいじゃないか」
lines.english: “Well, if it's time well spent, what's wrong with that?”

lines.japanese: 「それだと、忍に何も返せないわね」
lines.english: “Then I could never give you anything in return.”

lines.japanese: 「返す？」
lines.english: “In return?”

lines.japanese: 「気持ちを返せない」
lines.english: “I couldn't return the feeling.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 眉間にしわを寄せた。
lines.english: He knitted his brow.

lines.japanese: 「そばにいてくれれば、それでいいんだけどね」
lines.english: “All I need is for you to stay beside me.”

lines.japanese: 「遠くに行かれると、困る」
lines.english: “I'd be in trouble if you went far away.”

lines.japanese: 「忍は、強引よね」
lines.english: “You're pushy, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “I am.”

lines.japanese: 「強引だわ」
lines.english: “Very pushy.”

lines.japanese: 「イエス」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 悪戯心が沸いた。
lines.english: A mischievous thought came to him.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ強引ついでに、膝でも借りようかな」
lines.english: “Then, while I'm being pushy, perhaps I'll borrow your lap.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 横倒しになって沙也加の膝に頭を乗せた。
lines.english: He tipped sideways and laid his head in Sayaka's lap.
“…Wait…!”

lines.japanese: 「気持ちいい」
lines.english: “This is nice.”

lines.japanese:
幸せそうな顔に、沙也加は仕方ないという風に嘆
息した。
lines.english: At his blissful expression, Sayaka gave a sigh of helpless resignation.

lines.japanese: 「寝たら、いけないわよ」
lines.english: “You mustn't fall asleep.”

lines.japanese: 母親の仕草で、忍の頬を撫でた。
lines.english: She stroked Shinobu's cheek in a motherly gesture.

lines.japanese:
連れだって学校を出て、寄り道もせずにいつもの
ルートを辿る。
lines.english: They left school together and followed their usual route without taking any detours.

lines.japanese:
しかし工場には立ち寄らず、道を逸れて荒れ放題
の樹林に入る。
lines.english: But they did not stop at the factory. Instead, they left the road and entered a wild, neglected wood.

lines.japanese: 色濃い緑の空気を吸いながら、奥へ奥へと向かう。
lines.english: Breathing the deep green air, they pressed farther and farther in.

lines.japanese:
陽光が遮られて次第に薄暗くなっていく風景。
　それは一歩一歩、森の中心に近づいていることを
示している。
lines.english: The sunlight was shut out; the landscape steadily darkened. With every step, it told them that they were drawing nearer the heart of the woods.

lines.japanese:
弾んだ会話もなく黙然と二人は歩いた。
　そして、その場所に出た―――
lines.english: Without any lively conversation, the two walked in silence. And then they emerged into that place—

lines.japanese:
森の命は、天地にわかたれている。
　豊穣の大地と、青々と繁った樹冠部。
lines.english: The life of the forest is divided between earth and heaven: the fertile soil and the luxuriant green canopy.

lines.japanese:
そこには無数のバクテリアを底辺とした、様々な
小生命が息を潜めるように命を消費しているのだ。
lines.english: There, countless forms of tiny life, with numberless bacteria at their base, spent their lives as if holding their breath.

lines.japanese: 土中のものたちは光をそれほど必要とはしない。
lines.english: The creatures beneath the soil have little need of light.

lines.japanese:
だから奥深い場所では、樹葉が大半の光を収奪す
る、小暗い世界であったとしても機能上問題はない。
　その点で、森の中央は異質な空間だった。
lines.english: Thus, in the depths, the leaves may seize nearly all the light and leave behind a dim world without impairing the forest's function. In that respect, its center is an alien space.

lines.japanese:
切り取られたように樹頭部に穴が開き、光が降り
注いでいる。
lines.english: A hole seemed to have been cut from the crowns overhead, and light poured through.

lines.japanese:
その恩恵を一身に受けているのは、ねじ曲がった
古木だ。
lines.english: One twisted old tree received the whole of that blessing.

lines.japanese: 見るからに、古い樹木である。
lines.english: It was visibly ancient.

lines.japanese:
幹は太いばかりかねじ曲がっており、四肢たる枝
を蔦として周囲の若木に伸ばし、絡めている。
lines.english: The trunk was not only thick but contorted; its limb-like branches reached into the young trees around it like vines and entwined them.

lines.japanese: 引き立てられた老人のようにも見えた。
lines.english: It resembled an old man being hauled away.

lines.japanese: 「…………長老さん」
lines.english: “……The Elder.”

lines.japanese: 「そう言われているの？」
lines.english: “Is that what people call it?”

lines.japanese: 忍は頷いた。
lines.english: Shinobu nodded.

lines.japanese: 「知らなかったわ」
lines.english: “I didn't know.”

lines.japanese: 「不思議な木だ」
lines.english: “It's a strange tree.”

lines.japanese: 「子供の頃に見つけたの」
lines.english: “I found it when I was a child.”

lines.japanese: 「当時から、この姿だったわ」
lines.english: “It looked just like this even then.”

lines.japanese:
「そうだろうね。これほどの木だと、１０や２０の
　年月では、何も変わらないはずだよ」
lines.english: “I'm sure it did. A tree like this wouldn't change in a mere ten or twenty years.”

lines.japanese:
沙也加は根元にしゃがみ込んだ。
　老木のふもとには、古びた板きれが刺さっている。
lines.english: Sayaka crouched beside its roots. At the foot of the old tree, a weathered scrap of board protruded from the soil.

lines.japanese: 「ここに、埋めたの」
lines.english: “I buried it here.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「落ち着いた場所だと思うよ」
lines.english: “It's a peaceful place.”

lines.japanese:
「……あの頃は、ついこの間のことなのにひどく懐
　かしくて、嬉しかった」
lines.english: “…It was only a short time ago, yet it already felt so nostalgic. I was happy.”

lines.japanese:
「孤独は私を傷つけなかったけれど、心の循環から
　外れた私は滋養を得ることはできず、摩耗してい
　く自分を予見してきた」
lines.english: “Solitude did not wound me. But cut off from the circulation of other hearts, I received no nourishment, and I foresaw myself being worn away.”

lines.japanese: 「丘に打ち上げられた魚が過ごす最期の時のように」
lines.english: “Like a fish washed up on a hill, living out its final moments.”

lines.japanese:
「友達が欲しかったわけじゃない。必要だったわけ
　でもない」
lines.english: “It wasn't that I wanted friends. Nor that I needed them.”

lines.japanese:
「でも……この体は社会を必要としていて、人並み
　に疲れもしたし脆く壊れることもあった」
lines.english: “But… this body needed society. It tired like anyone else's, and sometimes it proved fragile enough to break.”

lines.japanese: 「社会に身を置くしかなかった」
lines.english: “I had no choice but to live in society.”

lines.japanese:
「その中で、私はいつか訪れる、周囲の圧力との葛藤
　の時を待っていた」
lines.english: “And there, I waited for the inevitable hour when I would come into conflict with the pressure around me.”

lines.japanese: 「魔女と言われていたこと？」
lines.english: “When they called you a witch?”

lines.japanese: 「適切な表現だわ」
lines.english: “An apt expression.”

lines.japanese:
「異物に対する攻撃は避けられない。予定されたそ
　の時が、私が削れ果てる瞬間だった」
lines.english: “An attack on the foreign body was unavoidable. That appointed hour would be the moment I was finally ground away.”

lines.japanese: 「きっと凄惨なものになる」
lines.english: “It would surely be something horrific.”

lines.japanese: 「異端者と、まっとうな人々の対立」
lines.english: “A clash between the heretic and ordinary, decent people.”

lines.japanese:
「いずれ殺しあう誰かと仲良くはできなかったし、
　したいとも思わなかった」
lines.english: “I couldn't befriend people I would one day kill or be killed by, nor did I wish to.”

lines.japanese:
「私の魂は、本当は他者を必要としない何かに、生
　まれつくべきだったのかも知れない」
lines.english: “Perhaps my soul should have been born into something that had no need of others.”

lines.japanese: 「忍は、そんなことを考えたことはある？」
lines.english: “Have you ever thought anything like that, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「……いつも考えてる」
lines.english: “…All the time.”

lines.japanese: 力無く、それでいて投げやりではない忍の言葉。
lines.english: His words were faint, but neither careless nor resigned.

lines.japanese:
「僕は子供の頃、灰色の青春を過ごしたクチだか
　らね」
lines.english: “My childhood years were pretty gray.”

lines.japanese: 「人間性とか、身につけ損なってた」
lines.english: “I never managed to acquire things like humanity.”

lines.japanese:
「友達のこととか、人と人の触れあいのこととか、
　疎かった」
lines.english: “I knew little about friends, or about contact between one person and another.”

lines.japanese: 「いろいろ、唐突だったでしょ？」
lines.english: “I was abrupt about so many things, wasn't I?”

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “You were.”

lines.japanese:
「あんな事務的に友達になってくれと言われたのは、
　はじめてだわ」
lines.english: “No one had ever asked me to be their friend in such a businesslike fashion.”

lines.japanese: 「面目ない」
lines.english: “Not my finest hour.”

lines.japanese: や
lines.english: act

lines.japanese: 「最近は、うまく演れているみたいね」
lines.english: “You seem to be playing the part well these days.”

lines.japanese: 「おかげさまで」
lines.english: “Thanks to all of you.”

lines.japanese:
「でも、皆にはばれてるから、本当、体面だけだね。
　飾りだ」
lines.english: “But everyone sees through it, so it's purely for appearances. Decoration.”

lines.japanese:
と忍は微笑むでもなく告げた。
　口調は淡々として、抑揚もなく、魂の欠けた人形
を思わせた。
lines.english: Shinobu said it without a smile. His flat, uninflected tone called to mind a doll without a soul.

lines.japanese:
人間味のないものを非とする思想に絡めなければ、
この上なく自然だった。
lines.english: Divorced from the belief that anything inhuman must be wrong, it sounded perfectly natural.

lines.japanese:
「それでも、私にはできないことを忍はよくやって
　いるわ……」
lines.english: “Even so, you manage to do many things that I cannot do…”

lines.japanese:
「さっきの話だけど……沙也加は何に生まれたかっ
　たの？」
lines.english: “About what you said earlier… What would you have wanted to be born as?”

lines.japanese:
「生まれたかったわけではないけど、適切だと思っ
　たのは木かしらね」
lines.english: “I wouldn’t say I wanted to be born as a tree, but I thought it might be a fitting form.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese:
「木は心象領域において常に一人だわ。静的にシス
　テムに組み込まれ、自由な思想が許される」
lines.english: “Within the mental-image domain, a tree is always alone. It is statically incorporated into a system and allowed freedom of thought.”

lines.japanese:
「もっとも彼らの心のほとんどは、ごくごく小さな
　火花のような刹那的なものだけれど」
lines.english: “Though most of their minds are momentary things, like the tiniest sparks.”

lines.japanese: 「その長老さんはどうなの？」
lines.english: “And what about the Elder?”

lines.japanese: 「からっぽよ」
lines.english: “Empty.”

lines.japanese: 節くれ立った幹に手を触れる。
lines.english: She laid a hand on the gnarled trunk.

lines.japanese: 「大きな空間があるけど、そこに生きた魂はない」
lines.english: “There is a vast space inside, but no living soul inhabits it.”

lines.japanese: 「抜け殻か」
lines.english: “A husk?”

lines.japanese: 「どうかしら？」
lines.english: “I wonder.”

lines.japanese: 「私もこれが何だったのか、知らないの」
lines.english: “I don't know what this used to be, either.”

lines.japanese: 「そう感じるだけだから」
lines.english: “That's only how it feels to me.”

lines.japanese:
忍は大樹を見やった。
　見るからに、大木は魂を失っているようだった。
lines.english: Shinobu looked up at the great tree. Even to the eye, it seemed to have lost its soul.

lines.japanese:
王は魂を持たない。
　王は統治者としての機能が全てであり、人格は必
要とされない。
lines.english: A king has no soul. A king is nothing but the function of governance; no personhood is required.

lines.japanese: 「終わってしまった未来、か」
lines.english: “A future already ended, huh.”

lines.japanese: 「それは？」
lines.english: “What do you mean?”

lines.japanese:
「いや、沙也加のさっきの言葉からの連想なんだけ
　ど」
lines.english: “Nothing. It just occurred to me because of what you said before.”

lines.japanese:
「自分の行く末が明確に見えているということは、
　人を急速に老成させるのかなと思ったんだ」
lines.english: “I wondered whether seeing your own future clearly makes you mature very quickly.”

lines.japanese:
「それが漠然とした不安だったのなら、人は足掻こ
　うとするだろうし」
lines.english: “If it were only some vague dread, a person might try to struggle against it.”

lines.japanese:
「それでも私のは推計に過ぎないわ。あなたの言う、
　漠然とした不安と同種のものだもの」
lines.english: “Mine is still only an estimate. It is the same kind of thing as the vague dread you describe.”

lines.japanese:
「私が確信できるのは、自分が一人で成立するとい
　うことと……そんな人間が社会で暮らせば、いつ
　か破綻してしまうということだけ」
lines.english: “All I can be certain of is that I am complete by myself… and that if someone like me lives in society, sooner or later they will break down.”

lines.japanese:
「運が良ければ、何者にもならずに死ぬまで生きる
　か」
lines.english: “With luck, you might live until you die without ever becoming anything.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、そういうことだと思う」
lines.english: “Yes. I think that is what it means.”

lines.japanese: （……終わってしまった未来―――）
lines.english: (…A future already ended—)

lines.japanese:
心には針の痛み。
　忍を諦念の墓穴に落とし込もうとする。
　そんな誘惑と、ずっと戦ってきたのだ。
lines.english: A needle pierced his heart. The temptation threatened to cast Shinobu into a grave of resignation. He had long fought that temptation.

lines.japanese:
「もし世界で自分一人だけだったら、忍はどうする
　の？」
lines.english: “What would you do if you were the only person in the world, Shinobu?”

lines.japanese: 「難しいね」
lines.english: “That's difficult.”

lines.japanese: 「でも僕だったら……歩くかな」
lines.english: “But if it were me… I think I'd walk.”

lines.japanese: 「外に向かう？」
lines.english: “Outward?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだね。どこかに生きている人がいるかも知れ
　ない」
lines.english: “Yes. There might be someone alive somewhere.”

lines.japanese: 「捜す」
lines.english: “I'd search.”

lines.japanese:
「大地が宇宙ほどにも広くて、忍には二本の足しか
　与えられなかったら？」
lines.english: “What if the earth were as vast as the universe, and you had been given only two feet?”

lines.japanese: 「たぶん僕の行動は徒労に終わるね」
lines.english: “My efforts would probably come to nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「それでも歩くの？」
lines.english: “And you'd keep walking anyway?”

lines.japanese:
「今の回答はね、自己規定をしているだけのものな
　んだ」
lines.english: “That answer was nothing more than self-definition.”

lines.japanese:
「僕の内面を観察して、そういう資質が立ち現れて
　くるわけじゃない。別に自賛しているわけでもな
　いし、性質の問題ではないんだ」
lines.english: “It isn't as though I look within and find that quality waiting. I'm not praising myself, either. It isn't a matter of temperament.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は、プロープ（調査機）のようなものだ」
lines.english: “I'm something like a probe—an instrument of investigation.”

lines.japanese:
「個人の喜びのために人を捜すのではなく、という
　こと」
lines.english: “Meaning you wouldn't be searching for people to make yourself happy.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。誉められた動機じゃないよ」
lines.english: “Right. There's nothing admirable about that motive.”

lines.japanese: 「自動的に生きてるようなものだ」
lines.english: “I live more or less automatically.”

lines.japanese:
「何が良くて悪いのか、人はすでにある何かに従っ
　て生きるけど……僕らはそこから自力で決めてい
　かないといけない」
lines.english: “Most people live by standards that already exist, standards that tell them good from bad… But we have to decide even that for ourselves.”

lines.japanese:
「でもいくら考えても、最後には合理的な結論以外
　を選べなくなってしまう」
lines.english: “No matter how long we think about it, eventually we're left unable to choose anything but the rational conclusion.”
“…Yes.”

lines.japanese:
「僕が今やっていることは、そんな理不尽に対する
　反抗なのだと思う」
lines.english: “I think what I'm doing now is my way of rebelling against that absurdity.”

lines.japanese:
「でも頑張って、心を学んでいるよ。身に付かない
　ことはわかっているけど」
lines.english: “Still, I'm doing my best to learn the ways of the heart, even though I know they'll never truly take root in me.”

lines.japanese: ここばかりは表情に微笑を浮かべた。
lines.english: Only then did he smile.

lines.japanese: 「沙也加はどう？」
lines.english: “What about you, Sayaka?”

lines.japanese: 「私はかなりの確率で、内に向かうと思う」
lines.english: “I think there's a good chance I would turn inward.”

lines.japanese:
「部屋に閉じこもるように、自らの内面だけで生き
　ると思う」
lines.english: “I think I would live entirely within my own mind, as though shutting myself away in a room.”

lines.japanese: 「肉体が死ぬまで―――」
lines.english: “Until my body died—”

lines.japanese:
「一人だけが存在するということは、自我と世界が
　同じサイズになるということだと思う」
lines.english: “If only one person exists, I think the self and the world become the same size.”

lines.japanese:
「有効射程は認知限界までだけれど、定義としては
　そうなる」
lines.english: “Its effective range ends at the limits of perception, but by definition, that's what happens.”

lines.japanese: 「結局は、自分の内面を旅しているのと変わらない」
lines.english: “In the end, it's no different from traveling through your own mind.”

lines.japanese:
「その意味で、僕も君も、不変の結果に至る同種の
　ものなのかもね」
lines.english: “In that sense, perhaps you and I are the same kind of being, destined for the same unchanging end.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「それは慰めの言葉だから」
lines.english: “Because those are words of comfort.”

lines.japanese:
「徒労に近い可能性に身を置くあなたと、最初から
　諦める私は、大きく価値を異にするのよ」
lines.english: “You choose to live within a possibility that is nearly hopeless. I give up before I even begin. The two of us are not remotely equal in worth.”

lines.japanese:
「価値は結果によって算出されるよ。だから結末が
　同じなら、そんな差をつける必要はないって」
lines.english: “Worth is measured by results. If we arrive at the same end, there's no need to say one of us is worth more.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたは、そうやって私と同じだって言うけれ
　ど……」
lines.english: “You keep saying that you and I are the same, but…”

lines.japanese: 沙也加の背が小さく感じられた。
lines.english: Her back looked very small.

lines.japanese:
「君が、本堂沙也加が、この世にいてくれて良かっ
　たと思ってる」
lines.english: “I'm glad you—Sayaka Hondou—exist in this world.”

lines.japanese: 「本当は、似て非なるものなのかも知れないのに？」
lines.english: “Even if we only look alike and are fundamentally different?”

lines.japanese:
「……たった一人の異性と出会えば、惹かれあうの
　が普通だ」
lines.english: “…If a man and a woman were the only two people alive and met each other, it would be natural for them to be drawn together.”

lines.japanese:
「そういう資質が備わっているし、仮に嫌いな相手
　であっても条件さえ整えば好きになることができ
　る分泌系の機能を持ってる」
lines.english: “We have that capacity built into us. Under the right conditions, the endocrine system can make us like even someone we hate.”

lines.japanese:
「ホルモンや心理的錯覚で人を好きになるというの
　は、皆がそうしていることだけど、口にしてしま
　うととても虚しいことだ」
lines.english: “Everyone falls for people because of hormones and psychological illusions. It only sounds terribly hollow when you say it aloud.”

lines.japanese: 「でも反対に、とても自然なことでもある」
lines.english: “On the other hand, it's also entirely natural.”

lines.japanese:
「そんな魂の神聖不可侵な面さえ否定された世界で、
　人として立ち向かう方法があるとすれば……それ
　は、自己規定しかありえない」
lines.english: “In a world that denied even that sacred, inviolable dimension of the soul, if there were any way to stand against it as a human being… it would have to be self-definition.”

lines.japanese:
「僕のことで言えば、外に向かって旅をはじめるのも
　そう決めているだけのことで、可能性に期待しての
　ことではないところがひどく非人間的に思える」
lines.english: “For me, even setting out into the world is nothing more than a decision I made, not an act of hope in what might be possible. And that seems terribly inhuman.”

lines.japanese:
「外か、内か。この選択は、僕や沙也加みたいな孤
　人には、どちらでも同じなんじゃないかな？」
lines.english: “Outward or inward—for solitary beings like you and me, don't both choices amount to the same thing?”

lines.japanese: 「そうかも……」
lines.english: “Perhaps…”

lines.japanese:
「だから、好きになりたいと決めたのかな、
　僕は―――」
lines.english: “Maybe that's why I decided I wanted to love someone. Why I—”

lines.japanese: 沙也加は抱えた膝に唇を押し当て、甘く震えた。
lines.english: Sayaka pressed her lips to her drawn-up knees, and a sweet tremor ran through her.
“…I see…”

lines.japanese: ずいぶんと時間を置いてから忍は声をかけた。
lines.english: Only after a long while did Shinobu speak again.

lines.japanese: 「いい場所だね」
lines.english: “This is a nice place.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese:
「でも……今朝はああ言ったけど、僕を連れてこな
　くても良かったんだよ」
lines.english: “But… whatever I said this morning, you didn't have to bring me here.”

lines.japanese:
「ここが君の聖域であるなら、無理に汚染しようと
　は思わないし」
lines.english: “If this is your sanctuary, I wouldn't try to force my way in and contaminate it.”

lines.japanese:
「この子たちは、あなたの友達でもあったのでしょ
　う？」
lines.english: “These little ones were your friends as well, weren't they?”
“…I suppose.”

lines.japanese: 「ならここに来る権利があるわ」
lines.english: “Then you have the right to come here.”

lines.japanese:
不意に思い出すのだ。
　幼かったあの頃、忍の周囲を踏みならした、あの
小さな友人たちの姿を。
lines.english: Without warning, he remembered. The little friends who had once trampled the earth around him when he was a child.

lines.japanese: そして彼女の笑顔の光景を―――
lines.english: And the sight of her smile—

lines.japanese:
「何をするのでも、そこに意味を見いださないと、
　私は怠惰になるの」
lines.english: “Unless I can find meaning in what I'm doing, I grow lazy.”

lines.japanese: 「無駄なことには少し抵抗があるの」
lines.english: “I have a little trouble with pointless things.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、よくわかるよ」
lines.english: “Yes. I understand that very well.”

lines.japanese: 「昔の君は、そんな感じだった」
lines.english: “You were like that, back then.”

lines.japanese:
沙也加の呼吸に、かすかな乱れが生じた。
　言うべきか否かの心理的闘争に、彼女が勝利した
のか敗北したのかはわからない。
lines.english: A faint hitch entered Sayaka's breathing. He could not tell whether she had won or lost the private battle over whether to speak.

lines.japanese: ただ沙也加は口に出した。
lines.english: But in the end, she did.

lines.japanese: 「……今も本質は同じとは思わないの？」
lines.english: “…Don't you think I'm still the same at heart?”

lines.japanese:
「あなたと友好を結んで、今こうして穏やかに生き
　ている」
lines.english: “I became your friend, and now I live this peaceful life.”

lines.japanese: 「だけどこれは仮の姿かも知れない」
lines.english: “But perhaps this is only a temporary guise.”

lines.japanese:
それは冴えた知性を持った少女にしては、あまり
にも不利益な発言なのではないかなと忍は感じた。
lines.english: For a girl as intelligent as Sayaka, Shinobu thought, that was a remarkably self-defeating thing to say.
“…Temporary.”

lines.japanese:
「破局から逃れるため、忍のことを利用しているの
　かも知れない」
lines.english: “I may only be using you to escape my own collapse.”

lines.japanese:
沙也加の場所への侵入を許した。
　事前に警戒を促すような発言。
lines.english: She had allowed him into the place that was hers. This was a warning given in advance.

lines.japanese:
停滞という神棚に供えられた二人の関係が、ゆっ
くりと変化していく気配が漂った。
　沙也加の意志がそうした。
lines.english: Their relationship, laid as an offering on the altar of stasis, now carried the first suggestion of slow change. Sayaka's will had set it in motion.

lines.japanese:
緑したたる森の香気に意図的に織り交ぜられた異
臭めいた空気に、どう反応して良いのかしばし迷う。
lines.english: For a moment, he did not know how to respond to that trace of something foul, deliberately threaded through the lush green scent of the forest.

lines.japanese: 「……今の毎日は嫌い？」
lines.english: “…Do you dislike the life we have now?”

lines.japanese: 「穏やかだわ」
lines.english: “It is peaceful.”

lines.japanese: 「なら」
lines.english: “Then—”

lines.japanese:
「……元々誰かを必要としたわけじゃないの。演じ
　ているに過ぎないのよ」
lines.english: “…I never needed anyone in the first place. All I am doing is playing a role.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたと同じように」
lines.english: “Just as you are.”

lines.japanese: 「でもあなたと私は、やはり違うような気がするの」
lines.english: “And yet I still feel that you and I are different.”

lines.japanese:
「嫌いなわけない。でも、この好きという感情さえ、
　あなたは―――」
lines.english: “It isn't that I dislike it. But even this feeling I call love… You—”

lines.japanese: 「……それを言われると、つらいな」
lines.english: “…That's hard to hear.”

lines.japanese: 「忍もそのことで苦しんでいるのはわかる」
lines.english: “I know this causes you pain too.”

lines.japanese: 土をさらい、指先ですり潰す。
lines.english: She raked up a little soil and ground it between her fingertips.

lines.japanese:
「何が正しいのか私にはわからない。善悪には頼れ
　ない。あなたが自分を取り決める理由はよくわか
　る」
lines.english: “I don't know what is right. I can't rely on good and evil. I understand very well why you choose to define yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「依存してしまえば思考停止でしかない」
lines.english: “If I relied on them, I would only be surrendering thought.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたにとっての私は、それでいいの？」
lines.english: “Is it all right with you for me to be that way?”

lines.japanese: 忍の顔は悲しげに歪む。
lines.english: Shinobu's face twisted in sorrow.

lines.japanese: 「もし」
lines.english: “Suppose…”

lines.japanese:
「もし、私があなたと同様、意志の力で自らを規定
　をしたとしたら……たまたま内ではなく、外に向
　かうことを決めたとしたら―――そこは地獄よ」
lines.english: “Suppose, like you, I defined myself by sheer force of will… Suppose that instead of turning inward, I happened to choose the world outside— it would be hell.”

lines.japanese:
「一度、心を失った私のすることは、おそらく際限
　がない」
lines.english: “Once I had lost my heart, there would probably be no limit to what I could do.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたから外れた途端に、境界線を乗り越えるこ
　とになる」
lines.english: “The instant I came loose from you, I would cross the line.”

lines.japanese: 「そして……そこが私の終わり。私の果て」
lines.english: “And… that would be my end. My farthest reach.”

lines.japanese: 「葛藤は私を抑圧してくれるのよ、忍」
lines.english: “My inner conflict gives me the oppression I need, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
「そして抑圧は私という形を保たせる。果てがやっ
　てくるその時まで」
lines.english: “And that oppression preserves the shape I have, until the moment my end comes.”

lines.japanese: 「それはある意味、自然なことではあった」
lines.english: “In one sense, it was only natural.”

lines.japanese: 忍は無言のまま佇んでいる。
lines.english: Shinobu remained standing in silence.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ」
lines.english: “Listen.”

lines.japanese: 求愛するような沙也加の声。
lines.english: Her voice sounded almost like a lover's appeal.

lines.japanese: 「私に自由を与えないで」
lines.english: “Do not give me freedom.”

lines.japanese: 「自由意志は私にとって害毒にしかならない」
lines.english: “Free will would be nothing but poison to me.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……」
lines.english: “But that's…”

lines.japanese: 「そこで悩むのが、いかにも忍らしいわ」
lines.english: “It's so like you to hesitate over that.”

lines.japanese:
小さく笑う。
　風。深刻な空気が吹き払われる。
lines.english: She gave a little laugh. A gust of wind blew away the gravity in the air.

lines.japanese: 「沙也加は、そうした方がいい？」
lines.english: “Would that be better for you?”

lines.japanese: 「嫌ではないと思うわ」
lines.english: “I don't think I would mind.”

lines.japanese:
「人は誰もが自由を望むけど、本当に他者や外部か
　らの干渉を一切受けないそれに……耐えられる人間
　はいないわ」
lines.english: “Everyone desires freedom, but no human being can endure true freedom—utterly untouched by other people or the outside world.”

lines.japanese: 「一人になるのがこわいの？」
lines.english: “Are you afraid to be alone?”

lines.japanese: 「こわくはないけれど……」
lines.english: “I'm not afraid, but…”

lines.japanese: 「僕もいる。みんなも。だから一人にはならない」
lines.english: “I'm here. So is everyone else. You won't be alone.”

lines.japanese:
「もし……私たちが対等に向かい合った時、あなた
　を抑圧と感じてしまうかも知れない」
lines.english: “If… you and I ever faced each other as equals, I might begin to feel that you were oppressing me.”

lines.japanese: 「それが君を沙也加たらしめるってさっき？」
lines.english: “Is that what you meant before? That oppression is what makes you Sayaka?”

lines.japanese:
「抑圧によって保たれた私は、いつか必ず果てを呼
　ぶとも言ったわ」
lines.english: “I also said that a self held together by oppression would, one day, inevitably call its own end into being.”
“Oh…”

lines.japanese:
忍はようやく理解した。
　彼女の二律背反めいた思い煩いを。
lines.english: At last, Shinobu understood the seeming contradiction that had been tormenting her.

lines.japanese:
「私は怒りっぽいの。自分でも制御できなくなると
　きが危険だわ」
lines.english: “I have a temper. It becomes dangerous when I can't control myself.”

lines.japanese:
「……その資質が、沙也加の成立には有用なのかも
　知れない。否定しきれないね」
lines.english: “…Perhaps that quality helps make you who you are. I can’t dismiss the possibility.”

lines.japanese: 「今が決して嫌ではない」
lines.english: “I don't dislike what we have now.”

lines.japanese:
「むしろ好きよ。だけれど……明日も好きとは限ら
　ない」
lines.english: “If anything, I like it. But… I may not like it tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「色褪せたものと感じてしまうかも知れない」
lines.english: “It may seem faded to me.”

lines.japanese: 「でも……忍がその気なら……私は……」
lines.english: “But… if you mean it… then I…”

lines.japanese: 「君を奴隷のようにしろって言うの？」
lines.english: “You're asking me to make you my slave?”

lines.japanese:
「羽虫を美しいと思うなら、琥珀に閉じこめなけれ
　ばならない」
lines.english: “If you find a gnat beautiful, you must seal it in amber.”

lines.japanese: 「美しかった時の記憶にだって価値があるよ」
lines.english: “The memory of its beauty has value too.”

lines.japanese: 「朽ちる瞬間をあなたは見ていられるの？」
lines.english: “Could you bear to watch it decay?”

lines.japanese:
長い沈黙が落ちてきた。
　はっきりと否定することはできなかった。
lines.english: A long silence fell. He could not give her a clear denial.

lines.japanese:
「……でもそれは、僕にとっては少し寂しいことだ
　よ」
lines.english: “…But that would be a little lonely for me.”

lines.japanese: 「そうね……」
lines.english: “Yes…”

lines.japanese:
「結局、あなたがしていることも、私がしたことも
　……同じなのよ」
lines.english: “In the end, what you're doing and what I did are… the same.”

lines.japanese: 「でも私は失った」
lines.english: “But I lost them.”

lines.japanese: 「失って、かわりにあなたがあらわれた」
lines.english: “I lost them, and you appeared in their place.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたには、誰かがあらわれてくれる？」
lines.english: “Will someone appear for you in turn?”

lines.japanese: 「……その連鎖は僕で最後なんだ」
lines.english: “…That chain ends with me.”

lines.japanese:
「昔の……出会った頃の忍だったら、違った言葉を
　口にしたんでしょうね」
lines.english: “The Shinobu of long ago—the boy I first met—would have said something different.”

lines.japanese: 「思い出は、美しい……か」
lines.english: “So memories are beautiful… Is that what you mean?”

lines.japanese:
沙也加は手を伸ばして、古木の切片を大地から抜
いた。
lines.english: Sayaka reached out and drew the fragment of old wood from the earth.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと……」
lines.english: “Wait…”

lines.japanese:
「いいの。もうすっかり大地に還って、別のものに
　なったのだから」
lines.english: “It's all right. They returned to the earth long ago and became something else.”

lines.japanese:
「あの子たちは森の一部になった。不幸なこととは
　思えな―――」
lines.english: “They became part of the forest. I cannot think of that as unhappiness—”

lines.japanese:
一陣の風が吹く。
　深いの森のどこから入ってきたものか。
lines.english: A gust of wind rose. Who could say where it had found its way into the depths of the forest?

lines.japanese:
木々の迷路をすり抜けてきた風は、沙也加の手元
と髪を吹き流した。
lines.english: Having threaded the maze of trees, it streamed through Sayaka's hair and over her hands.
“Ah…”

lines.japanese: 持ち上げた墓標が、ただそれだけのことで崩れた。
lines.english: The grave marker in her hand crumbled from that alone.

lines.japanese:
とうに朽ちていたのである。
　がらんどうだったのだ。
　木の形を残していただけで。
lines.english: It had rotted away long ago. It was hollow. Only the shape of wood remained.

lines.japanese: 「移ろっていく……全てが」
lines.english: “Everything… passes away.”

lines.japanese:
「……僕をここに呼んでくれたのは、君の最後の砦
　を明け渡すためだったんだ」
lines.english: “…You invited me here because you meant to surrender your last stronghold.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな大げさなことではないけれど」
lines.english: “It isn't anything quite so dramatic.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたがいつまでも私を甘やかすから」
lines.english: “Because you insist on coddling me forever.”

lines.japanese: 「それこそ」
lines.english: “You're the one who—”

lines.japanese: 「あなたは一人でも生きていける。私より少し強い」
lines.english: “You can live alone. You are a little stronger than I am.”

lines.japanese: 晴れ晴れとした声で。
lines.english: Her voice was clear and bright.

lines.japanese: 「あなたが上に立つべきだわ」
lines.english: “You should be the one above me.”

lines.japanese: 「たいして変わらないのに……」
lines.english: “There isn't that much difference between us…”

lines.japanese: 「大違いだわ」
lines.english: “We are worlds apart.”
“Haa…”

lines.japanese: 吐息は爪先を押し潰すほどに重い。
lines.english: The sigh was heavy enough to crush his toes.

lines.japanese: 「もうたくさん遊んだわ。だからそろそろ、ね？」
lines.english: “We've played long enough. So perhaps it is time, don't you think?”

lines.japanese: 「何が起こっても、後悔しないで済むように」
lines.english: “So neither of us will have regrets, no matter what happens.”

lines.japanese: 「あなたが言ったのよ？　欲しい、と」
lines.english: “You were the one who said you wanted it.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだけどさ」
lines.english: “I did say that, but…”

lines.japanese: 「長く一緒にいたけど……なんというか、さ」
lines.english: “We've been together a long time… It's just…”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「もう一度……甘酸っぱいのとか、味わいたいんだ
　よね」
lines.english: “I'd like to taste that sweet-and-sour feeling one more time.”

lines.japanese:
「よく言うじゃない？
　レモンとかイチゴとか……そんな感じのさ」
lines.english: “You know how people talk about it? Lemons, strawberries… that sort of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「あずさが言い出しそうなことよ、それは……」
lines.english: “That sounds like something Azusa would say…”

lines.japanese: 「うーん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 「どうすれば甘酸っぱいと言うの？」
lines.english: “What would make it sweet and sour?”

lines.japanese:
「わからない……ただ、デートをしたり、キッスを
　したりする時にそういう状態になるんだと思う」
lines.english: “I don't know… I think it's what happens when people go on dates, or kiss.”
“……How troublesome.”

lines.japanese: 「でもたまに……思い出さない？」
lines.english: “But don't you ever… remember?”

lines.japanese: 問いかけると、沙也加は目尻にほんのり紅を差した。
lines.english: At the question, a faint blush touched the corners of Sayaka's eyes.

lines.japanese: 「あれは、素晴らしい体験だった」
lines.english: “It was a wonderful experience.”

lines.japanese:
「僕らみたいな存在はああいうものを根元に否定し
　ているように見えて、同時に求めてもいるような
　気がするんだ」
lines.english: “People like us seem to deny such things at the root, yet at the same time, I feel we want them.”

lines.japanese:
「独自の精神性から依存はしないが故に、その価値を
　禁欲的に高めていって……命の保持とは関係なく
　いわば良質の甘露としての機能を誰かに求めてる」
lines.english: “Because our minds are independent, we don't depend on others. Abstinence only heightens their value… Apart from any need to preserve life, we look to someone else to serve as a sort of exquisite nectar.”

lines.japanese:
「確かに生きるだけなら一人でもいいさ。けど……
　それはもっとも低い段階の欲求だけのことなんじゃ
　ないかなって」
lines.english: “If all we want is to stay alive, one person truly is enough. But… isn't that only the lowest order of desire?”

lines.japanese:
「上を見れば、外を見れば、その外縁に応じた絆が
　あって良いと思うんだよ」
lines.english: “If we look higher—if we look outward—I think there can be bonds commensurate with the outer bounds of what we see.”

lines.japanese: 「だから私たちに甘いの？　だから―――」
lines.english: “Is that why you're so indulgent with us? Is that why—”

lines.japanese: 「私たちにそれを期待しているの？」
lines.english: “Is that what you expect from us?”

lines.japanese:
「そのあたりは自分でもわからない。期待を押しつ
　けるつもりはないんだけど……」
lines.english: “I don't really know that myself. I have no intention of forcing those expectations on anyone…”

lines.japanese:
「端的に言って僕はまた君とああいうことをしたい。
　意味もなく飴玉を舐めるように」
lines.english: “To put it plainly, I want to do that with you again. Like sucking on a piece of candy for no reason at all.”

lines.japanese: 「問題は」
lines.english: “The problem is—”

lines.japanese:
「うん。あの時は、彼らがいた。
　けど今は……僕らしかいない」
lines.english: “I know. They were there last time. But now… there are only the two of us.”

lines.japanese: 「でも今の僕らもまた、あの時とは違うと思う」
lines.english: “But we're not the same as we were then, either.”

lines.japanese: 「さっきの忍の言葉とてらしあわせると」
lines.english: “Set against what you said before…”

lines.japanese:
「そうやって心地よく堕落しても、あなたはいつか
　はどこかに旅だって行ってしまうのではないかと
　思えるわね」
lines.english: “Even if we surrendered to such pleasant corruption, I feel you would still set off someday on a journey somewhere.”

lines.japanese:
「本当、私も方針を決めないと、どう振る舞うのが
　最善か判断できなくなるわね……」
lines.english: “I really will have to settle on a course, or I won't know how best to behave…”

lines.japanese: と自嘲した。
lines.english: She said it in self-mockery.

lines.japanese: 「……試してみましょうか？」
lines.english: “…Shall we try it?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「物は試しと言うわ」
lines.english: “They do say there's no harm in trying.”
“What? Wait, what?”

lines.japanese: そういうことに、まあ、なった。
lines.english: And so, more or less, that was what they decided.

lines.japanese:
二羽に飽くなき頭突きを受けながら、忍は掃除を
していた。
lines.english: Under an unending barrage of headbutts from the pair, Shinobu keeps cleaning.

lines.japanese: 滑稽な姿だとは思うが、どうしようもない。
lines.english: He knows he looks ridiculous, but there is nothing to be done.

lines.japanese: やがてきりっとした顔つきで、沙也加がやってくる。
lines.english: Before long, Sayaka arrives with a crisp, stern expression.

lines.japanese:
小屋に入ると、ブチとマルの様子が変わる。
　磁石が砂鉄を引き寄せるように、自然に沙也加の
足下に集う。
lines.english: The moment she enters the hutch, Spot and Roly change their tune. As naturally as iron filings drawn to a magnet, they gather around Sayaka's feet.

lines.japanese: 「残りの作業は？」
lines.english: “What remains to be done?”

lines.japanese: 「スキンシップだけ」
lines.english: “Just petting them.”

lines.japanese:
沙也加は兎たちの元にしゃがみこむ。
　いつも通りの鉄面皮で、事務的に鼻先をくすぐる。
　まったく楽しそうではない。
lines.english: Sayaka crouches down beside the rabbits. Her face as impassive as ever, she tickles their noses with businesslike efficiency. She does not look as though she is enjoying herself at all.

lines.japanese: しかし、大切にしているのである。
lines.english: And yet she cherishes them.

lines.japanese: （不器用なんだよな）
lines.english: (She really is awkward.)

lines.japanese: （人のことは言えないな……）
lines.english: (Not that I'm one to talk…)

lines.japanese:
チリトリにたまったゴミをまとめて、袋に落とし
込む。
lines.english: He gathers the trash in the dustpan and drops it into a bag.

lines.japanese: 絞ったモップで、床を丁寧に拭く。
lines.english: With the mop wrung out, he scrubs the floor thoroughly.

lines.japanese: 「……手伝いましょうか？」
lines.english: “…Would you like some help?”

lines.japanese: 「平気。触ってて」
lines.english: “I'm fine. Keep petting them.”

lines.japanese:
礼も言わずに沙也加は手を再び動かし始める。
　モップはすぐに汚れる。
lines.english: Without so much as a thank-you, Sayaka goes back to petting them. The mop quickly grows filthy.

lines.japanese: 小屋の外で水につけて、きつく絞る。
lines.english: Outside the hutch, he dips it in water and wrings it hard.

lines.japanese:
モップ絞り器もあるのだが、あれは固絞りができ
ない。
lines.english: There is a mop wringer, but it cannot squeeze the head dry enough.

lines.japanese: 必然、手で直にモップの先を絞ることになる。
lines.english: So he has no choice but to wring the mop strands out by hand.

lines.japanese:
不潔だし、冷たい作業だ。
　雑巾とは違い、モップは絞るのにもコツがいる。
lines.english: It is filthy, freezing work. Unlike a rag, wringing a mop takes a certain knack.

lines.japanese:
毛先の束をいくつかにわけて、別個に少しずつ捻
っていく。
lines.english: He divides the strands into several bunches and twists each one out in turn.

lines.japanese: 湿っている程度にして、それで床を拭く。
lines.english: Once it is merely damp, he mops the floor with it.

lines.japanese: 沙也加を見た。
lines.english: He looks at Sayaka.

lines.japanese: （ずっとこれを一人でやってたのか）
lines.english: (She's been doing all this alone?)

lines.japanese: 頭からやれば、一人で一時間はかかる作業だ。
lines.english: From beginning to end, the job would take one person at least an hour.

lines.japanese:
（せっかく兎が好きなのに、あまり触れないんだよ
　な……）
lines.english: (For someone who loves rabbits, she hardly gets any time to pet them…)

lines.japanese: 軽く汗ばむほどになると、ようやく半分。
lines.english: By the time he is lightly sweating, he has finally finished half.

lines.japanese: 「そっちに移動してもらえないか？」
lines.english: “Could you move over there?”

lines.japanese:
声をかけると、沙也加は表に立てかけてあったす
のこを、モップがけの終わった箇所に置いた。
lines.english: At his call, Sayaka takes the slatted wooden mat propped outside and lays it over the section he has finished mopping.

lines.japanese:
沙也加に抱かれると兎は素直だ。
　持ち運ばれ、板張りの上にちんまりと丸くなった。
lines.english: The rabbits are docile in Sayaka's arms. She carries them over, and they curl into two small balls on the boards.

lines.japanese: （なぜ沙也加には頭突きをしない？）
lines.english: (Why don't they headbutt her?)

lines.japanese: とにかく、残り半分に着手する。
lines.english: In any case, he begins on the remaining half.

lines.japanese:
最初はちらちらと沙也加を気にするが、そのうち
作業に興が乗ってくると、脇目もふらずに床と格闘
するようになった。
lines.english: At first he keeps glancing toward Sayaka, but once he gets absorbed in the task, he stops looking aside and grapples single-mindedly with the floor.

lines.japanese:
単純作業に忍は抵抗力がない。
　丹念に合理的に、作業を進めていく。
lines.english: Shinobu cannot resist repetitive work. He proceeds carefully and methodically.

lines.japanese:
視線を感じたのはその時だった。
　顔を向けると、慌てて沙也加が目線をそらした。
lines.english: That is when he feels her eyes on him. He turns, and Sayaka hurriedly looks away.

lines.japanese: （あ……今、見てた……よね？）
lines.english: (Oh… She was watching me just now… wasn't she?)

lines.japanese:
信じがたいが、そうらしい。
　大きな衝撃が内部に鈍く浸透してきた。
　次には、ただ見ていただけだ、と思った。
lines.english: Unbelievable, but apparently so. A profound shock slowly seeps through him. Then he tells himself that she was only looking.

lines.japanese:
が、相手は本堂沙也加なのだ。
　全ての行動には、それなりの意味と重みがある。
lines.english: But this is Sayaka Hondou. Everything she does carries its own meaning and weight.

lines.japanese:
沙也加が忍を見ていた。
　そう認識してしまった瞬間、忍は性急に考えを固
めた。
lines.english: Sayaka had been watching Shinobu. The instant he acknowledges that fact, Shinobu rushes to a conclusion.

lines.japanese:
いまだに、まともに話し込んだことはない。
　これ以外で遊んだこともなければ、ましてやデー
トの一つもしていない。
lines.english: They have still never really sat down and talked. They have never hung out together apart from this, much less gone on so much as one date.

lines.japanese:
意志の疎通などこれほどもないと思っていた。
　だが、自分と沙也加との間は、確かに不可視の線
で結ばれていた。
lines.english: He had thought they understood almost nothing of each other. But an invisible line did indeed bind him to Sayaka.

lines.japanese:
注意していないと、見失ってしまう。切れてしまう。
　危うい、蜃気楼のような絆だ。
lines.english: Unless he watches closely, he will lose sight of it. It will snap. A fragile bond, like a mirage.

lines.japanese: 逃がすわけにはいかないと感じた。
lines.english: He feels that he cannot let it slip away.

lines.japanese: （……沙也加）
lines.english: (…Sayaka.)

lines.japanese:
少女の背後に立つ。
　物音を隠してはいない。
　向こうも気付いたはずだ。
lines.english: He comes to stand behind the girl. He has made no effort to hide the sound of his approach. She must know he is there.

lines.japanese:
いつも通りの態度で「なにか用？」とでも冷たく
言われれば、続く行動を抑制できたかも知れない。
lines.english: If she had coldly asked, in her usual way, “Do you want something?” he might have been able to stop himself from what came next.

lines.japanese:
いや、おそらく可能だったはずだ。
　しかし沙也加はそうしなかった。
lines.english: No—he almost certainly would have. But Sayaka had not.

lines.japanese:
ブチとマルだけが、忍を二組のつぶらな瞳で見上
げていた。
lines.english: Only Spot and Roly look up at Shinobu, two pairs of round, innocent eyes fixed on him.

lines.japanese: もはやその無反応は明かに奇異の感を呈している。
lines.english: By now, her failure to react has become conspicuously strange.

lines.japanese: （文句は、言えないはずだ……）
lines.english: (She shouldn't be able to object…)

lines.japanese: （……言えるものか）
lines.english: (…How could she?)

lines.japanese: 確信を胸に、忍は手を伸ばした。
lines.english: Certain of it, Shinobu reaches out.

lines.japanese:
あの日、触れるなと命じた少女の、か細い
肩に―――
lines.english: Toward the slender shoulder of the girl who, that day, ordered him not to touch her—

lines.japanese: 掴んだ。
lines.english: He grabs it.

lines.japanese:
忍はしゃがみこんで片膝をついた。
　モップをフェンスに預け、かけた手をぐいと引け
ば、伏しがちの顔が回転するようにこちらを向いた。
lines.english: Shinobu drops into a crouch on one knee. He rests the mop against the fence and pulls sharply on her shoulder; her lowered face swings around toward him.

lines.japanese:
ねじられた沙也加の顔には、不安と羞恥が剥き出
しにされている。
lines.english: On Sayaka's face, wrenched around toward him, anxiety and shame lie naked.

lines.japanese:
腹部が熱く発火した。
　いや、脳髄かも知れない。
　忍の認識は、部位をとらえきれなかった。
lines.english: Heat ignites in his abdomen. Or perhaps in his brain. Shinobu cannot identify where.

lines.japanese: 間近に、黒墨を流し込んだ猛禽の眼。
lines.english: Up close: the eyes of a bird of prey, flooded with black ink.

lines.japanese:
そう、鷹だ。
　この女は鷹だ。
lines.english: Yes. A hawk. This girl is a hawk.

lines.japanese:
飛翔し狩るための力強さをしなやかに有し、誰に
も媚びず、一人で飛ぶ。
lines.english: She possesses the lithe strength to soar and hunt, curries favor with no one, and flies alone.

lines.japanese: 眼力に優れ射界のすべてを支配する空の支配者。
lines.english: Sovereign of the sky, her keen sight commands everything within its field of fire.

lines.japanese:
兎などはその最たる獲物ではないか。
　忍は生まれてはじめて、欲しいと思った。
　どうしようもなく、欲しい。
lines.english: And what more natural prey could there be than a rabbit? For the first time in his life, Shinobu wants something. Wants it beyond endurance.

lines.japanese:
手に入れたい。
　入手してしまいたい。
　好きにしたい。
