lines.english: “…Quite a collection of oddballs you've put together.”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、なんだよテメー。ごアイサツだな」
lines.english: “Hey, what's your problem? Nice to meet you too.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、まあまあ」
lines.english: “N-now, now.”

lines.japanese:
慌てて仲立ちに入る忍だった。
　他にそういうことをしてくれる者も、いそうにな
かった。
lines.english: Shinobu hurriedly steps between them. No one else looks likely to do it.

lines.japanese: （……頑張れってことか）
lines.english: (…So I'm the one who has to try.)

lines.japanese:
思いを強めた。
　すると、妙に吹っ切れた気分になった。
lines.english: His resolve hardens. And suddenly, he feels strangely liberated.

lines.japanese: ためらいのあった言葉がすんなりと口を突いて出た。
lines.english: The words he had hesitated to say slip smoothly from his mouth.

lines.japanese: 「仲間じゃないか」
lines.english: “You're one of us, aren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 眼光か強まる。
lines.english: His glare sharpens.

lines.japanese: 「オレは誰の仲間でもねぇ。勝手に決めるな」
lines.english: “I'm not part of anybody's crew. Don't decide that for me.”

lines.japanese:
「そだ。
　オマエみたいなヤツは仲間に入れてやんなー」
lines.english: “Yeah. We're not letting a jerk like you join us!”

lines.japanese: 粗暴な少年は鼻を鳴らす。
lines.english: The rough boy snorts.

lines.japanese: 「……だろうよ」
lines.english: “…Of course not.”

lines.japanese: 空気が塗り変わるのを誰もが感じた。
lines.english: They all feel the air change.

lines.japanese:
「そうやっててめぇらだけしか認めないせまい軍隊
　作ってりゃいい」
lines.english: “Go ahead. Build your own tiny, closed-off army that accepts no one else.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、入れてもらわなくて結構だ」
lines.english: “I don't want in anyway.”
“Higuchi…”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだよ……ホンキで怒ってんなよ……」
lines.english: “W-what's your problem…? Don't get seriously mad…”

lines.japanese:
「怒ってないぜ。おまえらのグループも、つるむの
　に許可がいんだろ？　それでいいじゃねーか」
lines.english: “I'm not mad. People need permission before they can hang out with your group, right? Fine by me.”

lines.japanese: 「オレには関係ないってこった」
lines.english: “It just has nothing to do with me.”

lines.japanese:
「なんだよそのいーかた……
　こっちが悪いみたいじゃん」
lines.english: “Why'd you have to say it like that…? Now you make it sound like we're the bad guys.”

lines.japanese: 「どっちが悪いかなんて知るか」
lines.english: “Like I care which side is wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「君は」
lines.english: “You…”

lines.japanese: 忍が割り込む。
lines.english: Shinobu cuts in.

lines.japanese: 「何に対して、そんな苛ついているの？」
lines.english: “What are you so irritated about?”

lines.japanese: 「イラついてなんかねぇ、バカにしてんだ」
lines.english: “I’m not pissed off. I’m making fun of you.”

lines.japanese: 「何を？」
lines.english: “Making fun of what?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえらみたいなやり方だよ」
lines.english: “The way you people do things.”

lines.japanese: 「なにをー！？」
lines.english: “Why, you—!”

lines.japanese:
少女の怒りは手に取るようにわかるが、それを制
して言葉を待つ。
lines.english: The girl's anger is plain to see, but Shinobu restrains her and waits for Shouji to continue.

lines.japanese:
「ダチ選ぶのにもいちいちくだらねぇ理由つけやが
　って」
lines.english: “You have to invent some stupid reason for every friend you choose.”

lines.japanese:
「じゃ何か？　好きかどうかは関係ねぇのかよ？
　空気読めるやつだけが仲間かよ」
lines.english: “So it doesn't matter whether you like each other? Only people who can read the room get to join?”

lines.japanese:
「同じ種類の人間ばっかりよりわけて集めてるだけ
　じゃねぇか！」
lines.english: “You're just handpicking people who are all alike and herding them into one group!”

lines.japanese: 何人かが、章二の激昂を重く聞く。
lines.english: Several of them listen solemnly to Shouji's outburst.

lines.japanese:
「なんだよ、わっけわかんな！　好きだから集まる
　んだろ！　キライなのよけて何が悪いんだよ、
　バーカ！」
lines.english: “What are you talking about? We stick together 'cause we like each other! What's wrong with keeping out the people we hate, dummy?”

lines.japanese: 「本当にキライならそれでいい」
lines.english: “If you really hate them, that's fine.”

lines.japanese: 「で……本当にキライなのか？」
lines.english: “But… do you really hate them?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえなんてキライだねー！」
lines.english: “I sure hate you!”

lines.japanese:
「オレのことじゃない。おまえらちゃんと、互いに
　好き同士でつるんでんのかよ？」
lines.english: “I don't mean me. Do all of you really hang out because you like one another?”

lines.japanese: 沙也加はうっすらと笑う。
lines.english: A faint smile touches Sayaka's lips.

lines.japanese: 「……そういうこと」
lines.english: “…Ah. So that's what this is.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「純粋なものをお好みというわけ」
lines.english: “You have a taste for purity.”

lines.japanese: 「夢見る乙女のように」
lines.english: “Like a starry-eyed maiden.”

lines.japanese:
「忍、この子面白い。仲間にしたら？
　さぞかし参考になるんじゃない？」
lines.english: “Shinobu, this boy is interesting. Why not make him one of us? I'm sure you'll find him instructive.”

lines.japanese: 「こういうことは苦手なあなたにとって」
lines.english: “For someone as poor at this sort of thing as you are.”

lines.japanese: 「……あんま挑発しないでよ」
lines.english: “…Don't provoke him too much.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なめやがって」
lines.english: “D-don't patronize me.”

lines.japanese: 仄かな動揺を発露させた瞳を、傾けて隠す。
lines.english: He turns his face aside, hiding the faint agitation in his eyes.

lines.japanese:
「とにかく好きなら勝手につるみゃあいいんだ。い
　ちいち理由なんかつける方がバカだ」
lines.english: “Anyway, if you like somebody, hang out with 'em. Coming up with a reason for every little thing is what's stupid.”

lines.japanese: 「オレから見たらおまえらもバカってことだ」
lines.english: “From where I stand, you're all idiots.”

lines.japanese: 「好きだから、一緒にいるってのは？」
lines.english: “So you stay together because you like each other?”

lines.japanese: 「……それが普通だ」
lines.english: “…That's normal.”

lines.japanese: 「でも相手がこっちを好きじゃなかったら？」
lines.english: “But what if they don’t like you?”

lines.japanese: 「……離れりゃいーじゃねぇか」
lines.english: “…Then stay away from 'em.”

lines.japanese: 「でもどうしても好きだったら？」
lines.english: “But what if you really like them?”

lines.japanese: 「それはよ」
lines.english: “Well, then…”

lines.japanese:
語尾が濁る。
　末尾はいつまでも出力されない。
lines.english: His sentence trails off. The rest fails to output.

lines.japanese:
「とても好きである。好きの最高峰。でも相手はど
　うだかわかんない。嫌われているかも知れない」
lines.english: “You like them very much. The very pinnacle of liking someone. But you don't know how they feel. They might hate you.”

lines.japanese: 「無理矢理つるむの？」
lines.english: “Do you force them to be with you?”

lines.japanese: 「……相手のいやがることしてどうすんだ」
lines.english: “…What's the point of doing something they hate?”

lines.japanese:
「でもすごく好きなんだよ？　すごくすごく好き。
　さあどうする？」
lines.english: “But you really like them. You like them so, so much. Now what?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ……」
lines.english: “Well…”

lines.japanese:
「まず接近しないといけないよね？　はい、席替え
　のときにうまく立ち回って隣の席になった！
　さあ、次は？」
lines.english: “First you have to get close, right? All right. You play your cards right when they change the seating chart and get the desk beside theirs! What next?”

lines.japanese: 「話しかけて……」
lines.english: “Talk to them…”

lines.japanese:
「ところが嫌われてしまった。話しかけるのは、こ
　こでおしまい？」
lines.english: “But then they take a dislike to you. Do you stop talking to them after that?”

lines.japanese:
「やめるか。少し、少し時間を置いてよ……そんで
　……またちょっとずつ」
lines.english: “Like hell I'd stop. I'd wait a little—just a little while… and then …start again, bit by bit.”

lines.japanese:
迷いながら章二は語る。
　自分でも不確かなルートを、おそるおそる辿る。
lines.english: Shouji speaks hesitantly. He feels his way along a route even he isn't sure of.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅん。長期戦だね」
lines.english: “Hmm. A long campaign.”

lines.japanese:
「でも時間をかけた分だけ、惜しいよね。あきらめ
　きれなくなるよね」
lines.english: “But after you've put in all that time, it would feel like a waste. It would only get harder to give up.”

lines.japanese: 「でも手はあるよね？」
lines.english: “But there are ways, aren't there?”
“Ways?”

lines.japanese: 「いいところを見せたり、助けたり、」
lines.english: “Show them your good side. Help them.”

lines.japanese: 「悪いところを隠したり」
lines.english: “Hide your bad side.”

lines.japanese:
「ちゃんと計画立てて、いい印象を積み重ねて、相
　手の好みを調べて、それに合わせて」
lines.english: “Make a proper plan, leave one good impression after another, learn what the other person likes, and adapt yourself to match.”

lines.japanese: 猟犬めいた双眸に迷い。
lines.english: A flicker of uncertainty in his houndlike eyes.

lines.japanese: 「好きの実現のために、けっこうできることはある」
lines.english: “There's plenty you can do to make being with the person you like a reality.”

lines.japanese:
「好きな誰かとつるむために、そうすべきだ。だよ
　ね？」
lines.english: “And if being with someone you like is the goal, that's what you ought to do. Isn't it?”

lines.japanese:
言いかける。
　しかし止まる。
　震える口元を、じっと忍は注視した。
lines.english: He begins to answer. Then stops. Shinobu watches his trembling mouth intently.

lines.japanese:
やがて引き結ばれ、張りつめた弦と化した唇が、
静かに語句を発信した。
lines.english: At last, his lips draw tight as a taut string and quietly transmit a phrase.

lines.japanese: 「違う、それは」
lines.english: “No. That's different.”

lines.japanese: 忍は、一瞬悪鬼のように笑った。
lines.english: For one instant, Shinobu smiles like a demon.

lines.japanese:
「ふざけんな。そりゃ、ただ無理矢理してるか、だ
　ましてるだけじゃねーか」
lines.english: “Screw that. You're just forcing them into it or lying to them.”

lines.japanese:
「てめぇが好きで、てめぇを好きになるヤツとだけ
　組みゃいいんだ」
lines.english: “Just team up with somebody you like who likes you back.”

lines.japanese: 「それでダチができねーなら、諦めんだ！」
lines.english: “And if that means you never make a friend, give up!”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ」
lines.english: “Haha.”

lines.japanese: 「何がおかしい！」
lines.english: “What's so funny?”

lines.japanese: 一転して、忍は真顔になった。
lines.english: Shinobu's face abruptly turns solemn.

lines.japanese:
「じゃあ大好きな兎に人参なんて食べさせたらダメ
　だ」
lines.english: “Then don't feed carrots to the rabbit you love so much.”
“…Urgh.”

lines.japanese: 「生野菜の食べ過ぎは毒なんだよ」
lines.english: “Too many raw vegetables can poison a rabbit.”

lines.japanese: 「なんか、僕にスゴんでくれちゃったけどさ」
lines.english: “You tried to scare me a minute ago, but…”

lines.japanese: 「し、しらねーんだから、しょうがねぇだろ……」
lines.english: “I-I didn't know, okay? What could I do…?”

lines.japanese:
「知らない人間に、小屋の回りをうろつかれたくな
　いな」
lines.english: “I don't want someone ignorant prowling around the shed.”

lines.japanese: 「……悪かったよ」
lines.english: “…My bad.”

lines.japanese: 章二の表情が深くかげる。
lines.english: A deep shadow crosses Shouji's face.

lines.japanese: 「教えてあげるよ」
lines.english: “I'll teach you.”
“Wha…t?”

lines.japanese: 「そのかわり、兎の飼育手伝ってもらうよ」
lines.english: “In exchange, you're going to help care for the rabbit.”
“…Y-yeah…”

lines.japanese: 「……まあ、しょうがねぇな」
lines.english: “…Well, guess I've got no choice.”

lines.japanese:
鼻をかいて、だが決して安直な笑顔を見せるわけ
にも行かず、章二は不器用に空を見た。
lines.english: Shouji scratches his nose, but cannot let himself offer an easy smile. He looks awkwardly up at the sky.

lines.japanese: 「えー」
lines.english: “Aww.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね、あずさ。でも、決めたから」
lines.english: “Sorry, Azusa. But I've decided.”
“…Grr.”

lines.japanese: 「ちっ」
lines.english: “Tch.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもねぇよ」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「んだよ、えーかっこしーのくせに」
lines.english: “Oh yeah? You're such a poser.”

lines.japanese: 「男にはプライドがあるんだよ！」
lines.english: “Guys have pride!”

lines.japanese: 「バッカ、バッカバッカ」
lines.english: “Dummy, dummy, dummy!”

lines.japanese:
「オウムかおまえは！
　兎がビビッてんじゃねぇか！」
lines.english: “What are you, a parrot? You're scaring the rabbit!”

lines.japanese: 「おまえがビビらせてんだよーだ！」
lines.english: “You're the one scaring it!”

lines.japanese: 口論は良い通風口になったに違いない。
lines.english: Their quarrel must have made a fine pressure valve.

lines.japanese:
「なにがうるふだよ。ぜってーみとめなー。おまえ
　なんてだ犬でじゅーぶんだ」
lines.english: “Lone wolf, my foot. No way I'm buying that! You're nothing but a mutt.”

lines.japanese:
「は、おまえがショボ蔵すぎてオレ様の価値がわか
　んねーんだよ」
lines.english: “Ha. You're such a pathetic little nobody, you couldn't understand how great I am.”

lines.japanese: 「んだこらー」
lines.english: “What'd you say?”

lines.japanese:
あるいは満足げに忍は笑う。
　時計が４５分を告げる短いベルを鳴らした。
lines.english: Shinobu smiles, perhaps in satisfaction. The clock chimes briefly: quarter to the hour.

lines.japanese: 「あなたの頼みだからつきあうけど」
lines.english: “I'm only going along with this because you asked, but…”

lines.japanese: 誰に向けられた言葉だったのか。
lines.english: To whom were those words addressed?

lines.japanese: 「……いつまでも一緒にいられるとは思わないで」
lines.english: “…Don't think we can be together forever.”

lines.japanese: 「帰るの？」
lines.english: “Are you leaving?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
悠然と立ち去る少女は、未練のかけらも落とすこ
とはなかった。
lines.english: The girl departs with unhurried composure, leaving not one trace of reluctance behind.

lines.japanese:
清冽な物腰は一同を無言にし、姿が消えるまで場
に釘づけた。
lines.english: Her cool, crystalline composure silences them all and holds them rooted to the spot until she vanishes from sight.

lines.japanese: 「んぎゃ！　かえんなきゃ！」
lines.english: “Eek! I gotta go home!”

lines.japanese: 忘れた頃、時計を見てあずさが叫ぶ。
lines.english: When everyone has all but forgotten the time, Azusa looks at the clock and shrieks.

lines.japanese: 「そうだね。じゃ僕らは帰る」
lines.english: “That's right. Then we'll head home.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、こちらも引き上げよう」
lines.english: “Yes. We should withdraw as well.”

lines.japanese: 「……おまえらどっかヘンだな」
lines.english: “…There's something weird about all of you.”

lines.japanese: 「慣れてないんだ。じゃあね」
lines.english: “We're not used to this. See you.”

lines.japanese: 「ダッシュダッシュ」
lines.english: “Run, run!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、おい！　オレは明日からどうすんだ！」
lines.english: “H-hey! What am I supposed to do tomorrow?”

lines.japanese: 走りながら忍は不敵に笑いかけた。
lines.english: Still running, Shinobu flashes him a defiant grin.

lines.japanese: 「好きにすればいい！」
lines.english: “Do whatever you want!”

lines.japanese:
背後から何か叫びが聞こえだが、もう時間切れで
あった。
lines.english: A shout comes from behind them, but they're already out of time.

lines.japanese: 鞄を肩に、校門を飛び出す。
lines.english: Bags on their shoulders, they dash out through the school gates.

lines.japanese: 「バイバイ、沙也加」
lines.english: “Bye, Sayaka.”

lines.japanese: 「宿題わす、れん、なー」
lines.english: “Don't for-get your home-work!”

lines.japanese:
勝手な言葉を投げて追い抜いていく忍とあずさを、
沙也加は足を止めて見送った。
lines.english: Sayaka stops and watches as Shinobu and Azusa call out whatever they please and race past her.

lines.japanese:
夕刻の一時、集った六人は、たちどころに分解し
て離ればなれになった。
lines.english: For one brief moment that evening, the six had come together—only to break apart at once and go their separate ways.

lines.japanese: 忍、あずさ、笛子、葉子の四人がいる。
lines.english: There were four of them: Shinobu, Azusa, Fueko, and Youko.
“Cold…”

lines.japanese: 日が暮れて、急激に気温が低くなっていた。
lines.english: With the sun down, the temperature had plummeted.

lines.japanese: 「あ、火つけるね」
lines.english: “Oh, I'll get the fire going.”

lines.japanese:
あずさが手慣れた様子で、火をつけた。
　すぐに原始的な暖かみが、膝から全身に伝わって
きた。
lines.english: Azusa lit the fire with practiced ease. Its primitive warmth soon rose from Shinobu's knees and spread through his whole body.

lines.japanese: 一息つく。
lines.english: He relaxed.

lines.japanese: 「はい、コーヒー」
lines.english: “Here. Coffee.”

lines.japanese:
笛子の淹れてくれたコーヒーは、あいもかわらず
ブラック無糖。
lines.english: As always, the coffee Fueko brewed for him was black and unsweetened.

lines.japanese: 「最初に比べると、便利になったわね、ここ」
lines.english: “This place has gotten a lot more convenient since we first came here.”

lines.japanese: 「そうですねぇ」
lines.english: “It really has.”

lines.japanese: 「どー？」
lines.english: “How's that?”

lines.japanese: 火加減を調整したあずさが問いかける。
lines.english: Azusa asked as she adjusted the flame.

lines.japanese: 「ぐー」
lines.english: “Perfect.”

lines.japanese: 「いえー」
lines.english: “Yeah!”

lines.japanese: 立てた親指同士をくっつける。
lines.english: They bumped their raised thumbs together.

lines.japanese: 「指ちゅーですな」
lines.english: “A little thumb-kiss.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃ私もー」
lines.english: “Me too!”

lines.japanese: 「私も」
lines.english: “And me.”

lines.japanese: 全員で指ちゅー。
lines.english: All four thumbs kissed.

lines.japanese:
「……これではまるで４Ｐですなぁ、
　あはははははは！」
lines.english: “…Why, this is practically a foursome! Ahahahahahaha!”

lines.japanese:
はじっこに連れて行かれ、あずさは笛子に七分ほ
ど性教育された。
lines.english: Fueko led Azusa off to one side and gave her about seven minutes of sex education.

lines.japanese: 陰鬱な空気とともに戻ってきた。
lines.english: She returned shrouded in gloom.

lines.japanese: 「……久々にくらった……」
lines.english: “…Been a while since I got hit with one of those…”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そういえば聞いた？」
lines.english: “Oh, that reminds me. Did you hear?”

lines.japanese: 「何をです？」
lines.english: “Hear what?”

lines.japanese: まったくもったいぶらずに、笛子は言う。
lines.english: Fueko answered without drawing it out.

lines.japanese: 「魔女狩り」
lines.english: “Witch hunts.”

lines.japanese: 「魔女狩り？」
lines.english: “Witch hunts?”

lines.japanese:
「猟奇的な事件が立て続けでしょ？　最近、住民運
　動みたいのがあちこちで起こってるんだけど」
lines.english: “All these grisly incidents, one after another, right? Lately, residents have been organizing all over the place.”

lines.japanese: 「中にはタチ悪いの、ありますね」
lines.english: “Some of them get pretty nasty.”

lines.japanese: 「って？」
lines.english: “Meaning?”

lines.japanese: 「つまり武闘派」
lines.english: “Militant ones.”

lines.japanese: 「それって犯罪じゃないの？」
lines.english: “Isn't that a crime?”

lines.japanese: 「難しいところね」
lines.english: “That's where it gets complicated.”

lines.japanese: 腕を組む。
lines.english: She folded her arms.

lines.japanese:
「自警に関する例の新法があるから、正規活動と言
　い張ればどうとでもなるし……実際のところを確
　かめる術が警察側にないから……」
lines.english: “That new law covering neighborhood watches means they can call almost anything legitimate activity and get away with it… and the police have no way of finding out what actually happened…”

lines.japanese:
「こいつが魔女だーとみんなで言えば、実際は違う
　のだとしても加害者側が酌量される、か」
lines.english: “So if everyone points at someone and yells ‘Witch!’ the attackers get leniency even if their victim isn’t actually a witch.”

lines.japanese:
「あー、子供とかよくさらわれるしね。自警団がどー
　とか近所のおじさん話してたっけ」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. Kids get snatched pretty often. One of the men in the neighborhood was talking about some neighborhood watch or something.”

lines.japanese: 「……って、どこの人たち？　町内会側？」
lines.english: “…Wait, who are these people? The neighborhood association?”

lines.japanese: 「特にひどいのが商店街振興組合だって」
lines.english: “Apparently the shopping-district association is especially bad.”

lines.japanese: 「挙動不審な人間はすぐにしょっぴくって」
lines.english: “I hear they drag in anyone who acts suspicious.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、ライフラインが戦場！？」
lines.english: “Whoa, our supply line is a war zone!?”

lines.japanese: 「そん時は抵抗しちゃダメだからね、あずさ」
lines.english: “If they ever stop you, don't fight back, Azusa.”

lines.japanese: 「あたしはいいけど……ここに心配そうな人が」
lines.english: “I'm fine, but… there's somebody here I'm worried about.”

lines.japanese: 三組の視線が、自分に収束するのを感じ取る。
lines.english: He felt three pairs of eyes converge on him.
“…What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「ぼんやりしてる。危険度高し」
lines.english: “In a daze. High risk.”

lines.japanese: 「えー」
lines.english: “Aww.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、人前ではシャキッとしてよね！」
lines.english: “At least try to look alert when you're out in public!”
“…Aww.”

lines.japanese: 「背中のトコに針金でも入れたらどうかな？」
lines.english: “What if we ran a piece of wire down his back?”

lines.japanese: 「針金人形かっての……」
lines.english: “What is he, a wire doll…?”

lines.japanese: 「忍さんじゃ外に出たらダメ」
lines.english: “Shinobu shouldn't be allowed outside.”
“…Aww.”

lines.japanese: 「ヒキってくださいね」
lines.english: “Please stay a shut-in.”

lines.japanese: 「学校は？」
lines.english: “What about school?”

lines.japanese: 「ここから通います」
lines.english: “He can go to school from here.”

lines.japanese: 「できなかないね」
lines.english: “He could, you know.”

lines.japanese: 他人事のようにあずさ。
lines.english: Azusa said it as if none of this concerned her.

lines.japanese: 「健康害しそう」
lines.english: “Sounds bad for his health.”

lines.japanese: 「コントローラー欲しいですね」
lines.english: “I wish we had a controller.”

lines.japanese: 「欲しいね」
lines.english: “I want one too.”

lines.japanese: 「忍君を自由自在」
lines.english: “Total control over Shinobu.”

lines.japanese: 「忍ちゃんとのべつまくなし」
lines.english: “Shinobu, all day, every day.”

lines.japanese: 「わっ、わっ」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa!”

lines.japanese:
「はいエロい話
　ストーーーープッ！」
lines.english: “Okay, that's enough dirty talk! Stooooop!”

lines.japanese: 「わっとと」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese:
大声を出されて、忍がびくつく。
　両手の間、からっぽになったカップが泳いだ。
lines.english: Fueko's shout made Shinobu jump. The empty cup wobbled between his hands.

lines.japanese: 「死んじゃったのよね」
lines.english: “Someone died, you know.”

lines.japanese:
ぽつり、と言った。
　シンとした。
lines.english: She said it softly. Silence fell.
“Huh?”
“Someone… died?”

lines.japanese:
「ふつーのおじさんらしいんだけど、尋問を拒否し
　て……そんでリンチされちゃって……」
lines.english: “Apparently he was just some ordinary guy, but he refused to answer their questions… and then they lynched him…”

lines.japanese:
「で、殺された側の家族が生前に何の異常もなかっ
　たって主張して」
lines.english: “Then the dead man's family claimed he'd never shown any sign of abnormality while he was alive.”

lines.japanese: 「本当に異常なしだったの？」
lines.english: “Was there really nothing abnormal about him?”

lines.japanese:
「わからない。まったく確証のないまま死んだみた
　い。捕獲のためのリンチが行きすぎたってことら
　しいんで、いろいろと微妙」
lines.english: “We don't know. Apparently he died without anyone having a shred of proof either way. They're saying the beating got out of hand while they were trying to capture him, so it's all pretty murky.”

lines.japanese:
「……ま、やってる時は半ば殺っちゃうつもりだっ
　たんでしょうけど」
lines.english: “…Though I imagine they half meant to kill him while they were at it.”

lines.japanese: ずず、と冷静にコーヒーをすする葉子。
lines.english: Youko calmly sipped her coffee.

lines.japanese: 「狂ったご時世だからね」
lines.english: “Crazy times.”

lines.japanese:
「でも、警護する側がトチ狂って人を殺しちゃうな
　んて……そっちのが狂ってるよ」
lines.english: “But if the people who are supposed to protect us lose it and kill somebody… that's even crazier.”

lines.japanese: 「若者頑張れ」
lines.english: “You young people will have to step up.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あたしっすか！？」
lines.english: “Y-you mean me!?”

lines.japanese: 「がんばれがんばれ。美少女パワーで」
lines.english: “Go get 'em. Use that pretty-girl power.”

lines.japanese: 「そろそろ美女パワーにしようかなーって思ってる」
lines.english: “I was thinking it's about time I graduated to beautiful-woman power.”

lines.japanese: 「……こんな処女臭いのに」
lines.english: “…Not when you still reek this much of virginity.”

lines.japanese: 「びぎゃー！　気にしてることおー！」
lines.english: “Gyaaa! That's a sore spot!”

lines.japanese: 「気にしてる……の……？」
lines.english: “That's… a sore spot…?”

lines.japanese: この日も、賑やかであった。
lines.english: And so passed another lively day.

lines.japanese: 朝一番からかけているが、携帯電話は通じない。
lines.english: He had been calling since first thing that morning, but he could not get through.

lines.japanese: 忍は虚しく機器を畳んだ。
lines.english: Defeated, Shinobu closed the phone.

lines.japanese:
「……昔君が言った、いつまでも一緒にいられない
　って、こういうことなのか、沙也加……」
lines.english: “Back then, when you said we couldn't be together forever… was this what you meant, Sayaka…?”

lines.japanese:
沙也加が戻らなくなって、どれだけの日々が過ぎ
たろう。
lines.english: How many days had passed since Sayaka stopped coming back?

lines.japanese: もう数えることもやめていた。
lines.english: He had stopped counting.

lines.japanese: （捜せる場所はすべて捜した）
lines.english: (I've searched everywhere I can.)

lines.japanese:
全力を出したからといって、後悔がないというこ
とはない。
lines.english: The fact that he had done everything he could did not mean he had no regrets.

lines.japanese:
むしろ執着が強いほど、やるせない気持ちにいつ
までも牽引されてしまう。
lines.english: If anything, the stronger his attachment, the longer that helpless ache dragged him on.

lines.japanese:
考え込んでいると知れず興奮することも多く、忍
の呼吸は驚くほど荒くなっていた。
lines.english: Brooding often worked him up without his noticing, until his breathing grew startlingly ragged.

lines.japanese:
拳も石と化している。
　強ばった指をほぐしていく。
lines.english: His fist, too, had gone hard as stone. He worked the stiffness out of his fingers.

lines.japanese: てのひらに爪がくいこんで、血が出ていた。
lines.english: His nails had bitten into his palm and drawn blood.

lines.japanese:
指先のちょっとした怪我でも、沙也加は手加減し
てはくれなかった。
lines.english: Sayaka never took even the tiniest cut on a fingertip lightly.

lines.japanese:
高級なハンカチを惜しげもなく使って、傷口に雑
菌が入らないようにしてくれた。
lines.english: She would use an expensive handkerchief without a second thought to keep germs out of the wound.

lines.japanese:
今どき、破傷風も何もない。
　無意味な行動だった。
lines.english: Tetanus was hardly a concern these days. The gesture had been pointless.

lines.japanese: 心地よい模倣だった。
lines.english: It was a comforting imitation.

lines.japanese:
手放したくはない。
　手放すべきではない。
lines.english: He did not want to let go. He should not let go.

lines.japanese: 手放さないですむ方法を知りたくてたまらなかった。
lines.english: He was desperate to find a way not to.

lines.japanese: （そうだ）
lines.english: (That's right.)

lines.japanese: （僕は、彼女のことが好きなんだから）
lines.english: (Because I love her.)

lines.japanese: （諦めたらダメだ）
lines.english: (I can't give up.)

lines.japanese:
傷口を舐める。
　一度捜した場所も、また丹念に巡れば新しい発見
があるかも知れない。
lines.english: He licked the wound. If he made another careful pass through the places he had already searched, he might find something new.

lines.japanese: 現場百回と言うではないか。
lines.english: As the saying went: visit the scene a hundred times.

lines.japanese: 「よし」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese: 電子ジャーが炊飯完了を告げた。
lines.english: The rice cooker announced that the rice was ready.

lines.japanese: （食事は活力！）
lines.english: (Food is fuel!)

lines.japanese:
どんぶりにごはんを盛る。
　あまり細かく用意する時間はない。
　レトルトのみそ汁に熱湯を注ぐ。
lines.english: He heaped rice into a bowl. There was no time to make anything elaborate. He poured boiling water into a cup of instant miso soup.

lines.japanese:
みそ汁、ときどき、めし。
　ひたすらにかっこむ。
　炊きたての白米が放つ、熱い湯気。
lines.english: Miso soup, with the occasional mouthful of rice. He shoveled it all down without pause. Hot steam billowed from the freshly cooked white rice.

lines.japanese:
舌を火傷させてしまいそうな熱湯みそ汁。
　神経が悲鳴を上げる。
　が、構うことなく、ハイペースで口腔に押し込む。
lines.english: The soup was scalding enough to burn his tongue. His nerves screamed. He ignored them and kept cramming food into his mouth at a furious pace.

lines.japanese: 「んまま」
lines.english: “Mmph.”

lines.japanese:
豪快にみそ汁を飲み干すと、今度は納豆パックを
二つ持ってきて、残った御飯にぶちまける。
lines.english: After gulping down the soup, he grabbed two packs of natto and dumped them over the remaining rice.

lines.japanese:
黄身を落とし、乱暴にかきまぜて、白米と納豆が
それぞれ玉になっているうちに口内に流し込む。
lines.english: He dropped in an egg yolk and gave it a rough stir, then shoveled the lot into his mouth before the clumps of rice and natto had even broken apart.

lines.japanese: 「ごち」
lines.english: “Done.”

lines.japanese:
食器をまとめて張った水に放り込み、冷蔵庫から
緑の紙パックを引っ張り出す。
　５００ミリリットルパック。
lines.english: He stacked the dishes and dropped them into a sinkful of water, then pulled a green carton from the refrigerator. A 500-milliliter carton.

lines.japanese:
ミネラルとビタミンをとどめるため野菜の搾りか
すをふんだんに入れたそれは、もはやジュースと呼
べるものではなく、
lines.english: Packed with vegetable pulp to preserve the minerals and vitamins, the stuff could no longer properly be called juice.

lines.japanese: 本来の意味でエードと呼ぶべきだろう。
lines.english: In the word's original sense, it was better called an “ade.”

lines.japanese:
毒々しい色と粘度を保った液体を、息が詰まるま
で飲んだ。
lines.english: He drank the lurid, viscous liquid until he had to come up for air.

lines.japanese: 「行ってきます」
lines.english: “I'm off.”

lines.japanese: 無人の我が家に呼びかけて、忍は外に出た。
lines.english: Shinobu called a farewell to the empty house and stepped outside.

lines.japanese: 捜し続けたのである。
lines.english: And so he kept searching.

lines.japanese: 走り疲れ、ふと足を止めた。
lines.english: Worn out from running, he stopped almost without thinking.

lines.japanese:
周囲に人影はない。
　佇んだまま、決然と前を見据える。
　一人。
lines.english: There was no one in sight. He stood there, staring resolutely ahead. Alone.

lines.japanese: 影法師が夕日に引き伸ばされ、奇妙な遠近感を醸す。
lines.english: The evening sun stretched his shadow long, creating a strange sense of perspective.

lines.japanese:
人間味という成分が薄まる。
　佇立する、貴宮忍の形をした異物。
　静止画像を思わせる夕刻に、長く釘付けにされる。
lines.english: Whatever humanity he possessed began to thin. An alien thing stood there in the shape of Shinobu Atemiya. For a long while it remained pinned to an evening that looked like a still photograph.

lines.japanese:
暮れる太陽と、引き伸ばされる影のわずかな動き
が時の流れを示す。
lines.english: Only the setting sun and the almost imperceptible lengthening of his shadow marked the passage of time.

lines.japanese:
それは人の目には映らない。
　持続する機械的観察だけが明らかにする事実だか
らだ。
lines.english: No human eye could see it. It was a truth only sustained mechanical observation could reveal.

lines.japanese:
世界を覆う、現実なる薄い皮膜は裂けていた。
　切れ目からは液状化した異常が流れ込んでくる。
lines.english: The thin membrane of reality stretched across the world had torn. Liquefied abnormality seeped through the rent.

lines.japanese:
大地を薄く覆い、忍の靴を水位５ミリで異世界に
沈殿させている。
lines.english: It spread in a thin film over the earth, sinking Shinobu's shoes five millimeters into another world.

lines.japanese: 掠れる声、方位もなく霧散する。
lines.english: His hoarse voice dispersed, directionless, into the air.

lines.japanese: 「貴宮忍」
lines.english: “Shinobu Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 言葉は、刃物めいていた。
lines.english: The words were like a blade.

lines.japanese:
殺傷をもたらす意図で、鋭く絞られたものだった
からだ。
lines.english: They had been honed to an edge with the intent to kill or maim.

lines.japanese: 「南という」
lines.english: “Name's Minami.”

lines.japanese:
質量をともなった言葉だった。
　太い鎖をあざない、四辺をかたく包囲する。
lines.english: The words carried mass. They twisted into heavy chains, closing hard around him on every side.

lines.japanese:
渦中において、遅まきの自覚だけが否運を知る唯
一の術だ。
lines.english: Caught in the vortex, the only way to know one's misfortune was to realize it too late.

lines.japanese: かえって知らない方が良いことも多い。
lines.english: There were many things one was better off not knowing.

lines.japanese:
たとえば絶望。
　たとえば破滅。
lines.english: Despair, for one. Ruin, for another.

lines.japanese:
よしんば逃れ得たとしても、それが謀られたもの
でないとは断定できない。
lines.english: Even if he escaped, he could never be certain that the escape itself had not been engineered.

lines.japanese:
そんな疑心暗鬼を想起させ、また暗澹とさせる言
葉であった。
lines.english: They were words that conjured precisely that kind of paranoia and the bleakness that came with it.

lines.japanese: 「名前くらいは、耳にしているはずだ」
lines.english: “You must have heard the name, at least.”

lines.japanese: 「何の用？」
lines.english: “What do you want?”

lines.japanese:
間を置かず返す言葉に、体温は感じられない。
　そっけなく、ペースを崩しにかかる。
lines.english: His answer came without pause or warmth. Its brusqueness was meant to break Minami's rhythm.

lines.japanese: げん
lines.english: Words

lines.japanese:
だがさらに折り返された言に、忍は絶句すること
になる。
lines.english: But Minami's immediate reply struck Shinobu speechless.

lines.japanese: 「貴官に降伏を許可する」
lines.english: “I authorize your surrender.”

lines.japanese:
防備を一撃で粉砕された気分に見舞われた。
　流れた汗が、眉にかかる。
　こそばゆいが、指一本動かせない。
lines.english: He felt as though his defenses had been shattered in a single blow. A trickle of sweat reached his brow. It tickled, but he could not move so much as a finger.

lines.japanese: 動かせば、はじまりそうな気がした。
lines.english: He had a feeling that if he moved, it would begin.

lines.japanese:
「噛み砕けば……
　俺の指示に従え、ということになる」
lines.english: “Let me put it into bite-size terms… obey my orders.”

lines.japanese:
単刀直入な物言いだった。
　首筋に、ちりちりとした痛痒が感じられた。
　熱した鉄糸を添えられたような。
lines.english: The statement was brutally direct. A painful prickle ran along the back of his neck, as if a strand of red-hot wire had been laid against it.

lines.japanese:
緊張によるものか、南の威圧によるものか。
　それ以外か―――
lines.english: Was it tension, or the pressure Minami exerted? Or something else—

lines.japanese: 「間に合ってる、それは」
lines.english: “I'll pass.”

lines.japanese: 「大切な者がいるな。そういうにおいがする」
lines.english: “There's someone you care about. I can smell it on you.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、なおのこと俺の側につくべきだろう」
lines.english: “All the more reason to take my side.”

lines.japanese: 「状況は理解できているだろう？」
lines.english: “You do understand the situation, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「そう選択肢のあることでもない」
lines.english: “It isn't as though you have many options.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえに与えられた時間は終わった」
lines.english: “Your allotted time is over.”

lines.japanese: 「……そんな話は聞いてない」
lines.english: “…No one told me that.”

lines.japanese: だとしても、忍は思った。
lines.english: Even if that was true, Shinobu thought—

lines.japanese:
南という男がこうして接触してきているというこ
とは、手回しは済んでいると見るべきだ。
lines.english: The fact that Minami had approached him like this meant Shinobu had to assume all the arrangements were already in place.

lines.japanese:
これがハッタリだとするなら、さほど意味のある
ことではないからだ。
lines.english: If it was a bluff, there was little point to it.

lines.japanese:
単刀直入なのは、時間を短縮するためだろう。
　案の定、次に南が発した言葉は痛烈だった。
lines.english: His bluntness was probably meant to save time. Sure enough, Minami's next words were devastating.

lines.japanese: 「なくなるぞ」
lines.english: “It will be gone.”

lines.japanese:
首筋に焼きごてを押しつけられる感覚。
　かろうじて、忍は踏みとどまる。
　無様につんのめってしまいそうになったのだ。
lines.english: It felt as though a branding iron had been pressed to his neck. Shinobu barely held his ground. He had almost pitched forward.

lines.japanese: 錯覚に屈して。
lines.english: Giving in to the illusion.

lines.japanese: 「おまえが守ろうとしているものが、なくなる」
lines.english: “What you're trying to protect will be gone.”

lines.japanese: 「噛み砕かれてな」
lines.english: “Chewed to pieces.”

lines.japanese: 「選択肢はない。必要ないからだ」
lines.english: “You have no choice. You don't need one.”

lines.japanese: 「答えも道も一つだ」
lines.english: “One answer. One path.”

lines.japanese: 「そして俺たちの道もまた、重なっているはずだ」
lines.english: “And our paths, too, should coincide.”

lines.japanese: 「……守っているなんて、いつ言った？」
lines.english: “…When did I ever say I was protecting anything?”

lines.japanese: 失笑があった。
lines.english: A derisive chuckle.

lines.japanese: 「見ればわかる」
lines.english: “I can see it.”

lines.japanese:
言論の衝突にさえなっていない。
　かすかな抵抗も体を成さない。
　忍の双肩、重みが増す。
lines.english: It did not even amount to a clash of words. Not even the faintest resistance took shape. The weight on Shinobu's shoulders grew.

lines.japanese:
跳ねる心臓をなんとか押さえつけた。
　冷静に―――
　心の掛けがねが開けば、異物が滑りこんでくる。
lines.english: He somehow forced his hammering heart back under control. Stay calm— If the latch on his mind sprang open, a foreign body would slide inside.

lines.japanese:
乱されてしまう。
　忍は南をほとんど知らない。
lines.english: It would throw him off balance. Shinobu knew almost nothing about Minami.

lines.japanese:
だが逆に、南は忍を熟知している。状況を把握し
ている。ジョーカーを隠すことも、隠しているよう
に思わせることもできる。
lines.english: Minami, by contrast, knew Shinobu inside out and understood the situation. He could keep a joker up his sleeve, or merely make Shinobu think he had one.

lines.japanese:
そういう構図だ。
　忍は不利なのだ。
lines.english: That was the shape of it. Shinobu was at a disadvantage.

lines.japanese: 夕刻、無人の道。
lines.english: Dusk. An empty road.

lines.japanese: そういう罠なのだ。
lines.english: That was the trap.

lines.japanese: 「知ってるんだろう？　僕のしていることを」
lines.english: “You know what I've been doing, don't you?”

lines.japanese:
「……確かに僕は彼女たちを守ってるよ。大切だ。
　で、そのどこに疑問があると？」
lines.english: “…Yes, I'm protecting them. They matter to me. So what exactly is there to question?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえの行動を見ればわかるさ」
lines.english: “I only have to look at your actions.”

lines.japanese:
「おまえは本当に大切にしてる。紅緒あずさ、
　本堂沙也加、伊月笛子、塚本葉子、塚本斎、
　樋口章二を大切にしている」
lines.english: “You really do care about them: Azusa Benio, Sayaka Hondou, Fueko Izuki, Youko Tsukamoto, Itsuki Tsukamoto, and Shouji Higuchi.”

lines.japanese:
「とても愛おしく思っている。
　あるいは―――愛おしくしたいと定めている」
lines.english: “You hold them very dear. Or perhaps—you have resolved to make them dear to you.”

lines.japanese: 「見ればわかるさ。俺とおまえは同種なんだから」
lines.english: “I can see it. You and I are the same kind.”

lines.japanese: 「……そのようだね」
lines.english: “…So it seems.”

lines.japanese: 「だとしても、あるのは結果だけじゃないかな、南」
lines.english: “Even so, isn't the outcome all there is, Minami?”

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese:
「どんな結果になったとしても、そういう事実があ
　るだけだ」
lines.english: “Whatever the outcome, it will be nothing more than a fact.”

lines.japanese:
「世界に記されあるいは記されない、なにがしかの
　情報が、一つ増える」
lines.english: “One more piece of information is added to the world— whether or not the world records it.”

lines.japanese:
「本質的には、人質というものは無意味だってこと
　だよ。僕には」
lines.english: “Fundamentally, hostages are meaningless— at least to me.”

lines.japanese: 「……こんなご時世には、特にさ」
lines.english: “…Especially in times like these.”

lines.japanese: 「確かにな」
lines.english: “True enough.”

lines.japanese:
「普段のおまえが、真実のありさまだとは思ってい
　ない」
lines.english: “I don't believe the way you usually act is your true nature.”

lines.japanese: 「演じているだけということも、わかる」
lines.english: “I know it's only an act.”

lines.japanese:
「……しかし、そんなことに何の意味があるのか俺
　にはわからない」
lines.english: “…But I don't understand what meaning any of that could have.”

lines.japanese: 「意味という問いかけ自体に意味がない」
lines.english: “There's no meaning in asking about meaning.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ、そうしてるだけさ」
lines.english: “It's simply what I do.”

lines.japanese:
「もちろん、そうするだけの思考はある。けど……
　他の思考を選ぶことだってできる」
lines.english: “There is a train of thought behind it, of course. But… I could choose another.”

lines.japanese:
「彼らは大切な友達だけど、場合によっては大切じゃ
　なくなることもある」
lines.english: “They are dear friends, but depending on the circumstances they might cease to matter.”

lines.japanese: 「……本気で憂えた時とかね」
lines.english: “…If I ever found myself truly fearing for them, for example.”

lines.japanese: 「下手なつつき方をするな、ということか」
lines.english: “So you're warning me not to press the wrong nerve.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese:
「本質的に無意味というくらいだ。外部にかき乱さ
　れるくらいなら、自分で壊すことも厭わないか」
lines.english: “You say hostages are fundamentally meaningless. So you would not hesitate to destroy them yourself rather than let some outside force disrupt you?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 殺気めいた圧力が失せた。
lines.english: The almost murderous pressure disappeared.

lines.japanese: 「日を改める」
lines.english: “We'll speak again another day.”

lines.japanese: 「だが近いぞ。真実を見誤るなよ、貴宮忍」
lines.english: “But the day is close. Do not misread the truth, Shinobu Atemiya.”

lines.japanese: 「……その前にひとつ」
lines.english: “…One thing before you go.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese:
「人に話をするときに、武器を突きつけるような輩
　は、好きにならない」
lines.english: “I don't care for people who point weapons at someone while trying to talk to them.”
