lines.english: Her face broke into a smile, as though overcome by longing. Judging by her face alone, Sayaka looked truly happy.

lines.japanese: 「なんで、なんで」
lines.english: “Why? Why?”

lines.japanese: 「あの子たちの心……見つからなかった……わ……」
lines.english: “Their hearts… I couldn't find them…”

lines.japanese: 「ブチと、マル……」
lines.english: “Spot and Roly…”

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese:
「ひとかけらでもあれば、私はそれを取り込んでも
　良かった」
lines.english: “If even one fragment remained, I would have been willing to take it into myself.”

lines.japanese: 「そうしたら……優しい私になる」
lines.english: “Then… I would become kind.”

lines.japanese: 「今だって、優しいよ？」
lines.english: “You're kind even now.”

lines.japanese: 「演技ではなく、本当に優しくなるのよ」
lines.english: “I would be truly kind, rather than merely acting the part.”

lines.japanese:
「そうすれば……
　忍の可能性のままで、いられた……」
lines.english: “And then… I could have remained your possibility…”

lines.japanese: 「沙也加」
lines.english: “Sayaka.”

lines.japanese: 手を握る。
lines.english: He took her hand.

lines.japanese: 「あなたは最後まで、私を個人として扱った」
lines.english: “To the very end, you treated me as an individual.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、これもまた、一つの結末なのでしょうね」
lines.english: “Then this too must be an ending in its own right.”

lines.japanese: 「悔いることはないと思う……私も、あなたも」
lines.english: “I don't think there's anything to regret… for me or for you.”

lines.japanese: 「違う……寂しいんだよ」
lines.english: “No… that's not it. I'm lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「寂しくなるんだ……」
lines.english: “I'm going to be lonely…”

lines.japanese: 「あなたの想い描く魂は、尊い……」
lines.english: “The soul as you conceive it is precious…”

lines.japanese: 「愚劣ね」
lines.english: “And foolish.”

lines.japanese: 「だけど」
lines.english: “But…”

lines.japanese: 親愛のまなざし。情愛に丸みを帯びた吐息。
lines.english: A gaze full of fondness. A sigh rounded by affection.

lines.japanese: 「直線のよう」
lines.english: “It is like a straight line.”

lines.japanese: 「……誉め言葉に、なってないよ……沙也加」
lines.english: “…That's not much of a compliment… Sayaka.”

lines.japanese: 「フフ」
lines.english: “Hehe.”

lines.japanese: 「本当に、あのカケラさえ残っていれば……っ」
lines.english: “If only that fragment had truly survived…”

lines.japanese:
咳き込む。
　口元から赤いものが垂れた。
lines.english: She coughed. Something red spilled from her mouth.

lines.japanese: 「沙也加」
lines.english: “Sayaka.”

lines.japanese: 「……あなたと並んで、もしかしたら、革新に……」
lines.english: “…Beside you, perhaps… a breakthrough…”

lines.japanese: 「ブチとマルの記憶。心のかけら」
lines.english: “Spot and Roly's memories. Fragments of their hearts.”

lines.japanese: 「小さな優しさ」
lines.english: “A little kindness.”

lines.japanese: 「それは、これのこと？」
lines.english: “Do you mean this?”

lines.japanese: 忍は空手を少女に捧げる。
lines.english: Shinobu offered the girl his empty hand.

lines.japanese: 「まあ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese:
満ち足りて生涯を過ぎ去る老女の清さが、沙也加
に立ちこめた。
lines.english: The purity of an old woman passing peacefully from a full and contented life suffused Sayaka.

lines.japanese:
一秒ごとに強まるある種の予感に、忍は気絶しそ
うだった。
lines.english: The premonition grew stronger with every passing second, until Shinobu felt he might faint.

lines.japanese: 「それは、どこに？」
lines.english: “Where is it?”

lines.japanese: 「覚えてない？」
lines.english: “Don't you remember?”

lines.japanese: 沙也加はぽかんと口をあけた。
lines.english: Sayaka's mouth fell open.

lines.japanese: 「……ああ……もしかして……」
lines.english: “…Oh… Could it be…?”

lines.japanese:
「そう、子供の頃に……僕も彼女たちに触れたんだ
　よ」
lines.english: “Yes. When I was a child… I touched them too.”

lines.japanese: 「器用さん」
lines.english: “You clever thing.”
“…Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「こんなことばかり、できるよ」
lines.english: “Things like this are all I can do.”

lines.japanese: 「それはあなたが持っていて」
lines.english: “You should keep it.”

lines.japanese: 「でも」
lines.english: “But…”

lines.japanese: 「私には、もう必要ないみたい」
lines.english: “It seems I don't need it anymore.”

lines.japanese:
「それに……いま心を戻してしまったら……無様な
　姿を見せるかも……」
lines.english: “Besides… if I got my heart back now… I might make a pathetic spectacle of myself…”

lines.japanese: 「恥ずかしいから、いやなの」
lines.english: “I'd be embarrassed. I don't want that.”

lines.japanese: 「沙也加」
lines.english: “Sayaka.”

lines.japanese: 底から響く、忍の声だった。
lines.english: Shinobu's voice came from somewhere deep inside.

lines.japanese: 「僕は今、君を失いたくないと思ってる」
lines.english: “Right now, I don't want to lose you.”

lines.japanese: 「冷静にそう思ってる」
lines.english: “I feel that way with a clear head.”

lines.japanese:
「だから……沙也加……ごめん、本当にごめん……
　だけど沙也加……」
lines.english: “So… Sayaka… I'm sorry. I'm truly sorry… But, Sayaka…”

lines.japanese: 「お別れよ」
lines.english: “This is goodbye.”

lines.japanese: 「いやなんだ」
lines.english: “I don't want it to be.”

lines.japanese: 「どちらにしても、」
lines.english: “Either way…”

lines.japanese: 「お別れよ」
lines.english: “This is goodbye.”

lines.japanese: 目を閉じる。
lines.english: She closed her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「……キスを……して……くれる？」
lines.english: “…Will you… kiss me…?”

lines.japanese: 「そばにいてくれてありがとう……」
lines.english: “Thank you… for staying with me.”
“Mm…”

lines.japanese:
厳粛な儀式のように、唇を合わせた。
　長い長い時間。
lines.english: Their lips met as though in solemn ritual. For a long, long time.

lines.japanese: 顔を引き離した時、沙也加はもう呼吸を止めていた。
lines.english: When he drew his face away, Sayaka had already stopped breathing.

lines.japanese: 脳死に至る短い旅が始まろうとしている。
lines.english: The brief journey toward brain death was about to begin.

lines.japanese: 「……もう、いやなんだ」
lines.english: “…I can't bear this anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「本当にもういやなんだよ」
lines.english: “I really can't bear any more of it.”

lines.japanese: 「失うのは、ごめんなんだ……」
lines.english: “I can't bear to lose anything else…”

lines.japanese:
再度、口づけをした。
　傷口を押さえた手を持ち上げる。
　魂なき肉体の重さにはぞっとさせられる。
lines.english: He kissed her once more. He lifted the hand pressed against her wound. The weight of a soulless body made him shudder.

lines.japanese: 「こんな穴をあけられて……かわいそうに……」
lines.english: “They left a hole like this in you… You poor thing…”

lines.japanese:
蒙昧な傷だった。
　しかし沙也加は受け入れた。
　忍はそこにも口づけた。
lines.english: It was a wound born of blind ignorance. But Sayaka had accepted it. Shinobu kissed that place too.

lines.japanese: 「さようなら、沙也加。さようなら」
lines.english: “Goodbye, Sayaka. Goodbye.”

lines.japanese: 冷たく泣きながら、万感の思いと息吹を込めた。
lines.english: Weeping coldly, he poured all his feelings and all his breath into it.

lines.japanese:
たどたどしく弔いの儀式を終えると、忍は伏して
泣いた。
lines.english: Once the halting funeral rite was over, Shinobu lay facedown and wept.

lines.japanese:
もっとも見苦しいと思うやり方で、納得いくまで
泣き続けた。
lines.english: He wept in the ugliest way he knew until, at last, he had cried his fill.

lines.japanese: 鼻歌がまるで他人事だった。
lines.english: The humming seemed to belong to someone else.

lines.japanese:
忌まわしい夕焼けは、事が終わっても未練がまし
く訪れる。今日もまた。
lines.english: Even when it was all over, the hateful sunset returned and refused to leave. Again today.
“Mm-mm-mm…♪”

lines.japanese:
どこかやつれた顔で、忍は歩く。
　腕に沙也加を抱いて。
lines.english: Shinobu walked on, his face haggard. Sayaka cradled in his arms.

lines.japanese:
歌は流行歌だ。
　疎い沙也加が、唯一好んだ流行歌。
lines.english: It was a pop song. The one pop song Sayaka—who knew little about such things—had ever liked.

lines.japanese:
カラオケに連れていっても、決して歌おうとはし
なかったけれど。
lines.english: Even when he took her to karaoke, she would never sing it herself.

lines.japanese: 忍が歌うのは、楽しげに耳を傾けていた。
lines.english: But whenever Shinobu sang it, she had listened happily.

lines.japanese:
そして忍は二人で歩いていく。
　遠くを目指して、歩いていく。
lines.english: And so they walked on together. They walked on, bound for somewhere far away.

lines.japanese: （外に行くんだ）
lines.english: (We're going outside.)

lines.japanese: （二人で、歩いていくんだ）
lines.english: (The two of us are going to walk on together.)

lines.japanese: （でもその前に）
lines.english: (But before we go…)

lines.japanese: （ブチとマルや長老に、顔を見せていこう）
lines.english: (We'll go show our faces to Spot and Roly, and the Elder.)

lines.japanese: そして祈るのだ。
lines.english: And then, a prayer:

lines.japanese: 新たな二人の絶望的な門出を、どうか、
lines.english: This hopeless new beginning for the two of them—please…

lines.japanese: 呪ってください―――
lines.english: curse it—

lines.japanese: 503 Service Unavailable
lines.english: ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ ⁠ 503 Service Unavailable

lines.japanese:
本来、彼女が失踪する理由などないのだ。
　忍はいくらかけても繋がらない携帯電話を畳む。
lines.english: There was no reason for her to disappear in the first place. Shinobu closed the phone; no matter how often he called, he could not get through.

lines.japanese:
「……昔君が言った、いつまでも一緒にいられない
　って、こういうことなのか、沙也加……」
lines.english: “Back then, when you said we couldn't be together forever… was this what you meant, Sayaka…?”

lines.japanese:
硬くなった拳をほどけば、爪が食い込み、てのひ
らから出血していた。
lines.english: When he opened his clenched fist, his palm was bleeding where his nails had dug in.

lines.japanese:
血を見ると沙也加のことを思い出す。
　彼女の白いハンカチは、よく忍の血を吸ったものだ。
lines.english: The sight of blood reminded him of Sayaka. Her white handkerchief had soaked up his blood time and again.

lines.japanese: （これが……僕の予知した、悲しみの正体なのか？）
lines.english: (Is this… what the sorrow I foresaw really was?)

lines.japanese: （じゃあ、これからはどうなる？）
lines.english: (Then what happens from here?)

lines.japanese: （この先は視せてはくれないのか？）
lines.english: (Will it show me nothing beyond this point?)

lines.japanese: 見たかった。
lines.english: He wanted to see it.

lines.japanese:
全ての出来事について、先々までの歴史が記され
た……そんな記録を。
lines.english: A record containing the history of every event far into the future…

lines.japanese:
一つの正しく尊い答えがあるというなら、それを
辿るか回避すればいいのだ。
lines.english: If there were one correct and sacred answer, all he had to do was follow it or steer clear of it.

lines.japanese: 悩む必要もない。
lines.english: There would be no need to agonize.

lines.japanese:
もはやそれを予知とは呼べない。
　全知というべき代物である。
lines.english: It could no longer be called foresight. It would have to be called omniscience.

lines.japanese:
どんな人間も有してはいない、神の才能に他なら
ない。
lines.english: A divine faculty possessed by no human being.

lines.japanese:
血を舐める。
　含まれる鉄分を玩味したためか、空腹を感じた。
lines.english: He licked the blood. Perhaps savoring the iron in it made him aware of his hunger.

lines.japanese: 「よし」
lines.english: “All right.”

lines.japanese:
室内から、炊飯の終わったことを知らせる電子音
が聞こえた。
lines.english: An electronic chime sounded inside, announcing that the rice was done.

lines.japanese: （何をするにしても、滋養は必要だ）
lines.english: (Whatever I do, I'll need nourishment.)

lines.japanese:
簡単に食事の用意をすませる。
　食事は三分で終わる。
lines.english: He threw together a simple meal. It took him three minutes to eat.

lines.japanese:
国家公認の総合ビタミン・ドリンクは、面妖なそ
の味さえ気にしなければ、非常に完成された栄養食
である。
lines.english: Provided one could overlook its bizarre taste, the government-approved multivitamin drink was an exceptionally well-formulated source of nutrition.

lines.japanese: （一日駆け回ることになるんだしな）
lines.english: (I'll be running around all day.)

lines.japanese:
即席の食事を補うため、一気に飲み干した。
　そうしなければとても５００ミリリットルを“服
用”することなどできない。
lines.english: He drained it in one go to supplement the makeshift meal. There was no other way he could possibly “dose himself” with all 500 milliliters.

lines.japanese: 「行ってきます」
lines.english: “I'm off.”

lines.japanese: 千鳥のいない室内に呼びかけて、家を出た。
lines.english: He called out into the house—Chidori was not there—and left.

lines.japanese: 捜し続けた。
lines.english: He kept searching.

lines.japanese: 沙也加の家に足を向ける途中、忍は叫び声を聞いた。
lines.english: On his way to Sayaka's house, Shinobu heard someone shout.

lines.japanese: 「進藤さん！　なんか宮田町の方で出たってさ！」
lines.english: “Shindou! They say something showed up over Miyata way!”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんだって？」
lines.english: “What? What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 「魔女が出たって！」
lines.english: “A witch showed up!”

lines.japanese:
「こっちにも応援頼まれたんだけど、これ誰に報告
　したらいいの？」
lines.english: “They asked us to send help too, but who am I supposed to report this to?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それね、２丁目の山岸さんってわかる？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. You know Yamagishi over in the Second District?”

lines.japanese: 「家はわかんないなぁ……加藤さん案内してくれる？」
lines.english: “I don't know where he lives… Katou, can you show me?”

lines.japanese:
「すぐそこなんだけど……うん、ちょっとそこで待
　ってて！　じかに説明した方が早いよ」
lines.english: “It’s right nearby… Yeah, wait there a second! It’ll be quicker to explain it in person.”

lines.japanese:
塀の外から話しかけていた男と、庭で畑をいじっ
ていた男が、連れだってどこかに走り去った。
lines.english: The man speaking from beyond the wall and the man tending the garden ran off somewhere together.

lines.japanese:
ピリピリと肌を灼く、悪意めいたものを気取るこ
とができた。
lines.english: He sensed something like malice— a prickling heat against his skin.
“…A witch?”

lines.japanese:
該当する人物はただ一人。
　自然、忍の足は動く。
lines.english: Only one person fit the description. Shinobu's feet moved of their own accord.

lines.japanese:
人々が避難してくる。
　昨日食事をともにした隣人さえも信頼できない今だ。
lines.english: People were evacuating. These days, you couldn't trust even a neighbor you'd shared a meal with yesterday.

lines.japanese:
魔女の噂。
　逃げまどう人々。
　対応が過敏であるとは言い切れない。
lines.english: Rumors of a witch. People fleeing in terror. Their reaction could not simply be dismissed as excessive.

lines.japanese:
彼らとは逆方向、事件の渦中に向かって忍は駆け
ていく。
lines.english: Shinobu ran against the flow, toward the heart of the incident.
“The witch—”

lines.japanese: 「自警団の連中が―――」
lines.english: “The neighborhood watch—”

lines.japanese: 「向こうの坂の方に―――」
lines.english: “Over by the hill—”

lines.japanese: 「市内放送かけてもらって―――」
lines.english: “Get them to announce it over the town PA—”

lines.japanese: 「避難場所学校ダメなの？―――」
lines.english: “Can't we use the school as an evacuation site?—”

lines.japanese: 「学校方面に―――」
lines.english: “Toward the school—”

lines.japanese:
学校方面。
　忍はそちらに向かう。
lines.english: Toward the school. Shinobu headed that way.
(Sayaka—!)

lines.japanese:
問題は彼女が抵抗したかどうかだ。
　ひとたび血を見れば、もはや彼女を魔女でないと
擁護することはできなくなる。
lines.english: The question was whether she had resisted. Once blood was spilled, it would no longer be possible to argue that she was not a witch.

lines.japanese:
最悪の事態だ、それは。
　だが―――
lines.english: That would be the worst possible outcome. But—

lines.japanese: （……抵抗しなかったら？）
lines.english: (…What if she didn't resist?)

lines.japanese:
当たり前のイメージが浮かびかけて、消えた。
　沙也加はあまりにも完成しやすい個人だった。
lines.english: An obvious image almost took shape, then vanished. Sayaka was an individual all too easily completed.

lines.japanese:
そして重すぎる天体が自壊するように、寿命を全
うすることのない崩壊が約束されていた。
lines.english: And like a celestial body collapsing beneath its own excessive mass, she was fated to fall apart before living out her natural span.

lines.japanese: とうに、摩滅して果てているはずの人間だったのだ。
lines.english: She was someone who should have worn herself away to nothing long ago.

lines.japanese:
恐るべき人類の変異種、本堂沙也加。
　忍の意志が、それを保持した。
　その力を剥奪することで。
lines.english: Sayaka Hondou, a terrifying mutation of humanity. Shinobu's will had preserved her. By stripping her of that power.

lines.japanese:
だが……もうどれほどの時間、離ればなれになっ
ていることだろう。
lines.english: But… how long had they been separated now?

lines.japanese:
夕刻の森に、沙也加は連れ込まれた。
　工業地域も近いこの場所は、人通りが極端に少な
く、治安も良くはない。
lines.english: Sayaka was taken into the forest at dusk. Close to the industrial district, it saw very few passersby and was far from safe.

lines.japanese:
十年ほど前までは、社会生活から逸脱した人間が
住みついていたり、若者たちの暴力的集団のたまり
場となっていたこともある。
lines.english: Until about a decade earlier, it had sheltered people who had fallen out of society, and had served as a hangout for gangs of violent youths.

lines.japanese:
駅前の発展とともに彼らは移動していったが、街
に近く人目につかないこの場所は、犯罪行為にうっ
てつけの場所であることは間違いない。
lines.english: They had moved on as the area around the station developed, but a place so close to town and so well hidden was undoubtedly ideal for crime.

lines.japanese:
そこに沙也加は連れてこられた。
　男は三人いた。
lines.english: Sayaka had been brought there. There were three men.

lines.japanese:
全員、背広を着用し、腕には補導員の腕章をつけ
ていた。
lines.english: All three wore suits and armbands identifying them as juvenile guidance officers.

lines.japanese:
年齢は三十代前半。
　中肉中背、痩身、やや肥満の男だった。
lines.english: They were in their early thirties. One was of average height and build, one was thin, and one was slightly overweight.

lines.japanese:
本堂の名字を呼んで沙也加を呼び止め、パトロー
ル隊員を名乗った。
lines.english: They stopped Sayaka by calling out her surname, Hondou, then introduced themselves as members of a patrol unit.

lines.japanese:
沙也加は補導された。
　いろいろと質問をされたが、沙也加が一向に返答
をしないためであった。
lines.english: They took Sayaka into custody because she would not answer any of their questions.

lines.japanese:
時間帯からか周囲に人影はなく、まったく誰に目
撃されることもなく車に乗せられたのである。
　車は郊外へと向かい、森のそばで停車した。
lines.english: Perhaps because of the hour, no one else was nearby. They put her in a car without a single witness. The car headed for the outskirts and stopped beside the forest.

lines.japanese:
すでに民家は遠い。
　男たちは沙也加を連れて車を降りる。
　言葉一つ交わさず、森の奥に歩いていった。
lines.english: The nearest houses were already far behind. The men brought Sayaka out of the car. Without exchanging a word, they walked deep into the forest.

lines.japanese:
そしてある地点まで到達すると、一人が先行して
草むらをかき分けた。
lines.english: At one point, one of the men went ahead and parted the undergrowth.

lines.japanese:
そこには全高１３０センチほどのドーム型テント
が設置されていた。
lines.english: A dome tent roughly 1.3 meters tall had been pitched there.

lines.japanese:
居住性が高く、５～６人ほどが寝泊まりできるタ
イプのものだ。
lines.english: It was a roomy model large enough for five or six people to sleep inside.

lines.japanese:
肥満がビデオカメラを取り出し、充電状態を確か
めた。
lines.english: The overweight man took out a video camera and checked the battery level.

lines.japanese:
中肉中背が残った一人と会話しつつ、沙也加の手
首に革製の拘束具を装着する。
　後ろ手に縛られたようになった。
lines.english: While talking to the third man, the man of average height and build fastened leather restraints around Sayaka's wrists. Her hands were bound behind her back.

lines.japanese:
そして、本堂の家の人間の本日のスケジュールに
ついて言及し、三時間以内に全てを済ませる必要が
あると仲間に注意を促した。
lines.english: He then mentioned the Hondou family's schedule for the day and reminded his companions that everything had to be finished within three hours.

lines.japanese:
痩身の男が、優しげに沙也加の肩をつかんだ。
　夜までにはおうちに帰れるから協力してください
ね―――
lines.english: With an air of kindness, the thin man took Sayaka by the shoulder. “You'll be home before nightfall, so please cooperate with us”—

lines.japanese:
教師のように言った。
　中肉中背が、足の方はどうするのか痩せぎすに問
いかけた。
lines.english: He spoke like a teacher. The man of average build asked the thin one what they should do about her legs.

lines.japanese:
リサーチ通り大人しいしこの調子ならテントの中
でいい、と答えた。
lines.english: The thin man said she was as docile as their research had suggested; at this rate, the tent would do.

lines.japanese:
風が吹いた。
　不自然に強い風だった。
　森の奥に届くようなものではないのだが。
lines.english: A wind blew. It was unnaturally strong. No such wind should have reached so deep into the forest.

lines.japanese:
テントに押し込まれてしまう前に、沙也加はふら
りと男の手をくぐり抜けた。
lines.english: Before they could force her into the tent, Sayaka slipped beneath the man's arm.

lines.japanese:
三人はそのあたりには警戒して、常に一人が少女
を見張っていたのだが、完全ではない瞬間があった。
lines.english: They had anticipated something like this and kept one man watching her at all times. Even so, for a single moment their vigilance faltered.

lines.japanese:
どこからか小石が飛んできて、テントを叩いたた
めだった。
lines.english: A pebble flew out of nowhere and struck the tent.

lines.japanese:
これらのテントは二重構造になっていて、それな
りの防音性があった。
lines.english: The tents were double-walled, affording a degree of soundproofing.

lines.japanese:
撤収も容易であり、底も一部であるため、体液な
どを残さない。
lines.english: They were also easy to dismantle, and the built-in floor meant no bodily fluids would be left behind.

lines.japanese:
だが間隙を突くような沙也加の動きを、それが羽
毛の散るほど緩いものであったにも関わらず、反応
することができなかった。
lines.english: Yet they failed to react as Sayaka slipped through the gap, though her movement was no quicker than a feather drifting to earth.

lines.japanese:
そのまま逃げるかと思いきや、沙也加は男たちに
向き直った。
　それで男たちも戸惑い、反応が遅れた。
lines.english: They expected her to flee. Instead, Sayaka turned to face the men. Their confusion delayed them still further.

lines.japanese:
沙也加は無表情。
　人のそれではない。
　狩猟者、そのものの、
lines.english: Sayaka's face was expressionless. Not a human one. The very face of a hunter—

lines.japanese:
血　　　　　　
　　　　　　　　分解されて、
　　　　大地に
lines.english: Blood                            broken down,           into the earth

lines.japanese: 完全に隠蔽―――
lines.english: Completely concealed—

lines.japanese:
忍は無人の校庭に駆け込む。
　気息を整える間もなく、注意を全域に向ける。
lines.english: Shinobu raced into the deserted schoolyard. Without pausing to catch his breath, he turned his attention to every part of the grounds.

lines.japanese: （……沙也加は！）
lines.english: (…Sayaka—!)

lines.japanese:
よろめき出て、回転しながら全周を視野にとらえ
ていく。
lines.english: He staggered forward, turning in a circle to take in every direction.

lines.japanese: 誰もいやしなかった。
lines.english: There was no one there.
(…What?)

lines.japanese:
何を思い、駆けてきたのか。不意に忍は動機を見
失った。
lines.english: What had he been thinking, running here? All at once, Shinobu lost sight of his own purpose.

lines.japanese: ともかく対象は存在しない。
lines.english: In any event, his target was not there.

lines.japanese:
学校の校庭は、地平の丸みさえ描けないほどの境
域に、荒野の空虚をまとっていた。
lines.english: Within borders too narrow even to trace the curve of a horizon, the schoolyard wore the emptiness of a wasteland.

lines.japanese: （予知が……外れた？）
lines.english: (My foresight… was wrong?)

lines.japanese: （それとも……運命が、変わったとでも？）
lines.english: (Or did… fate change?)
(Huh…)

lines.japanese: （なんだ……）
lines.english: (What…)

lines.japanese: （この世界……は……なんだ？）
lines.english: (This world… what… is it?)

lines.japanese: （何から、何までも、嘘みたいじゃないか）
lines.english: (Doesn't every last thing in it seem like a lie?)

lines.japanese: 頭を抱えて、膝をついた。
lines.english: He clutched his head and fell to his knees.

lines.japanese: （じゃあ彼女は、どこに行ったんだ？）
lines.english: (Then where did she go?)

lines.japanese: （誰か）
lines.english: (Someone…)

lines.japanese: 嘔吐するように叫ぶ。
lines.english: He retched out a scream.

lines.japanese: 「教えてよ―――」
lines.english: “Tell me—”
“…Whew.”

lines.japanese:
その大きなテントは多少古いが、森で寝泊まりす
る時に非常に役に立つ。
lines.english: The large tent is a little old, but enormously useful for sleeping in the woods.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の両親が子育てを放棄し、もう何年か経つ。
　今の保護者である祖母は、持病のため入退院を繰
り返す身の上で、自宅にいないことが多かった。
lines.english: It has been several years since Sayaka's parents gave up raising her. Her grandmother, now her guardian, suffers from a chronic illness and is often hospitalized, which keeps her away from home much of the time.

lines.japanese:
家政婦もいるが泊まり込みではなく、夜はたいが
い一人の時間となる。
lines.english: A housekeeper comes in but does not stay overnight, so Sayaka usually spends her nights alone.

lines.japanese:
森に寝泊まりする悪癖は、その頃に生まれた。
　なぜ森にいるのか。
lines.english: Her bad habit of sleeping in the woods dates from that time. Why the woods?

lines.japanese:
沙也加は風変わりな少女で、生来、虫や獣に怯え
ることはなかった。
lines.english: Sayaka is an unusual girl, with no instinctive fear of insects or animals.

lines.japanese:
魂の半分を妖精の世界に置いているような、そん
な少女だと言われるほどだ。
lines.english: People even say she is the sort of girl who keeps half her soul in the realm of fairies.

lines.japanese:
実際彼女にとって、もっとも落ち着ける場所は自
室ではなく、森である。
lines.english: In truth, the place she feels most at peace is not her bedroom, but the woods.

lines.japanese:
落ち着く……安息の地、と換言してもいい。
　ただここだけが心休めることのできる聖地だとし
たら、少女が足繁く通う理由としては充分だ。
lines.english: At peace… a place of repose, perhaps. If this is the one sacred place where her heart can rest, that alone is reason enough for the girl to return so often.

lines.japanese:
森は全てから沙也加を守った。
ここに暮らせば、いつまでも生きていける気がした。
lines.english: The woods protect Sayaka from everything. She feels she could live forever if she made her home here.

lines.japanese:
テントの中には、ペットボトルの水や菓子・食物
類・寝具・その他生活用具も蓄積されている。
lines.english: Inside the tent she has stockpiled bottled water, sweets and other food, bedding, and assorted necessities.

lines.japanese:
登山用の携帯コンロを用いての、簡単な調理も覚
えた。
lines.english: She has even learned to cook simple meals on a portable camping stove.

lines.japanese:
それまで沙也加はインスタントの乾燥麺など口に
したことはなかった。
lines.english: Before this, Sayaka had never tasted instant noodles or anything like them.

lines.japanese:
大衆食と言うよりむしろ粗食の類だ。
　実家で食卓にのぼることはない。
lines.english: This is not so much common fare as plain subsistence food. Nothing like it ever appears on the table at home.

lines.japanese:
が、案外この食品は、栄養バランスが整っている
のだ。
lines.english: Surprisingly, though, this sort of food is nutritionally well balanced.

lines.japanese:
唯一の気がかりは入浴ができないことだったが、
もとより新陳代謝が鈍いのか、一日二日程度なら別
段不都合を感じたりはしない。
lines.english: Her only concern is that she cannot bathe, but perhaps her metabolism is naturally slow; a day or two without a bath causes no particular discomfort.

lines.japanese:
それに自宅に戻れば、行水くらいはいつでもでき
るのだ。
lines.english: Besides, whenever she returns home, she can always take a quick bath.

lines.japanese:
まだ幼い少女に過ぎない沙也加だが、森暮らしに
ついてはだいぶ吹っ切った状態にある。
lines.english: Though still only a young girl, Sayaka has largely made her peace with living in the woods.

lines.japanese:
学校を卒業したら、森に住もう。
　本気でそう考えたことある。
　いや、今でもまだ胸に抱いている。
lines.english: Once I graduate from school, I'll live in the woods. She has considered it in all seriousness. No—even now, she still nurses that dream.

lines.japanese:
老いた親類同士で祖母宅に集まって暮らそうとい
う計画がある。
lines.english: Several of her elderly relatives plan to move into her grandmother's home and live together.

lines.japanese:
祖母の希望でもあり、子供らに巣立たれ伴侶も失
った本堂の女たちの都合とも合致する。
lines.english: The arrangement suits both her grandmother's wishes and the Hondou women, whose children have left the nest and who have lost their spouses.

lines.japanese:
もちろん沙也加のことが引き金になっているのだ
が、おそらくは保護者がわりとなるだろう彼女たち
をどう説得するかは、いまだに答えの見つからない
lines.english: Sayaka's situation is, of course, what set the plan in motion. But how she will persuade the women who are likely to become her guardians remains a question with no

lines.japanese: 問題である。
lines.english: answer.

lines.japanese:
テントでの寝泊まりは心地よいが、たまに木々の
隙間から夜空を見上げたくなる。
lines.english: Sleeping in the tent is comfortable, but sometimes she wants to gaze up through the trees at the night sky.

lines.japanese:
表に出た。
　見上げれば、雄大な、黒。
　感動的な光景に違いない。
lines.english: She steps outside. Above her: a magnificent blackness. Surely a sight to move the heart.

lines.japanese:
それを味わいたいと沙也加は思った。
　沙也加の全てで、感受すべきだと判断した。
　少女はテントに潜り、荷物から鍵束を取り出した。
lines.english: Sayaka decides she wants to savor it. She ought to take it in with her whole being. The girl ducks into the tent and takes a ring of keys from her belongings.

lines.japanese: それだけを持って森を出る。
lines.english: Carrying nothing else, she leaves the woods.

lines.japanese:
森を出ると少し肌寒い。
　上着を持ってこなかったことを少し後悔しつつ、
歩みは止めない。
lines.english: Outside the woods, the air is a little chilly. She regrets not bringing a jacket, but keeps walking.

lines.japanese:
無人の学校に辿り着く。
　ひそかに作った合い鍵を用いて、裏門から侵入し、
飼育小屋を開く。
lines.english: She reaches the deserted school. Using a duplicate key she made in secret, she slips in through the rear gate and opens the animal shed.

lines.japanese:
ブチとマルは起きていた。
　大きめのケージを引っ張り出すと、二羽は自らそ
の中に入る。
lines.english: Spot and Roly are awake. When she pulls out a large cage, both rabbits enter on their own.

lines.japanese:
重みを増したケージを両手で持ち、来た道を引き
返す。
lines.english: She takes the now-heavier cage in both hands and retraces her steps.

lines.japanese:
森遊びをする時の起床はだいたい四時だ。
　すぐに返却に来れば、ばれることはない。
lines.english: When she spends the night in the woods, she usually wakes around four. If she brings them back promptly, no one will notice.

lines.japanese:
実際、この手で今まで何度か同じことをしたこと
があった。
lines.english: In fact, she has done the same thing several times before.

lines.japanese:
そもそも明日は日曜日だ。
　ずっと一緒にいても良いのである。
lines.english: Besides, tomorrow is Sunday. They can spend the entire day together.

lines.japanese:
テントに戻る。
　さすがに少し汗ばむ。
　ケージを開くと、二羽はのそのそと出てきた。
lines.english: She returns to the tent. By now, even she is perspiring a little. When she opens the cage, the two rabbits lumber out.

lines.japanese: 鼻を膨らませて森の臭いを取り込んだ。
lines.english: Their nostrils flare as they breathe in the scent of the woods.
“…Hehe.”

lines.japanese: その仕草が愛らしく、沙也加は幸せな気分になった。
lines.english: The sight is so adorable that Sayaka feels a swell of happiness.

lines.japanese:
兎たちの行動を観察しながら、お湯を沸かす。
　湯で手ぬぐいを絞り、裸になって体を丁寧にぬぐ
った。
lines.english: Watching the rabbits explore, she boils water. She wrings out a washcloth in the hot water, undresses, and carefully wipes herself clean.

lines.japanese:
寝袋を外にせり出させ、仰向けで寝た。
　やがて兎たちが、テントの中、沙也加の足下にひ
っついて丸くなる。
lines.english: She pushes her sleeping bag partway out of the tent and lies on her back. Before long, the rabbits curl up inside the tent, nestled against her feet.

lines.japanese:
心が豊かな人間は、もっといろいろなものを日々
に感じられるのだろうか。
lines.english: Do people with rich inner lives find more to feel in each passing day?

lines.japanese:
無味無臭の日々を思うと、沙也加は意識が遠のき
そうになる。
lines.english: When Sayaka thinks of her flavorless, odorless days, she feels her consciousness threatening to slip away.

lines.japanese: 自分がどう生きていけばいいのか、わからなくなる。
lines.english: She no longer knows how she ought to live.

lines.japanese:
どうせ……長くはないのだ。
　予感である。
　人としての日々は、そんなには続かない。
lines.english: Either way… she does not have long. It is a premonition. Her days as a human being will not last much longer.

lines.japanese:
内面を省みればよくわかる。
　せめて、と祈る。
lines.english: One look within herself tells her as much. She has one prayer, at least:

lines.japanese:
決定的な破局が訪れる前に、ブチとマルが天寿を
全うし、そして―――
lines.english: That Spot and Roly may live out their natural lives before the decisive rupture comes, and then—

lines.japanese:
平坦な心のまま、死ぬことができれば、と。
　睡魔にとらわれる直前、少年の顔が脳裏をよぎった。
lines.english: that she may die with her heart still level and smooth. Just before sleep claims her, a boy's face crosses her mind.

lines.japanese:
あるいは彼は、引導を渡してくれるのではないか？
　いや、むしろ―――
lines.english: Might he perhaps be the one to put an end to her? No. Rather—

lines.japanese:
日曜日である。
　昼前。
　貴宮忍から、呼び出しを受けている。
lines.english: Sunday. Just before noon. Shinobu Atemiya has summoned her.

lines.japanese:
彼については思うことがありすぎて困るほどだが、
いくら頭を使っても画餅に帰すだけであると見切り
をつけ、全て放棄してしまった。
lines.english: There is almost too much to think about where he is concerned, but she has concluded that no amount of thought will yield anything but empty fancies and has abandoned the whole business.

lines.japanese:
とにかく、忍は沙也加を求めた。
　接吻も強要された。
lines.english: Whatever else might be true, Shinobu wanted Sayaka. He had even forced a kiss on her.

lines.japanese:
赤面する。
　こんな時ばかりは、沙也加も等身大の少女だ。
　近くに廃工場を見付けたのだと言った。
lines.english: She blushes. At moments like this, even Sayaka is simply a girl her age. He said he had found an abandoned factory nearby.

lines.japanese:
忍が集めたのか知らないが、奇妙なメンバーとと
もに、そこを視察に行くのである。
lines.english: She is going to inspect it with a strange group of people, though she does not know whether Shinobu brought them together.

lines.japanese:
二羽はまだテントの中で寝ている。
　少女の意図を汲む彼女らは、森ではみだりに出歩
かない。
lines.english: The two rabbits are still asleep in the tent. Understanding the girl's intentions, they do not roam carelessly through the woods.

lines.japanese:
また森の方もこの兎については手を出すことはな
いはずだった。
lines.english: Nor, for its part, should the woods lay a hand on these particular rabbits.

lines.japanese: 忍らにつきあい、自宅に戻り家政婦に顔を見せる。
lines.english: She will go with Shinobu and the others, then return home and check in with the housekeeper.

lines.japanese:
そしてまたテントに戻ってこよう、と沙也加は考
えた。
lines.english: After that, Sayaka thinks, she will come back to the tent.

lines.japanese: 明日の早朝に兎を戻し、また学校生活である。
lines.english: She will return the rabbits early tomorrow morning, then go back to her school routine.

lines.japanese:
少量の水に乾草・ペレットなどを皿に盛り、沙也
加はテントを出た。
lines.english: She leaves out a little water and plates of dry hay, pellets, and the like, then leaves the tent.

lines.japanese:
たくさんの予定を消化し、軽い疲労を背負って、
森を歩いていた。
lines.english: Her many errands behind her, she walks through the woods with only a trace of fatigue.

lines.japanese: 家政婦が夕方のうちに帰宅したのは幸いだった。
lines.english: Fortunately, the housekeeper had gone home before the evening was over.

lines.japanese:
用意された夕食を片づけ、入浴を済ませ、新しい
着替えを持って家を出た。
lines.english: Sayaka finished the dinner left for her, bathed, and left the house with fresh clothes.

lines.japanese:
あとは森を感じながらのんびりと過ごそう、と考
えていた。
lines.english: All that remained, she thought, was to spend a quiet evening feeling the woods around her.

lines.japanese:
侵入者の気配に、血が凍る。
　珍しく蒼惶と足をもつれさせ、脇道の草をかき分
けて直線に進んだ。
lines.english: The presence of intruders turns her blood to ice. In a rare panic, she stumbles forward, tearing through the grass beside the path in a straight line.

lines.japanese:
空気が濁っている。
　これは人間のにおいだ。
　嫌な予感がする。
lines.english: The air is clouded. This is the smell of human beings. She has a terrible feeling.

lines.japanese:
テントのそばまで接近すると、空気どころか明確
に会話が耳に入った。
lines.english: As she nears the tent, she no longer merely senses it in the air: she can clearly hear voices.

lines.japanese: テントの中に誰かいる！
lines.english: Someone is inside the tent!

lines.japanese: 「……なんか食い物いっぱいあんぜ？」
lines.english: “…There's a ton of food in here.”

lines.japanese: 「ホームレスかな？」
lines.english: “Think it belongs to some homeless guy?”

lines.japanese: 「人いねーけど」
lines.english: “Nobody's here.”

lines.japanese: 「なーんかいい匂いすんだよな……」
lines.english: “Something smells really good…”

lines.japanese:
「水に、なにコレ、コンロ？　かんっぺき住んでる
　わ」
lines.english: “Water, and what's this, a stove? Somebody's totally living here.”

lines.japanese: 複数の少年だった。
lines.english: There are several boys.

lines.japanese: 「あ、なんか服……女の服だ」
lines.english: “Hey, clothes… A girl's clothes.”

lines.japanese: 「パンツあんじゃん」
lines.english: “There are panties in here.”

lines.japanese:
意識が軋みかけたが、かろうじて持ち直した。
　大切なことも思い出す。
　ブチとマル。
lines.english: Her consciousness creaks, nearly buckling, but somehow rights itself. She remembers what matters. Spot and Roly.

lines.japanese: こんな時の対応を教育してはいなかった。
lines.english: She had never trained them for anything like this.

lines.japanese:
テントの中にいないということは、
　自主的に逃げた可能性は、
　まだ見つかっていないという可能性は、
lines.english: If they are not inside the tent, perhaps they fled on their own, perhaps they have not been found yet—

lines.japanese: 非論理的な思考が反芻された。
lines.english: She turns the illogical thoughts over and over.

lines.japanese: 「この兎ってうちの学校のじゃねぇ？」
lines.english: “Hey, isn't this one of our school's rabbits?”

lines.japanese: ブチの耳を握り持ち、宗多がテントから出てきた。
lines.english: Holding Spot by the ears, Souta steps out of the tent.

lines.japanese:
呼応して、向こう側からさらに数人の少年がやっ
てくる。
lines.english: As if in response, several more boys approach from the far side.

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだわ、これ」
lines.english: “Oh yeah, it is.”

lines.japanese: 「なんつったっけ名前？」
lines.english: “What was its name again?”

lines.japanese: この少年たちが外で何をしていたのか気になった。
lines.english: She wonders what these boys have been doing outside.

lines.japanese: 「狩りは？」
lines.english: “How'd the hunt go?”

lines.japanese: 「大・成・功ー！」
lines.english: “A com-plete suc-cess!”

lines.japanese:
少年たちが、スリングショットやらエアガンやら
をかざした。
lines.english: The boys brandish slingshots, air guns, and the like.

lines.japanese: 「どうよ？」
lines.english: “Whaddaya think?”

lines.japanese:
もう一人が、ソレを持ち上げた。
　血まみれになってだらりと四肢を投げ出した、
ブチだった。
lines.english: Another boy lifts it into view. Limbs dangling, drenched in blood— Spot.

lines.japanese:
「やめろぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉ
　ぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉぉっ！！」
lines.english: “STOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO OOOOOOOOOOOOOOP!!”

lines.japanese:
雄叫びをあげて、沙也加は少年たちにつかみかか
った。
lines.english: With a roar, Sayaka lunges for the boys.

lines.japanese: 一瞬で、宗多の顔に喜色が広がる。
lines.english: Delight floods Souta's face in an instant.

lines.japanese: 「こいつだ！　ここの住人！」
lines.english: “It's her! She lives here!”

lines.japanese:
手にしたマルを放り投げた。
　沙也加に。
lines.english: He hurls Roly from his hand. Straight at Sayaka.

lines.japanese:
つんのめるように足を止め、受け取る。
　胸元に抱きしめた。
　温かい。まだ生きてる。
lines.english: She stumbles to a halt and catches her. Clutches her to her chest. Warm. Still alive.

lines.japanese:
だが震えていた。
　おもしろ半分に仲間を殺害した少年たちにものの
ように扱われ、萎縮し、失禁していた。
lines.english: But Roly is trembling. The boys had killed her companion for sport and treated her like a thing; cowed, she had wet herself.

lines.japanese:
だから宗多は耳を持ったのだ―――
　直感で悟った。
lines.english: That is why Souta held her by the ears— Sayaka understands instinctively.

lines.japanese: 「マル、マル……」
lines.english: “Roly. Roly…”

lines.japanese: 敵を忘れるべきではなかった。
lines.english: She should not have forgotten the enemy.

lines.japanese: 「オラッ！」
lines.english: “Take this!”

lines.japanese:
鋭く重い飛び蹴りが、沙也加の抱きしめたその腕
を、とらえた。
lines.english: A sharp, heavy flying kick strikes Sayaka's arms where they cradle the rabbit.

lines.japanese: 腕の中で、折れて潰れるのがわかった。
lines.english: She feels something break and crumple within her arms.

lines.japanese:
瞬間、脳内に無数の断線が起こる。
　無痛の、激痛。
　マルが口元から血のあぶくを吐いた。
lines.english: In that instant, countless circuits snap inside her brain. Agony without pain. Bloody foam spills from Roly's mouth.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の喉から、細く長い金切り声がほとばしる。
　それに、宗多をはじめとする少年たちの哄笑が重
なり、不協和音を奏でた。
lines.english: A thin, protracted shriek tears from Sayaka's throat. The laughter of Souta and the other boys overlaps it to form a dissonant chord.

lines.japanese: 「うわ、うわぁぁぁぁ―――ダメ、ダメ―――！！」
lines.english: “Aah, aaaah—don't, don't—!!”

lines.japanese:
マルが聞いたことのない、濁った悲鳴を切れ切れ
に発しながら、血と糞便を垂れ流した。
　それを見て少年たちがさらに盛大に笑う。
lines.english: Roly gives broken, guttural screams unlike anything Sayaka has ever heard, voiding blood and feces. At the sight, the boys laugh louder than ever.
“Ah, ah, ah—”

lines.japanese:
崩壊していく。
　最初は黒い粒。
　急激に拡大し、全てを呑んでいく。
lines.english: Everything collapses. At first, a black speck. It swells with terrible speed and consumes all things.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の心の中にだけ投影されたイメージは、あ
りとあらゆる心の機構を浸しつつ、やがて津波の響
きをともなって全てをかき消した。
lines.english: An image projected in Sayaka's mind alone floods every mechanism of her heart until, with the sound of a tsunami, it finally erases everything.

lines.japanese:
痛嘆も、喪失も、激怒も、一切合切に撹拌し、得
体の知れない粘液。
lines.english: Grief, loss, fury—all of it churned together into some nameless slime.

lines.japanese: 虚無の泥濘を、一匹の蟲が泳ぐ様子をイメージした。
lines.english: She imagines a single insect swimming through the mire of nothingness.

lines.japanese:
時間をかけ、マルは苦しみながら死んだ。
　蟲は黒の水面に浮き上がり、裏側になって震え、
膨張していき、風船のように膨大し―――最後には。
lines.english: Roly dies slowly, in agony. The insect rises to the black surface, turns onto its back, trembles, and swells, ballooning to immensity—until at last.

lines.japanese:
兎は体を潰されへし折られた。
　目の前で。
　網膜に。
lines.english: The rabbit's body is crushed and broken. Before her eyes. Upon her retina.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の心象領域が、急激に開ける。
　森と同じサイズになった。
lines.english: Sayaka's mental-image domain abruptly expands. It becomes the size of the woods.

lines.japanese:
木々の隙間、朽ち葉の底で起きている、ありとあ
らゆるバクテリアの活動、自然の道理を見た。
lines.english: She sees every bacterial process at work between the trees and beneath the dead leaves. She sees the laws of nature.

lines.japanese:
沙也加は森と一体となる。
　いや……もとからそういった機能はあったのだ。
lines.english: Sayaka becomes one with the woods. No… she had always possessed that function.

lines.japanese:
ただ使わなかっただけ。
　使い方がわからないから、たいしたことはできな
かった。
lines.english: She simply never used it. Not knowing how, she had never been able to do anything significant.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の住まう、回線の濁った外界では、なおの
こと。
lines.english: All the less so in the outside world that Sayaka inhabits, where the lines are clouded with noise.

lines.japanese:
だがここは森である。
　莫大な情報が、沙也加の内外に極小タイムラグで
やりとりされる。
lines.english: But here she is in the woods. Vast quantities of information pass between Sayaka's interior and exterior with an infinitesimal time lag.

lines.japanese:
少年が沙也加をスリングで狙った。
　弾丸が額に当たり、皮膚が裂けて血が出た。
　反応のない少女を、宗多は蹴倒した。
lines.english: A boy aims his slingshot at Sayaka. The pellet strikes her forehead, splitting the skin and drawing blood. When the girl does not react, Souta kicks her to the ground.

lines.japanese: 「ごちそうを食わせろ！」
lines.english: “Make her eat the feast!”

lines.japanese:
無数の手に押さえつけられる。
　そのうちのいくつかが、意図的に胸や股間をまさ
ぐったことも、さして気にならなかった。
lines.english: Countless hands pin her down. It barely registers that some of them are deliberately groping her chest and between her legs.

lines.japanese:
地べたに落ちたマルの骸を、誰かがシャベルで拾
った。
lines.english: Someone scoops Roly's corpse off the ground with a shovel.

lines.japanese: もはや素手で触る気もないのだ。
lines.english: They no longer even want to touch it with their bare hands.

lines.japanese: ごちそう。ごちそう。
lines.english: A feast. A feast.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の顔に何かが落ちてくる。
　マルだった。
lines.english: Something drops onto Sayaka's face. Roly.

lines.japanese: 「押し込め！」
lines.english: “Shove it in!”

lines.japanese: ようやく我に返る。
lines.english: Only then does she return to herself.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううう、うっ！！」
lines.english: “Nn, nnngh, nn!!”

lines.japanese:
暴れるが、すでに身体は自由にならない。
　骸の一部が口内に押し込まれる。
　血の味を噛みしめながら、沙也加は思った。
lines.english: She thrashes, but her body is already pinned. Part of the corpse is forced into her mouth. With the taste of blood between her teeth, Sayaka thinks.

lines.japanese: おまえらみんな、肉になって死んでしまえ―――
lines.english: Every last one of you, turn to meat and die—

lines.japanese:
もはや人であることを拒絶した理性の切片が、す
べて終わりだと告げていた。
lines.english: A fragment of reason that has already renounced humanity tells her that everything is over.

lines.japanese: 意識の底から、途轍もなく重い理念が浮上してきた。
lines.english: From the depths of consciousness, an impossibly heavy idea rises.

lines.japanese:
血肉の海だった。
　慄然とした思いで、その現実を直視する。
lines.english: A sea of flesh and blood. Horror-struck, Shinobu confronts the reality before him.

lines.japanese:
感情は平気でも濃密すぎる匂いが、忍の食道に不
快な蠕動運動を催させた。
lines.english: His mind stays calm, but the smell is so thick that it sets off an unpleasant peristaltic spasm in his esophagus.

lines.japanese: 「沙也加……」
lines.english: “Sayaka…”

lines.japanese: 「……はぁ、はぁ、はぁ」
lines.english: “…Hah, hah, hah.”

lines.japanese: 大木を背にして、呼吸が荒い。
lines.english: Her back against a great tree, she breathes raggedly.

lines.japanese: 「君が、やったのか」
lines.english: “Did you do this?”

lines.japanese: 「これを……」
lines.english: “All this…”

lines.japanese:
信じがたいものを見る目で、丹念に引きちぎられ
た人体の見本市を眺めた。
lines.english: He surveys a grisly exhibition of human bodies, painstakingly torn apart, unable to believe his eyes.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の聖域は、もはや血まみれ臓物まみれ。
　何人かのうめき声が聞こえる。
　忍は寄った。
lines.english: Sayaka's sanctuary is drenched in blood and entrails. He can hear several people moaning. Shinobu draws nearer.

lines.japanese: 「…近寄るな」
lines.english: “…Stay away.”

lines.japanese: 少女が叫ぶ。
lines.english: The girl cries out.

lines.japanese: 「どうするの？」
lines.english: “What are you going to do?”

lines.japanese:
問いかけると、沙也加は顔を上げた。
　怨色一つない、平坦な面持ち。
　喪失者のものではない。
lines.english: At the question, Sayaka raises her face. Her expression is flat, without the slightest trace of resentment. It is not the face of someone grieving a loss.

lines.japanese:
喪失の衝撃に打ちのめされ麻痺したものでもない。
　冷静で知的な、一人の、沙也加の有り様である。
lines.english: Nor is it the face of someone numbed by the shock of loss. It is simply Sayaka herself, calm and intelligent.

lines.japanese: 「私として、生きる」
lines.english: “I will live as myself.”

lines.japanese: 「こんなことがバレたら、生きては行けないね」
lines.english: “If this gets out, you won't be able to go on living.”
“…And?”

lines.japanese: 「大人がやってくるよ。この森に」
lines.english: “Adults will come here. Into these woods.”

lines.japanese: 「私に触れた者から、順番に殺すことになるわね」
lines.english: “Then I'll kill them one by one, starting with whoever touches me.”

lines.japanese: 「とてもたくさん殺せるだろうね」
lines.english: “You could probably kill a lot of them.”

lines.japanese: 「でも全員は無理だよ」
lines.english: “But not all of them.”

lines.japanese: 「そうでしょうね」
lines.english: “I suppose not.”

lines.japanese: 「でもこれが私なの」
lines.english: “But this is what I am.”

lines.japanese:
「嫌いではないけれど、虫にたかられて払い散らさ
　ないほど、優しいものでもないの」
lines.english: “I do not hate insects, but neither am I kind enough to let them swarm me without brushing them away.”

lines.japanese:
「その結果を予測できないこともないし、受け入れ
　られないこともないの」
lines.english: “I’m not incapable of predicting the consequences, nor of accepting them.”

lines.japanese: 「同じ場所にいれば、そうならずにはいられないか」
lines.english: “If you stay in one place, this is bound to happen, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「そうよ」
lines.english: “That's right.”

lines.japanese: 「だから仕方ないわ」
lines.english: “So it cannot be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「何もかも、仕方ない」
lines.english: “None of it can be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「自然なことなの」
lines.english: “It's natural.”

lines.japanese: 「ここで止めてしまえば、そうなるだろうね」
lines.english: “If this is where we stop, I suppose that's what will happen.”

lines.japanese: 眼球だけを向けてくる。
lines.english: She turns only her eyes toward him.

lines.japanese: 「僕が触っても、殺されてしまう？」
lines.english: “If I touch you, will you kill me too?”

lines.japanese: わずかの戸惑い。
lines.english: A moment's uncertainty.

lines.japanese: 「……あなたとは、対話が成立する」
lines.english: “…I can communicate with you.”

lines.japanese: 「敵対、しないなら」
lines.english: “If you don't… turn against me.”

lines.japanese: 「……殺さない」
lines.english: “…I won't kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「なら」
lines.english: “Then—”

lines.japanese: 「まず着替えて血を落とそう」
lines.english: “First, change clothes and wash off the blood.”
“You…?”

lines.japanese: 少女の瞳が開く。
lines.english: The girl's eyes widen.

lines.japanese: 「その作業はテントの中でした方がいい」
lines.english: “You'd better do that inside the tent.”

lines.japanese: 「ここは残酷すぎるから」
lines.english: “It's too cruel out here.”

lines.japanese: 「どう？」
lines.english: “How's that?”

lines.japanese: 身だしなみを整えて、沙也加が出てきた。
lines.english: Sayaka emerges, neat once more.

lines.japanese: 「いいようだね」
lines.english: “That looks better.”

lines.japanese: 「あのまま街に戻ったら、怪しまれるから」
lines.english: “People would suspect something if you went back to town like that.”

lines.japanese: 「なぜ？」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「なぜとは？」
lines.english: “Why what?”

lines.japanese: 「協力したらあなたまで同罪になる」
lines.english: “If you help me, you'll be just as guilty.”

lines.japanese:
「それに、そもそもこんな隠し事をしても通るもの
　じゃないわ」
lines.english: “Besides, there's no way a secret like this could stay hidden.”

lines.japanese: 「人間社会は死体を隠すようにはできていないの」
lines.english: “Human society isn't built to hide corpses.”

lines.japanese: 「死体はね」
lines.english: “The corpses, yes.”

lines.japanese: 「どういうこと？」
lines.english: “What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「何も質問してはならない。いいよね？」
lines.english: “You must not ask any questions. Understood?”

lines.japanese: 教え諭す口調。
lines.english: He speaks in the tone of a teacher.

lines.japanese: 「……いいわ」
lines.english: “…All right.”

lines.japanese: 「勝手に調べるのは許可だ」
lines.english: “You are free to investigate on your own.”
“Huh…?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ、行こう」
lines.english: “Come on. Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「どこに？」
lines.english: “Where?”

lines.japanese: 「兎の死体、なんとかしないと」
lines.english: “We have to do something about the rabbits' bodies.”

lines.japanese:
少年たちの死体を見て、沙也加は微妙な違和感を
覚えた。
lines.english: Looking over the boys' bodies, Sayaka senses something faintly wrong.

lines.japanese:
だがそれを具体的に指摘することはできなかった。
　記憶と照合して、確認することさえ億劫な気分だ。
　血をぬぐい着替えるのにそれなりの時間をかけた。
lines.english: But she cannot say exactly what. She cannot even bring herself to compare them against her memory. She had spent a fair amount of time wiping off the blood and changing.

lines.japanese:
あるいはその間、忍が死体に触れたのかも知れない。
　しかし何のために？
lines.english: Perhaps Shinobu touched the bodies during that interval. But for what purpose?

lines.japanese: 「気になる？」
lines.english: “Curious?”

lines.japanese: 「これ」
lines.english: “This.”

lines.japanese:
地面を指さす。
　シャツか何か、布に巻かれた膨らみが二つ。
lines.english: He points at the ground. Two bundles, wrapped in shirts or some other cloth.

lines.japanese: 「わかるよね？」
lines.english: “You understand?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたら、いいの？」
lines.english: “What… should I do?”

lines.japanese: 「こういう時は、お墓を作るでいいんだと思う」
lines.english: “I think this is when you make a grave.”

lines.japanese: 「死んだら肉よ。そんなもの感傷に過ぎない」
lines.english: “Once something dies, it's meat. A grave is nothing but sentiment.”

lines.japanese: 「感傷で、いいんだよ」
lines.english: “Sentiment is fine.”

lines.japanese: 「半身をもぎ取られたようなものなんだから」
lines.english: “It's as though half of you had been torn away.”

lines.japanese: 考えて、沙也加は頷く。
lines.english: Sayaka thinks it over, then nods.

lines.japanese: 「そうね」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は手伝う？」
lines.english: “Do you want me to help?”

lines.japanese: 「……いらない」
「シャベルはこれを使って」
lines.english: “Use this shovel.”

lines.japanese:
包みとシャベルを持って、沙也加は森の奥に消え
ていった。
lines.english: Carrying the bundles and shovel, Sayaka vanishes deep into the woods.

lines.japanese: 忍はその場にとどまった。
lines.english: Shinobu remains where he is.

lines.japanese: ほどなくして沙也加が戻ってきた。
lines.english: Before long, Sayaka returns.

lines.japanese: 「終わった？」
lines.english: “Finished?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、埋めてきたわ」
lines.english: “Yes. I buried them.”

lines.japanese: 「話、いいかな」
lines.english: “Can I say something?”

lines.japanese: 「どうぞ」
lines.english: “Go ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「まだ終わりにしたらダメだ」
lines.english: “We can't let it end here.”

lines.japanese: 「なぜ」
lines.english: “Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「まだ諦めたらダメだよ」
lines.english: “You can't give up yet.”

lines.japanese: 「だからなぜ」
lines.english: “I asked you why.”

lines.japanese: 「勿体ない」
lines.english: “It'd be a waste.”

lines.japanese: 虚を突かれ、沙也加は口を開いた。
lines.english: Caught off guard, Sayaka's mouth falls open.

lines.japanese: 「友達になって欲しい」
lines.english: “I want you to be my friend.”

lines.japanese: 「わからない」
lines.english: “I don't understand.”

lines.japanese:
「どうしてそんなことを言うのか、わたしにはまる
　で理解できない」
lines.english: “I cannot understand at all why you would say such a thing.”

lines.japanese: 「他に言葉を知らない」
lines.english: “I don't know another word for it.”

lines.japanese: 「君だって死にたいわけじゃないはずだ」
lines.english: “You can’t really want to die.”

lines.japanese: 「苦痛だとも思わないけど」
lines.english: “I don't think I'd find it painful, though.”

lines.japanese: 「守ってあげるよ」
lines.english: “I'll protect you.”

lines.japanese: 「いろいろなものから、いろいろな力で」
lines.english: “From all sorts of things, with all sorts of powers.”

lines.japanese: 「守ってあげられる」
lines.english: “I can protect you.”

lines.japanese: 少女は考え込む。
lines.english: The girl thinks it over.

lines.japanese: 「他に、たいした見返りはあげられないけど」
lines.english: “I can't give you much else in return, though.”

lines.japanese: 「おでこ、血が出てるね」
lines.english: “Your forehead's bleeding.”
“…Huh?”

lines.japanese: 忍は口を寄せ、傷口を吸った。
lines.english: Shinobu puts his mouth to the wound and sucks.

lines.japanese:
みるみるうちに少女の顔が険しくなっていく。
　少女は身を引き剥がして、忍の頬を打った。
lines.english: The girl's expression hardens by the second. She wrenches herself away and slaps Shinobu across the cheek.
“What are you doing?!”

lines.japanese: 「何って」
lines.english: “What am I doing?”

lines.japanese: 「見返り」
lines.english: “Something in return.”

lines.japanese: 「バカにしないで！」
lines.english: “Don't make fun of me!”

lines.japanese: 「いらないの？」
lines.english: “You don't want it?”

lines.japanese: 「本物の気持ちじゃない」
lines.english: “Those feelings aren't real.”

lines.japanese: 「本物って何」
lines.english: “What does ‘real’ mean?”

lines.japanese: 「どういうのを本物って言うんだい？」
lines.english: “What sort of thing would you call real?”

lines.japanese: 「冷静になって考えてごらんよ」
lines.english: “Calm down and think it through.”

lines.japanese: 両腕を広げる。
lines.english: He spreads his arms.

lines.japanese: 「だとしても……意味が、ないわ」
lines.english: “Even so… it would be meaningless.”

lines.japanese: 「それは難しい問題だから」
lines.english: “That's a difficult problem.”

lines.english: The forest. The children. His brain stirred.

lines.japanese:
なぜ忘れていたのだろう。
　そんな出来事を、記憶から失うはずがない。
lines.english: How had he forgotten? He could not possibly have lost the memory of such an event.

lines.japanese:
だというのに、忍は今はじめて見たものであるる
かのように、記録を参照していた。
lines.english: And yet Shinobu consulted the record as though seeing it for the first time.

lines.japanese: 集団失踪事件の顛末である。
lines.english: The record of how the mass disappearance case had ended.

lines.japanese: かぶりを振る。
lines.english: He shook his head.

lines.japanese: （今は）
lines.english: (Right now—)

lines.japanese: （沙也加を捜さないと）
lines.english: (I have to find Sayaka.)

lines.japanese: 今日は、あの場所にたどり着ける気がするのだ。
lines.english: Today, he felt he could reach that place.

lines.japanese: あの、光射す庭に―――
lines.english: That garden flooded with light—

lines.japanese: （そうだ！）
lines.english: (That's right!)

lines.japanese: （彼女は魔女なんかじゃない）
lines.english: (She isn't a witch!)

lines.japanese: （ずっと、そばにいたんだ！）
lines.english: (She was beside me all along!)

lines.japanese: 駆ける。
lines.english: He runs.

lines.japanese: （沙也加は誰も殺してなんかいない！）
lines.english: (Sayaka hasn't killed anyone!)

lines.japanese: 森の外では。
lines.english: Outside the forest.
“Ha—”

lines.japanese:
忍は足を止めた。
　止めざるを得なかった。
lines.english: Shinobu stopped. He had no choice.

lines.japanese:
複数人分と思われる大量の血液が、木々を濡らし
ていた。
lines.english: A vast quantity of blood, seemingly from several people, soaked the trees.
“What… is this…?”

lines.japanese:
少年が死んでいた。
　一人ではない。
　たくさん、だ。
lines.english: A boy lay dead. Not just one. There were many.

lines.japanese:
濃厚な血の臭い。
　むせかえっている。
lines.english: The thick reek of blood. It choked the air.

lines.japanese: 「新しい……」
lines.english: “Fresh…”

lines.japanese:
しゃがみこみ、骸のいくつかを調べる。
　ひどい有様だった。
lines.english: He crouched to examine several of the bodies. They were in a terrible state.

lines.japanese: 「ダメだ、完全に……」
lines.english: “No… They're gone…”

lines.japanese:
それだけではない。
　腕や足が、爆撃でも受けたかのように弾け飛んで
いる。
lines.english: And that was not all. Arms and legs had been blown apart, as if the bodies had been through a bombing raid.

lines.japanese:
飛び散った皮膚が木の幹に張りついている光景が、
衝撃的だ。
lines.english: The sight of skin plastered across the tree trunks was staggering.

lines.japanese: 臓物。特にまき散らされた腸は目立つ。
lines.english: Viscera. The intestines strewn everywhere were the most conspicuous.

lines.japanese:
砕けた骨。
　爆発物を大量かつ継続的に用いることで、このよ
うな惨状を呈することは考えられる。
lines.english: Shattered bone. Sustained, heavy use of explosives could conceivably produce a scene like this.

lines.japanese:
だが火薬が用いられたのならば、木々だって無事
ではすまない。
lines.english: But if explosives had done this, the trees would not have escaped unscathed.

lines.japanese: 「まさか……」
lines.english: “It can't be…”

lines.japanese:
嫌な予感がよぎる。
　信じたくはない。
　だが―――
lines.english: A dreadful suspicion crossed his mind. He did not want to believe it. But—

lines.japanese: 「……沙也加」
lines.english: “…Sayaka.”

lines.japanese:
間違いない。
　本堂沙也加の、魔女術である。
　拳銃が落ちていた。
lines.english: There could be no mistake. This was Sayaka Hondou's witchcraft. A handgun lay on the ground.

lines.japanese: 拾ってみると、使用された形跡がある。
lines.english: When he picked it up, he saw that it had been fired.

lines.japanese: 森の奥から、叫び声が聞こえた。
lines.english: A scream came from deep within the forest.

lines.japanese: 走りだす。
lines.english: He broke into a run.

lines.japanese: 沙也加が、見覚えのある男と対峙していた。
lines.english: Sayaka stood facing a man Shinobu recognized.

lines.japanese: 「伊勢崎……宗多！」
lines.english: “Souta… Isezaki!”

lines.japanese:
過去に舞い戻ったように感じられた。
　しかし対峙する二人は、間違いなく“今”の
沙也加と宗多だ。
lines.english: It felt as though he had been flung back into the past. Yet the two facing each other were unmistakably Sayaka and Souta as they were now.

lines.japanese:
全体を見渡す。
　周囲には、少年少女らの骸が転がっていた。
　いや、若者だけではない。
lines.english: He surveyed the scene. The bodies of boys and girls lay scattered all around. No—not only the young.

lines.japanese:
大人の姿もいくつか見られる。
　全員、生きながら撹拌されたも同然の、惨たらし
い骸をさらしている。
lines.english: Several adults lay among them. Every body was horribly mangled, as though churned apart while still alive.

lines.japanese: 宗多だけが生きていた。
lines.english: Souta alone was alive.

lines.japanese:
近寄れる雰囲気ではない。
　宗多は沙也加に銃を向けている。
　数メートル。
lines.english: He couldn't just walk up to them. Souta had a gun trained on Sayaka. A few meters separated them.

lines.japanese:
宗多の腕なら、外れる距離ではない。
　どう行動すべきか、忍は身を潜めたまま検討した。
　森の中では何もできない。
lines.english: At that range, a shot from Souta could not miss. Still hidden, Shinobu weighed his options. Here in the forest, he was powerless.

lines.japanese:
我が身一つだけが頼りだ。
　が、まずは沙也加から銃口をはがさなければ。
　違和感を受けた。
lines.english: He had nothing but his own body to rely on. First, though, he had to get the gun pointed away from Sayaka. Something felt wrong.

lines.japanese:
銃を突きつけている宗多の方が、興奮と恐怖に喘
いでいる。
lines.english: It was Souta—the one holding the gun—who gasped with fear and agitation.

lines.japanese:
沙也加は衣服はズタズタであるが、怪我一つして
いない。
lines.english: Sayaka's clothes were in tatters, but she did not have so much as a scratch.

lines.japanese: 怯えている様子もない。
lines.english: Nor did she seem afraid.

lines.japanese: 「……てめぇ……この、化け物が……」
lines.english: “…You… You fucking monster…”

lines.japanese: 「全員やっちまいやがった……ハ、ハハ」
lines.english: “You killed every last one of them… Ha. Hahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「もう終わりだ。俺たちも、てめぇも！」
lines.english: “It's over! For us—and for you!”

lines.japanese:
「みんな死んじまうんだ！　抵抗なんざ無意味なん
　だよ。誰もおまえを許さない……たとえ俺を殺っ
　ても、もうおしまいだよ、本堂！」
lines.english: “Everybody's going to die! Fighting back is fucking pointless. No one's ever going to forgive you… Even if you kill me, you're finished, Hondou!”

lines.japanese: 「……言いたいことは、それでおしまい？」
lines.english: “…Is that all you have to say?”

lines.japanese: 静かに問いかける。
lines.english: She asked quietly.

lines.japanese: 「ああっ！？」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: 「無意味と言ったわね」
lines.english: “You called it pointless.”

lines.japanese: 「それはおまえのことよ」
lines.english: “That's what you are.”

lines.japanese: 「有象無象」
lines.english: “Just another face in the rabble.”

lines.japanese: 「……本堂ぉぉ」
lines.english: “…Hondoooo…”

lines.japanese:
脅しつけるため銃を構え直す。
　しかし沙也加は動じない。
lines.english: He raised the gun again, trying to intimidate her. Sayaka did not flinch.

lines.japanese: 「俺の、俺の隊を……」
lines.english: “My… my unit…”

lines.japanese: 「雑種の群れが」
lines.english: “A pack of mongrels.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせぇ！」
lines.english: “Shut up!”

lines.japanese: 引き金を、宗多は引けない。
lines.english: Souta could not pull the trigger.

lines.japanese: 何度も試そうとするが、指が動かない。
lines.english: He tried again and again, but his finger would not move.

lines.japanese: 「塵芥。人間遊びをしましょう」
lines.english: “Filth. Let's play at being human.”

lines.japanese: 幼子に対するような砕けた申し出。揺るぎない殺意。
lines.english: An offhand invitation, the sort one might make to a small child. Unwavering intent to kill.

lines.japanese:
銃口が動く。
　自らの爪先に。
lines.english: The muzzle swung toward his own toes.

lines.japanese: 「て、てめぇぇぇぇっ！？」
lines.english: “Y-you bastard!?”

lines.japanese:
今度は引き金が動いた。
　動作不良も起こさず、銃弾は宗多の爪先を吹き飛
ばす。
lines.english: This time, the trigger moved. The gun did not jam. The bullet blew off Souta's toes.

lines.japanese: 「ガッ！」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: 直立が困難になり、宗多は尻をつく形で倒れた。
lines.english: Unable to stand, Souta toppled backward onto his backside.

lines.japanese:
コントロールの戻った銃口を、再度沙也加に合わ
せる。
lines.english: The moment he regained control, he trained the gun on Sayaka again.

lines.japanese: 「てめぇ……人の体を乗っ取れるのか！」
lines.english: “You… You can take over somebody's body!?”

lines.japanese: 一瞬で脂汗の浮いた額が、宗多の苦痛を示す。
lines.english: A greasy sheen of sweat broke out across his forehead, betraying his agony.

lines.japanese:
「あの時、見逃されたことも忘れ、同じことを繰り
　返す」
lines.english: “You've forgotten that you were spared that time, only to make the very same mistake again.”

lines.japanese: 「まるでそう規定されているよう」
lines.english: “As though it had been prescribed.”

lines.japanese:
「……わけわかんねぇこと……言ってんじゃねぇぞ
　……クソ魔女」
lines.english: “…Don't spout shit… that doesn't make any sense, you fucking witch…”

lines.japanese:
おぼろな眼光が、地べたを這いずる少年に照射さ
れる。
lines.english: Her unfocused gaze settled on the boy crawling through the dirt.

lines.japanese:
銃口が動く。
　今度は、自らの頭を。
lines.english: The muzzle moved. This time, toward his own head.

lines.japanese: 「お……おお……ヤメロッ、ヤメロ！！」
lines.english: “N… no… STOP! STOP!!”

lines.japanese:
恐怖に震えながら、沙也加を睨む眼球には憎悪が
たぎる。
lines.english: Even trembling with terror, he glared at Sayaka with hatred boiling in his eyes.

lines.japanese:
忍は姿を露出させた。
　血濡れた草木を踏みしめながら。
lines.english: Shinobu stepped into view, treading through blood-soaked brush.

lines.japanese: 「よすんだ、沙也加」
lines.english: “Stop, Sayaka.”

lines.japanese: 「……このまま見ているのかと思った」
lines.english: “…I wondered if you meant to keep watching.”

lines.japanese:
気付いていたらしい。
　驚くには値しない。
lines.english: Apparently she had noticed him. Hardly surprising.

lines.japanese: 「やめよう、本当の魔女になってしまうことはない」
lines.english: “Let's stop. You don't have to become a real witch.”

lines.japanese: 「もう遅いわ」
lines.english: “It's too late.”
“…But—”

lines.japanese: 「たくさん殺したもの」
lines.english: “I've killed so many.”

lines.japanese:
喜々として沙也加は告げた。
　目は笑っていなかった。
lines.english: Sayaka said it with evident delight. Her eyes were not smiling.

lines.japanese: 「この子たち、私を捕まえにきたのよ」
lines.english: “These children came to capture me.”

lines.japanese: 「ここがどういう場所か、知りもしないで」
lines.english: “Without even knowing what sort of place this is.”

lines.japanese: 「……普通は、知らないよ」
lines.english: “…Most people wouldn't know.”

lines.japanese: 「君の場所だとは」
lines.english: “That it belongs to you.”

lines.japanese: 「知っている者もいたようだけど」
lines.english: “Some of them seemed to.”

lines.japanese: 意味深な視線を忍に向ける。
lines.english: She gave Shinobu a pointed look.

lines.japanese: 「……沙也加。なぜこんなことを？」
lines.english: “…Sayaka. Why did you do this?”

lines.japanese: 「なぜ問うの？」
lines.english: “Why ask?”

lines.japanese: 「知っているはず」
lines.english: “You should know.”

lines.japanese: 「言葉で聞きたい」
lines.english: “I want to hear you say it.”

lines.japanese: 「……結局あなたは、私の自律を求めた」
lines.english: “…In the end, you wanted me to be autonomous.”

lines.japanese:
「外界での日々が、私を支配する好機だったにも関
　わらず……あなたはそうしなかった」
lines.english: “Our days in the outside world gave you every chance to control me, and yet… you chose not to.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、忍。長い時間が過ぎたわね」
lines.english: “Shinobu. It has been a long time, hasn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「何年になるかしら」
lines.english: “How many years has it been?”

lines.japanese:
「あなたが私をがんじがらめに封印してから、何年
　になるかしら？」
lines.english: “How many years since you bound me hand and foot and sealed me away?”

lines.japanese: 沙也加は笑っていた。
lines.english: Sayaka was smiling.

lines.japanese:
「従順なペットとして過ごし数年……もう、私を縛
　り付ける枷はなくなった」
lines.english: “I spent years as an obedient pet… and now the shackles that bound me are gone.”

lines.japanese:
「あなたが、私への介入を拒んだ時点で、もうなく
　なった」
lines.english: “They disappeared the moment you refused to intervene.”

lines.japanese: 「……それは枷じゃなかったんだ」
lines.english: “…They weren't shackles.”

lines.japanese: 「私には枷だったのよ」
lines.english: “They were to me.”

lines.japanese: 「言ったはずよ。こういうものだって」
lines.english: “I told you. This is what I am.”

lines.japanese: 「君を尊重しただけだ」
lines.english: “All I did was respect you.”

lines.japanese: 「尊重などいらなかった」
lines.english: “I never wanted your respect.”

lines.japanese:
「その甘さが、この結果を生むことも私は何度とな
　く話した」
lines.english: “I warned you time and again that your leniency would lead to exactly this.”

lines.japanese: 「最後まで、決断しなかったわね」
lines.english: “You never decided. Not even at the very end.”

lines.japanese: 「……お馬鹿さん」
lines.english: “…You little fool.”

lines.japanese:
怨じ笑う。
　決して負い目ではなかったはずだが、忍は気圧さ
れ目線を外すことになった。
lines.english: She gave him a bitter smile, full of reproach. Surely this was nothing to feel guilty about, yet Shinobu was cowed into looking away.

lines.japanese: 「とにかくもう殺さないで欲しい」
lines.english: “Just please don't kill anyone else.”

lines.japanese: 「それは命令？」
lines.english: “Is that an order?”

lines.japanese: 「お願いだ」
lines.english: “It's a request.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、きけない」
lines.english: “Then I cannot oblige.”

lines.japanese: 「もう私たちは別々の道を歩み出すのだから」
lines.english: “Because you and I are setting out on separate paths now.”

lines.japanese:
朗唱するように沙也加は告げる。
　森の枝が、彼女に対する礼讃で揺れた。
lines.english: Sayaka spoke as though reciting verse. The branches of the forest stirred in adoration of her.

lines.japanese: 「沙也加！」
lines.english: “Sayaka!”

lines.japanese: 宗多が身を乗り出して叫んだ。
lines.english: Souta leaned forward and shouted.

lines.japanese:
「てめぇにかばわれる俺じゃねぇ！
　すっこんでろ優等生！　てめぇの前でこの女、
　犯して殺して―――」
lines.english: “I don’t need you protecting me! Stay the fuck out of this, honor student! Right in front of you, I’ll rape her, then kill her—”

lines.japanese:
宗多の腕が爆ぜた。
　腹の底から絞られた、激痛の呻き。
lines.english: Souta's arm burst apart. From deep in his gut came a groan of pure agony.

lines.japanese: 「騒がしい。次は舌をはじくわよ」
lines.english: “How noisy. Next time I'll burst your tongue.”
“Guh…”

lines.japanese: 「わずかな余生、静かに過ごすことね」
lines.english: “Spend what little life you have left in silence.”

lines.japanese: 「沙也加、頼む」
lines.english: “Sayaka, please.”

lines.japanese: 「諦めなさい。もう私は敵よ、忍」
lines.english: “Give up. I'm your enemy now, Shinobu.”

lines.japanese:
忍は唇を噛む。
　光射す庭。
　血に暮れる墓標。
lines.english: Shinobu bit his lip. A garden flooded with light. A grave marker sinking into blood.

lines.japanese:
沙也加の聖域。
　宗多が地面を這いずり、沙也加から逃れようとし
ている。
lines.english: Sayaka's sanctuary. Souta crawled over the ground, trying to get away from her.

lines.japanese: 沙也加は軽やかな足取りで、前に立ちふさがった。
lines.english: Sayaka stepped lightly ahead of him and blocked his path.
“Y… you—”

lines.japanese: 「聞きなさい」
lines.english: “Listen.”
“Huh…?”

lines.japanese: 「私はおまえを許さない」
lines.english: “I will never forgive you.”

lines.japanese: 「許すなよ、ビッチが」
lines.english: “Then don't, bitch.”

lines.japanese: 「私がおまえを憎む理由がある。思い出しなさい」
lines.english: “I have a reason to hate you. Remember it.”

lines.japanese: 「んだぁ……？　てめぇと俺に、何の関係が……」
lines.english: “What…? What the hell could you and I possibly have to do with each other…?”

lines.japanese: 「あるわ」
lines.english: “We do.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえと私は同じ学校に通っていた」
lines.english: “You and I attended the same school.”

lines.japanese: 「だからどうしたってんだ！」
lines.english: “So fucking what!?”

lines.japanese: 「友達を殺した」
lines.english: “You killed my friends.”

lines.japanese:
「知らねぇよ。くせぇ股を開いて命乞いしろ。突っ
　込んだあとで俺のをしゃぶるなら、助けてやらな
　いこともねぇ」
lines.english: “I don’t give a shit. Spread your stinking legs and beg for your life. After I ram it into you, suck me off, and maybe I’ll let you live.”

lines.japanese:
この期に及んでなお強気の宗多は、死の覚悟を終
えていたのかも知れない。
lines.english: Defiant even now, Souta might already have resigned himself to death.

lines.japanese: だが―――
lines.english: But—

lines.japanese: 「ブチとマル」
lines.english: “Spot and Roly.”

lines.japanese: ぽつ、と沙也加は言う。
lines.english: Sayaka spoke the names softly.

lines.japanese: 「ブチ……と……マル？」
lines.english: “Spot… and… Roly?”

lines.japanese:
二つの名前に、宗多の表情から怒気が失せた。覚
悟も。
lines.english: At those two names, the anger drained from Souta's face. So did his resolve.
“Huh…?”

lines.japanese: ぽかんと口をあけたまま、地面を凝視している。
lines.english: He stared at the ground, mouth hanging open.

lines.japanese:
精神が揺さぶられたのか、苦痛も忘れてしまった
かのようだ。
lines.english: Perhaps his mind had been shaken; he seemed to have forgotten even the pain.

lines.japanese: やがて、
lines.english: At last—
“Rabbits…”

lines.japanese: 「記憶を拾えたようね」
lines.english: “So you found the memory.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょうど、その場所だったわね」
lines.english: “It happened on that very spot, didn't it?”

lines.japanese:
粗暴なはずの少年が、弾かれたように沙也加を見
上げた。
lines.english: The boy who had been so vicious jerked his head up at Sayaka.

lines.japanese:
恐慌寸前を思わせ、青ざめた顔。出血のせいだけ
ではない。
lines.english: His face had gone pale and seemed close to panic—and not merely from blood loss.

lines.japanese:
「私はおまえを呪った。忍が望み、一度は見逃した。
　けど、もし再起することがあるなら、忍にまた牙を
　剥くことがあるなら……」
lines.english: “I cursed you. At Shinobu's request, I spared you once. But if you ever rose again—if you ever bared your fangs at Shinobu again…”

lines.japanese: 「そのときは私のことを思い出してくれるよう――」
lines.english: “So that when you did, you would remember me—”

lines.japanese: 「呪ったわ」
lines.english: “I cursed you.”

lines.japanese: 「結果、私の望む展開になった」
lines.english: “And the result was exactly what I wanted.”

lines.japanese: 「……バカな……これは、俺の意志……」
lines.english: “…Impossible… This was my own choice…”

lines.japanese:
「なぜおまえは今、逃げようとしてその運命の場所
　に重なっているの？」
lines.english: “Then why, when you try to run away now, do you find yourself back at that fated place?”

lines.japanese:
「逃げるという選択肢を、おまえは取るようなもの
　だった？」
lines.english: “Were you ever the sort to choose to run?”

lines.japanese: 「偶然だと思えるの？」
lines.english: “Can you honestly call it coincidence?”

lines.japanese:
「考えていいわ。その頭蓋と中身が、まだ形をとど
　めているうちに」
lines.english: “You may think it over while your skull and what's inside it still hold their shape.”

lines.japanese:
「……呪った、だと？
　バカな……そんなものが……」
lines.english: “…You cursed me? That's insane… There's no such thing…”

lines.japanese: 「おまえたちが言った」
lines.english: “You were the ones who called me”

lines.japanese: 「魔女、と」
lines.english: “a witch.”

lines.japanese: 絶望の帳が、宗多の顔面を覆う。
lines.english: A curtain of despair fell across Souta's face.

lines.japanese: 「ハ、ハハ……ハハハ……」
lines.english: “Ha… Haha… Hahahaha…”

lines.japanese: 「仕組まれたのかよ、俺は……？」
lines.english: “Was it all arranged? Was I… set up?”

lines.japanese:
すると沙也加が、婉然と微笑を向けた。
　黒目の奥に、人知を越えた密度がたくわえられて
いた。闇よりも暗く。
lines.english: Then Sayaka turned an exquisite smile on him. A density beyond human comprehension had gathered behind her black eyes— darker than darkness.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ……」
lines.english: “What the hell…”

lines.japanese: 「兎じゃないか！？　たかが動物だ？」
lines.english: “They were rabbits! Nothing but animals!”

lines.japanese: 殺意も敵意もない饒舌さに、沙也加は耳を傾ける。
lines.english: Sayaka listened to his sudden torrent of words, stripped now of both hostility and murderous intent.

lines.japanese: 「う、兎なんかのために、俺をハメやがったのか！」
lines.english: “Y-you set me up over lousy rabbits!?”

lines.japanese: 「俺の貴宮に対する……俺の、俺の―――！！」
lines.english: “What I felt toward Atemiya… My… my—!!”

lines.japanese: 「友達だった」
lines.english: “They were my friends.”
“Th—”

lines.japanese: 静かで低い呟きに、宗多の勢いは打ち消される。
lines.english: Her quiet, low murmur killed Souta's momentum.

lines.japanese:
「おまえだけは、いつかくびり殺してやろうと思っ
　ていた」
lines.english: “You were the one I intended to strangle someday.”

lines.japanese: 「たかが？　たかがと言った」
lines.english: “‘Just’? You called them ‘just animals.’”

lines.japanese:
「そう、たかが動物のために、おまえは遺恨と屈辱
　を抱えたまま、無価値なまま、死んでいく」
lines.english: “Yes. For the sake of mere animals, you will die still clutching your resentment and humiliation—worthless to the end.”

lines.japanese:
「待て、待ってくれ……俺はまだ……こいつに……
　何も返せちゃいない……おまえのことは関係ない！
　どうでもいいことだったんだ……」
lines.english: “Wait… wait. I still haven't… paid him back… You have nothing to do with this! It never mattered…”

lines.japanese:
「コイツに、コイツに仕返しできりゃあ俺は
　それで―――」
lines.english: “If I could only get back at him—at him— that's all I—”

lines.japanese: 「伊勢崎宗多」
lines.english: “Souta Isezaki.”

lines.japanese:
「体制に殉じきることもなく、抗って野に下ること
　もない」
lines.english: “You neither give yourself wholly to the system nor defy it and take to the wild.”

lines.japanese: 「何者でもない、あさましい半野良」
lines.english: “A pathetic half-stray. No one at all.”

lines.japanese: 「……伏して、償え」
lines.english: “…Bow down and atone.”

lines.japanese:
複数のベクトルを持つ強大な力に巻き込まれたか
のように、少年の体がよじれた。
lines.english: The boy's body twisted as though seized by immense forces pulling in different directions.
“Not like—”

lines.japanese:
首が１８０度回転した。
　同時に、バツン、と大きな音が響いた。内側から
割けて弾けた音だった。
lines.english: His neck twisted around 180 degrees. At the same instant, a tremendous snap rang out—the sound of something splitting and bursting open from within.

lines.japanese:
伊勢崎宗多の肉体は、裏返っていた。
　皮膚が内に、臓腑が外に。
　はらわたを大地に伏せるように。
lines.english: Souta Isezaki's body had been turned inside out. Skin within, organs without. His entrails lay spread across the earth.

lines.japanese: 顔だけで天を見上げて。
lines.english: His face alone was turned toward the sky.

lines.japanese:
無感情な瞳で、蠢く臓物を眺める。
　そして忍を見て、
lines.english: She watched the writhing viscera with emotionless eyes. Then she looked at Shinobu.

lines.japanese: 「見て忍。私、仇討ちをしたわ」
lines.english: “Look, Shinobu. I avenged them.”

lines.japanese: 「約束を反故にしたことになるわね」
lines.english: “I suppose that means I broke our promise.”

lines.japanese: 「名実ともに危険人物」
lines.english: “A menace in every sense of the word.”

lines.japanese: 「掛け値ない、あなたの―――敵」
lines.english: “Your enemy, pure and simple.”

lines.japanese: 「違う」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「違わない」
lines.english: “I am.”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ、サヤ。敵は―――」
lines.english: “No, Saya. The enemy is—”

lines.japanese: 「私は、あなたの―――」
lines.english: “I am your—”

lines.japanese: 森を抜けると、朝冷えが身に染みた。
lines.english: The morning chill bit into him when he emerged from the forest.
“……Cold.”

lines.japanese:
ここからなら、工場も近い。
　誰かいるかも知れない。
lines.english: The factory was close by. Someone might be there.

lines.japanese:
猟奇殺人犯の跋扈する昨今、不安に怯えているか
も知れない。
lines.english: With a homicidal maniac at large these days, they might be trembling with fear.

lines.japanese: 「でも、もう行かなくちゃ」
lines.english: “But I have to go now.”

lines.japanese:
一緒にいられないのは寂しい。
　だとしても、あの場所にいてくれるなら。
　待っていてくれるならば。
lines.english: He felt lonely knowing they could not stay together. Even so, if only she would stay in that place— if she would wait for him there.

lines.japanese: 忍は歩き出す。
lines.english: Shinobu began to walk.

lines.japanese:
森の方角に顔を向け、もはや蒼然と深い小山のよ
うな存在を、愛おしげに見つめた。
lines.english: He turned toward the forest and gazed tenderly at what now loomed, deep and blue-shadowed, like a small mountain.

lines.japanese:
込み上げる気持ちをぐっと凝縮して、もっともわ
かりやすい単語に込める。
lines.english: He compressed the feeling welling up inside him into the clearest word.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう―――」
lines.english: “Thank you—”

lines.japanese: 自衛隊の最高責任者は内閣総理大臣である。
lines.english: Ultimate responsibility for the Japan Self-Defense Forces rests with the Prime Minister.

lines.japanese: Ａ資金。
lines.english: The A Fund.

lines.japanese:
それは第二次世界大戦終結後、占領政策を司ったＧＨＱのマーカット経済科学
長官が、戦時日本が所持していた貴金属類（日本軍が戦地で略奪したものも含む
）を用いて組み立てた特殊予算であり、現地における平和的政治制度の早期実現
を果たすため運用され……たものではない。
lines.english: After World War II, GHQ directed Japan's occupation. William F. Marquat, chief of its Economic and Scientific Section, assembled this special budget from precious metals held by wartime Japan—including plunder seized by the Japanese military in occupied territories. The fund was administered to establish peaceful political institutions in Japan as swiftly as possible… except it wasn't.

lines.japanese:
忍のデートに際し、義姉である千鳥のポケットマネーから供与されたあらゆる
書類に記載されない予算枠のことである。
　提供者である貴宮千鳥の名字から、Ａ資金と呼ばれ、その額は二万円であると
言われる。
lines.english: The term actually refers to an entirely off-the-books budget financed with pocket money from Shinobu’s older sister, Chidori, to pay for one of Shinobu’s dates. It takes the A in its name from its provider, Chidori Atemiya, and is said to total twenty thousand yen.

lines.japanese: ちなみにマーカットとマッカーサーは別人。元前線上がりの砲兵少将。
lines.english: For the record, Marquat and MacArthur were different people. Marquat was an artillery major general who had risen through front-line service.

lines.japanese: 「フン、服か」
lines.english: “Hmph. Clothes, huh?”

lines.japanese:
「そうだな……こちら側なら、やはり商店街に行く
　しかない」
lines.english: “Let's see… On this side of town, the shopping district is really our only bet.”

lines.japanese:
「まず行かないといけないのは、古着のおしゃれ
　泥棒だ」
lines.english: “First stop has to be Fashion Bandit, the secondhand clothing shop.”

lines.japanese:
「二階はヴィンテージ・ジーンズを中心の
　ラインナップだが、一階はカップル向けに
　レディース・コーナーもある」
lines.english: “The second floor is mostly vintage denim, but down on the first floor they also have a women's section for couples.”

lines.japanese:
「店長が趣味でやってるような店でな、文字通り
　アイテムは厳選されてる。管理状態も良い」
lines.english: “It's the kind of place the owner runs as a hobby, so everything is handpicked. They keep it all in good shape, too.”

lines.japanese: 「ここで一時間は潰してもいいだろうぜ」
lines.english: “You could easily kill an hour in there.”

lines.japanese:
「ここを出たら、実際行くところはほとんどない。
　大衆向けのカジュアルショップがあるが、広いだ
　けで安物だらけだ」
lines.english: “After that, there isn't much else. There's a big mass-market casualwear store, but size is all it has going for it. The place is full of cheap junk.”

lines.japanese:
「駅向こうに出ても、カジュアルやＢ系のショップ
　しかない」
lines.english: “Even on the far side of the station, all you'll find are casualwear and B-boy streetwear shops.”

lines.japanese:
「あとは駅前のデパート系列に行くくらいしか
　ないぞ」
lines.english: “That leaves the department-store chain by the station, and that's about it.”

lines.japanese: 呼吸が乱れていく。
lines.english: His breathing grew ragged.

lines.japanese: （ヤメロ！　こんなものは見たくない！）
lines.english: (STOP! I don't want to see this!)

lines.japanese: 呼吸が乱れていく。
lines.english: His breathing grew ragged.

lines.japanese: （意識の底に沈め！　実現するな！）
lines.english: (Sink into the depths of my consciousness! Don't come to pass!)

lines.japanese: （その未来だけは……決して！）
lines.english: (Not that future… Never!)

lines.japanese: （回避だ！）
lines.english: (I have to avoid it!)

lines.japanese: 呼吸が乱れていく。
lines.english: His breathing grew ragged.
